body: The Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 is built around one problem: a reactor needs precise dosing while it runs, and fast bulk transfer when it does not.
One pump, two speeds of work. It delivers 2.0 to 4,056 mL/min in single-channel operation, covering microlitre dosing and rapid fill or empty work in the same drive.
Speed, tubing diameter, flow display, dosing volume, and interval pause times are stored as a profile you select instead of re-entering every parameter.
RS232 and analogue control let speed, direction, and start/stop run under a PLC or process controller through digital RS232 or analogue 0 to 10 V / 4 to 20 mA signals.
The retraction function briefly reverses after each run to pull the tube clear before a drop forms at the tip, keeping small-volume dosing cleaner and more repeatable.

sections.title: Flow rate and dosing accuracy
body: The number on the datasheet is a range; the number that matters is what your specific tubing bore delivers at your specific speed setting. Flow rate on a peristaltic pump is a function of speed and tubing internal diameter together, not speed alone.

At the low end of the 24 to 600 rpm range, a fine-bore tube delivers microlitre-scale dosing with room to spare. At 600 rpm with a wide-bore tube, the same drive moves toward its 4,056 mL/min ceiling for fast fill and empty work.

The +/-0.5% control accuracy holds the drive steady at whichever point on that curve the application sits, and the +/-2% precision figure describes how tightly repeat doses land relative to each other.

body: Not every pump needs to remember a recipe. Some just need to run fast, run reliably, and answer to a signal from elsewhere in the process. The Hei-FLOW Expert 600 is built for that job: 2.0 to 4,056 mL/min across a 24 to 600 rpm range, at +/-0.5% control accuracy, without the programmable dosing layer that a reactor-dosing pump carries.

The turbo button is the feature this tier is built around. One press takes the drive straight to full speed, which is exactly what a tube needs when it's being drained or a vessel needs when the last of a residue has to come out. There's no menu to navigate and no parameter to set, press it, and the pump responds.

External control runs through a single analogue interface, 0 to 10 V or 4 to 20 mA, handling speed, direction, and start/stop. Wire it into a process controller and the pump takes its commands from the system rather than a person standing at the panel.
Direction reverses with a button press, and an optional foot switch frees both hands for the vessel, which matters most when you're filling something and changing containers often.

sections.title: Speed, flow and external control
body: Two things decide how this pump behaves in your process: the speed you set, and the signal your controller sends it.
Flow rate follows speed and tubing bore together, the same as any peristaltic drive, across 24 to 600 rpm and 2.0 to 4,056 mL/min. What's different here is how the drive is told what to do.

There's no stored program to select. The analogue interface takes a continuous voltage or current signal and translates it directly into speed, direction, and start/stop, so the pump does whatever the signal tells it to do, in real time.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-FLOW Core 120 Multi Channel Peristaltic Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Core 120 Multi is used for general fluid transfer and multi-channel dispensing, with one drive accepting either a single-channel or multi-channel pump head.

faqs.question: Can the same pump run both single-channel and multi-channel heads?
faqs.answer: Yes. The drive is built to accept either a single-channel or a multi-channel pump head, so one instrument covers both configurations as your work requires.

faqs.question: What flow rate does the Core 120 Multi deliver?
faqs.answer: Single-channel flow runs 0.85 to 861 mL/min. Multi-channel flow runs 0.005 to 364 mL/min per channel, depending on the head fitted.

faqs.question: Does the Core 120 Multi support programmed dosing?
faqs.answer: No. Volume dosing, interval dosing, and digital interfaces are not available on this model. For programmed dosing, the Hei-FLOW Ultimate range carries that functionality.

faqs.question: How is the direction of flow changed?
faqs.answer: With a single button. The tube and pump head do not need to be removed to reverse the direction of conveying.

faqs.question: Does the pump require maintenance?
faqs.answer: The drive has no user-serviceable components and is built for a long service life without attention. Routine maintenance is supported by Inkarp as needed.

faqs.question: What is the precision of the Core 120 Multi?
faqs.answer: Precision is +/-5%, with a control accuracy of +/-0.5% at the drive. For tighter precision, the Expert and Ultimate 600 pumps are rated to +/-3.5% and +/-2% respectively.

faqs.question: Does the pump include the pump head and tubing?
faqs.answer: No. The pump drive is supplied on its own; the pump head and tubing are selected separately based on your channel configuration and fluid, and Inkarp confirms this before quotation.

faqs.question: What other variants are available?
faqs.answer: The same drive is also available as the Core 600, capped at 600 rpm, and as a Standard version limited to single-channel operation only.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Hei-FLOW Core 120 Multi?
faqs.answer: The part number is 523-50013-00. Inkarp is the authorized distributor for this configuration in India.

faqs.answer: The price depends on the pump head, tubing, and channel configuration your application needs. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your flow requirements are confirmed.

longForm.heroHook: One Pump. Multiple Workflows. No Need for a Second Drive.
longForm.heroLead: Your lab requirements can change from one application to the next. The Heidolph Hei-FLOW Core 120 Multi is built to adapt with you. Use the same drive with either a single-channel or multi-channel pump head, simply swap the head to match your workflow instead of investing in another pump, delivering 0.85 to 861 mL/min single-channel or 0.005 to 364 mL/min per channel across a 10 to 120 rpm speed range. Operation requires no programming, and the maintenance-friendly design has no user-serviceable internal parts.

sections.title: Hei-FLOW Core 120 Multi at a glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the Core 120 Multi: how one drive handles both single and multi-channel work, the flow range for each configuration, what pump head and tubing you need, the full technical data, and Inkarp installation and service support.
body: Eliminate the need to buy separate pumps for single-channel and multi-channel applications. The Hei-FLOW Core 120 Multi uses one drive that accepts either a single-channel or multi-channel pump head, and you simply change the head to match your workflow as application requirements evolve.

It delivers 0.85 to 861 mL/min with a single-channel head, or 0.005 to 364 mL/min per channel with a multi-channel head, depending on the pump head and tubing selected. Speed is controlled across a 10 to 120 rpm range.
Reverse the pumping direction with a single button, no need to remove the tubing or pump head. There is no display or programming required, which keeps day-to-day operation simple and intuitive.

The drive is built with no user-serviceable internal components, for dependable, low-maintenance performance. It suits straightforward fluid transfer and multi-channel dispensing rather than automated dosing or stored programs.
Confirmed model: Hei-FLOW Core 120 Multi, P/N 523-50013-00. Also available as the Hei-FLOW Core 600 Multi at up to 600 rpm, or the Hei-FLOW Core Standard for single-channel applications only.

sections.title: Single and multi-channel flow
body: The flow rate this pump delivers depends entirely on which head is fitted, and that's the point. One drive, two very different flow profiles.

With a single-channel head, the pump covers 0.85 to 861 mL/min, a wide enough span for most general transfer work. Fit a multi-channel head instead, and the same drive splits its output across several channels, each running 0.005 to 364 mL/min.
That range makes the multi-channel configuration suited to fine, low-volume work spread across parallel lines, where the single-channel head is built for a single, larger flow.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-FLOW Expert 120 Multi Channel Peristaltic Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Expert 120 Multi is used for multi-channel dispensing and fast fluid transfer, with one drive taking either a single-channel or multi-channel head and an analogue interface for external control.

faqs.question: Can the same pump run both single-channel and multi-channel heads?
faqs.answer: Yes. The drive accepts either configuration, so one instrument covers both single-channel and multi-channel work.

faqs.question: What is the turbo button on the Hei-FLOW Expert 120 Multi?
faqs.answer: The turbo button takes the drive to full speed with one press, useful for draining a tube or clearing residue quickly, on either head configuration.

faqs.question: What flow rate does the Expert 120 Multi deliver?
faqs.answer: Single-channel flow runs 0.5 to 936 mL/min. Multi-channel flow runs 0.005 to 277 mL/min per channel, depending on the head fitted.

faqs.question: Does the Expert 120 Multi support programmed dosing?
faqs.answer: No. Volume dosing, interval dosing, and RS232 connectivity are not available on this model. For programmed dosing, the Hei-FLOW Ultimate range carries that functionality.

faqs.question: How is the Expert 120 Multi controlled?
faqs.answer: Through a single analogue interface, 0 to 10 V or 4 to 20 mA, which sets speed, direction, and start/stop.

faqs.question: Does the pump include the pump head and tubing?
faqs.answer: No. The pump drive is supplied on its own; the pump head and tubing are selected separately based on your channel configuration and fluid, and Inkarp confirms this before quotation.

faqs.question: What is the precision of the Expert 120 Multi?
faqs.answer: Precision is +/-3.5%, with a control accuracy of +/-0.5% at the drive.

faqs.question: What other variants are available?
faqs.answer: The same drive is also available as the Expert 600, capped at 600 rpm and single-channel only, and as a Standard version limited to single-channel operation at this speed cap.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Hei-FLOW Expert 120 Multi?
faqs.answer: The part number is 523-51013-00. Inkarp is the authorized distributor for this configuration in India.

longForm.heroHook: Switch channels. Hit turbo. One drive, both moves.
longForm.heroLead: Some jobs need several channels running at once. Others just need the line cleared fast. The Hei-FLOW Expert 120 Multi does both, on one drive. Fit a single-channel head and it runs 0.5 to 936 mL/min. Fit a multi-channel head and each channel runs 0.005 to 277 mL/min. Speed runs 5 to 120 rpm, held at +/-0.5% control accuracy. A turbo button gives instant full-speed access for line clearing, and an optional foot switch allows hands-free operation.

sections.title: Hei-FLOW Expert 120 Multi at a glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the Expert 120 Multi: how one drive runs single or multi-channel heads, what the turbo button and analogue interface control, the full technical data, and Inkarp installation and service support.
body: The Hei-FLOW Expert 120 Multi is designed for laboratories that need flexible pumping, fast operation, and easy integration with automated workflows. Use the same drive with either a single-channel or multi-channel pump head, adapting the pump to different applications without replacing the drive.
It delivers 0.5 to 936 mL/min with a single-channel head, or 0.005 to 277 mL/min per channel with a multi-channel head, depending on the pump head and tubing selected.

Press the turbo button to instantly reach maximum speed for quickly emptying tubing or clearing vessels between runs. Connect the pump to PLCs and process control systems using 0 to 10 V or 4 to 20 mA analogue control for external control of speed, direction, and start/stop functions.
The optional foot switch supports hands-free operation during routine dispensing tasks, and the flow reverses with the touch of a button without disconnecting the tubing or changing the pump head.
Confirmed model: Hei-FLOW Expert 120 Multi, P/N 523-51013-00. Also available as the Expert 600 at 600 rpm, single-channel only, or as a Standard model, single-channel only.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 120 Multi Channel Peristaltic Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Ultimate 120 Multi is used for precision dosing in pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and food-grade processes, with +/-1% precision and the flexibility to run single-channel or multi-channel pump heads.

faqs.question: What makes this the most precise pump in the Hei-FLOW range?
faqs.answer: Its +/-1% precision is the tightest across the range, tighter than the Ultimate 600's +/-2%, a result of its lower, more tightly controllable 5 to 120 rpm speed range.

faqs.question: Can the Ultimate 120 Multi run both single-channel and multi-channel heads?
faqs.answer: Yes. The drive accepts either configuration, so one instrument covers precise dosing on a single flow or across several parallel channels.

faqs.question: What is the retraction function?
faqs.answer: After each pumping run, the drive briefly reverses to pull the tube back and clear the last drop at the tip, protecting accuracy at the smallest dosed volumes.

faqs.question: Can the pump be operated inside a closed exhaust hood?
faqs.answer: Yes. The optional foot switch lets you start and stop the pump from outside a closed exhaust hood, so hazardous or sensitive media can be handled without reaching into the enclosure.

faqs.question: Can the Ultimate 120 Multi be automated?
faqs.answer: Yes. RS232 and analogue interfaces, 0 to 10 V or 4 to 20 mA, put speed, direction, and start/stop under external control from a PLC or process system.

faqs.question: What is interval dosing?
faqs.answer: A programmable dosing volume paired with a pause time, from 0.1 seconds to 750 hours, so a multi-step dosing sequence runs unattended exactly as specified.

faqs.question: Does the pump include the pump head and tubing?
faqs.answer: No. The pump drive is supplied on its own; the pump head and tubing are selected separately to match your channel configuration and fluid, and Inkarp confirms this before quotation.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Ultimate 120 Multi and the Ultimate 600?
faqs.answer: Both offer full dosing automation, retraction, and RS232 connectivity. The Ultimate 120 Multi adds channel flexibility and reaches tighter +/-1% precision, while the Ultimate 600 covers a higher 24 to 600 rpm speed range for faster conveying, single-channel only.

body: The Hei-FLOW Ultimate 120 Multi is built for applications where accurate, repeatable dosing is more important than moving high volumes of liquid. It achieves +/-1% dosing precision with +/-0.5% control accuracy, the highest precision in the Hei-FLOW range.

Use the same drive with either a single-channel or multi-channel pump head to suit different dosing applications. Program and save key parameters, including speed, tubing diameter, flow display, dosing volume, and interval dosing with pauses of up to 750 hours.

Integrate with laboratory software or PLC systems using RS232 and analogue interfaces for automated control of speed, direction, and start/stop functions. The retraction function briefly reverses the pump after each run to minimise droplet formation and improve dosing accuracy.

Operate the pump safely with the optional foot switch, allowing start and stop control from outside a closed exhaust hood. Designed for pharmaceutical, cosmetic, food, and other applications where precise, repeatable dispensing is essential.
Confirmed model: Hei-FLOW Ultimate 120 Multi, P/N 523-52013-00. Also available as the Ultimate 600 at 600 rpm, single-channel only, or as a Standard model, single-channel only.

sections.title: Channel flow and dosing precision
body: Precision here means two things at once: how tightly the drive holds a set speed, and how tightly repeat doses land against each other. This pump is rated +/-0.5% on the first and +/-1% on the second, both tighter than the equivalent 600 rpm Ultimate.
Channel configuration changes what that precision applies to. A single-channel head puts the full 0.36 to 813 mL/min range and the full +/-1% precision behind one flow.

A multi-channel head splits the drive across several channels, each running 0.005 to 329 mL/min at the same precision, which is what makes parallel, validated dosing across multiple lines possible from one instrument.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-VAC Valve Control Vacuum Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-VAC Valve Control is a vacuum pump built for rotary evaporation, supplying suction to up to three rotary evaporators at once, with an ultimate vacuum of 7 mbar without gas ballast.

faqs.question: What is gas ballast, and when should I use it?
faqs.answer: Gas ballast admits a controlled amount of air into the pump to prevent solvent vapour from condensing inside it. It shifts the ultimate vacuum from 7 mbar to 12 mbar, and is worth engaging when running high vapour loads or condensable solvents.

faqs.question: How many rotary evaporators can this pump run at once?
faqs.answer: Up to three, drawing suction from the same pump simultaneously.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-VAC Valve Control include a secondary condenser?
faqs.answer: No. The secondary condenser is not part of the scope of delivery and needs to be ordered separately for full solvent recovery.

faqs.question: Can this pump be used with a Hei-VAP Expert Control or Ultimate Control evaporator?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a vacuum valve, which is required for that pairing and sold separately.

faqs.question: How is the vacuum controlled on this pump?
faqs.answer: Through valve-operated or manual vacuum controllers, and the pump switches on and off via a switchbox.

faqs.question: What is the pumping speed of the Hei-VAC Valve Control?
faqs.answer: The pump reaches a maximum pumping speed of 2.0 to 2.3 m³/h, depending on the supply frequency.

faqs.question: What voltage does the Hei-VAC Valve Control run on?
faqs.answer: It accepts 100 to 115 V or 230 V supply, at 50 or 60 Hz, within +/-10%.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Valve Control and the RPM-regulated Vario models?
faqs.answer: The Valve Control uses valve-operated or manual vacuum control, while the Vario Station and Vario Control models regulate vacuum through pump speed instead. Inkarp confirms which control method suits your process.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Hei-VAC Valve Control?
faqs.answer: The part number is 591-00130-00. Inkarp is the authorized distributor for this configuration in India.

faqs.answer: The price depends on the accessories your setup needs, including the vacuum valve and secondary condenser. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your evaporator setup is confirmed.

longForm.heroLead: A rotary evaporator is only as good as the vacuum behind it. The Hei-VAC Valve Control pulls down to 7 mbar without gas ballast, or 12 mbar with it. One pump can supply suction to up to three rotary evaporators at the same time. Control runs through valve-operated or manual vacuum controllers, switched on and off through a switchbox. Pairing this pump with a Hei-VAP Expert Control or Ultimate Control evaporator needs a vacuum valve, and the secondary condenser is ordered separately.

sections.subheading: Shared vacuum for up to three rotary evaporators
body: The Hei-VAC Valve Control provides the vacuum performance needed for reliable solvent evaporation while supporting multiple rotary evaporators from a single pump.
It achieves an ultimate vacuum of 7 mbar without gas ballast for efficient solvent recovery, and operates at 12 mbar with gas ballast, helping protect the pump when handling condensable vapours.

The pump supplies vacuum to up to three rotary evaporators simultaneously, making it suited to shared laboratory workflows, and is compatible with valve-operated and manual vacuum controllers for flexible operation. It is controlled through an external switchbox, keeping operation simple and convenient.

When used with Hei-VAP Expert Control or Ultimate Control rotary evaporators, a vacuum valve is required and supplied separately. A secondary condenser is also available separately to complete the vacuum system.
Confirmed model: Hei-VAC Valve Control, P/N 591-00130-00. Secondary condenser and vacuum valve, where required, are sold separately.

sections.title: Vacuum depth and pumping speed
body: Two numbers decide how well this pump serves your evaporation: how deep a vacuum it reaches, and how fast it gets there.
Without gas ballast, the pump reaches 7 mbar, the deeper of the two figures and the one to use for straightforward solvent removal where vapour condensation inside the pump isn't a concern.

Switch gas ballast on, and the ultimate vacuum settles at 12 mbar instead, shallower, but the controlled air bleed keeps solvent vapour from condensing inside the pump chamber, which protects it during runs with high vapour loads.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-VAC Valve Tec Vacuum Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-VAC Valve Tec is a compact vacuum pump recommended for solvents with low or medium boiling points, reaching an ultimate vacuum of 12 mbar without gas ballast.

faqs.question: Why is the ultimate vacuum shallower than the Valve Control?
faqs.answer: Low and medium boiling point solvents evaporate at higher pressures and don't need the deeper 7 mbar vacuum the Valve Control reaches. The Valve Tec is sized to match, not to pull harder than the process requires.

faqs.question: What is gas ballast, and when should I use it?
faqs.answer: Gas ballast admits a controlled amount of air into the pump to prevent solvent vapour from condensing inside it. It shifts the ultimate vacuum from 12 mbar to 20 mbar, worth engaging with moderate vapour loads.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-VAC Valve Tec include a secondary condenser?

faqs.question: Can this pump be used with a Hei-VAP Expert Control or Ultimate Control evaporator?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a vacuum valve, which is required for that pairing and sold separately.

faqs.question: How compact is the Hei-VAC Valve Tec?
faqs.answer: It measures 338 x 183 x 143 mm and weighs 7.9 kg, a footprint built for a single-station bench rather than a shared multi-evaporator setup.

faqs.question: How is the vacuum controlled on this pump?
faqs.answer: Through valve-operated or manual vacuum controllers.

faqs.question: What voltage does the Hei-VAC Valve Tec run on?
faqs.answer: It accepts 100 to 115 V, 120 V, or 220 to 230 V supply, at 50 or 60 Hz, within +/-10%. The 120 V version includes an additional 2.5 AT fuse.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Valve Tec and the Valve Control?
faqs.answer: The Valve Tec is a smaller, lighter pump matched to low and medium boiling point solvents, reaching 12 mbar. The Valve Control is a higher-capacity pump reaching 7 mbar, built for deeper vacuum demand and up to three rotary evaporators at once.

longForm.heroHook: Built for Low & Medium Boiling Solvents. Nothing More Than You Need.
longForm.heroLead: Not every evaporation process requires a deep vacuum. For low and medium boiling point solvents, the Hei-VAC Valve Tec delivers the vacuum performance you need in a compact, space-saving design. Achieve an ultimate vacuum of 12 mbar without gas ballast or 20 mbar with gas ballast, balancing performance with pump protection when handling condensable vapours. Weighing just 7.9 kg with a compact 338 x 183 x 143 mm footprint, it's ideal for single-station rotary evaporator setups where bench space matters. It is compatible with valve-operated and manual vacuum controllers, and can be paired with Hei-VAP Expert Control and Ultimate Control rotary evaporators using an optional vacuum valve; a secondary condenser is available separately.

sections.title: Hei-VAC Valve Tec at a glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the Valve Tec: which solvents it's built for, what its compact footprint means for your bench, how gas ballast changes its vacuum, the full technical data, and Inkarp installation and service support.
sections.subheading: Right-sized vacuum for low and medium boiling point solvents
body: The Hei-VAC Valve Tec is designed for laboratories working with low and medium boiling point solvents, delivering the right level of vacuum without unnecessary complexity.

It achieves an ultimate vacuum of 12 mbar without gas ballast, or 20 mbar with gas ballast, providing the vacuum level needed while helping reduce the risk of bumping and foaming caused by excessive vacuum.

A compact 338 x 183 x 143 mm footprint and 7.9 kg weight make it suited to single rotary evaporator workstations, and it is compatible with valve-operated and manual vacuum controllers for straightforward vacuum control.
When paired with Hei-VAP Expert Control or Ultimate Control rotary evaporators, an optional vacuum valve is required. A secondary condenser is available separately to complete the vacuum system.

sections.title: Vacuum depth and solvent matching
body: The right vacuum pump isn't the one that pulls hardest. It's the one matched to what your solvent actually needs.

Low and medium boiling point solvents evaporate at higher pressures than the deepest vacuums a pump can reach, so the Valve Tec's 12 mbar (without gas ballast) is calibrated to that reality rather than chasing a depth the process doesn't use.
Engage gas ballast and the ultimate vacuum settles at 20 mbar instead, trading a little depth for protecting the pump against condensing vapour during runs with a heavier vapour load.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-VAC Vario Station RPM-Regulated Vacuum Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Vario Station is a stand-alone vacuum pump built for Hei-VAP Core rotary evaporators, using continuous RPM regulation to hold a precise vacuum and prevent bumping and foaming.

faqs.question: What does RPM-regulated mean?
faqs.answer: The pump's motor speed adjusts continuously, from 0 to 2,400 rpm, to hold the target vacuum, rather than running at a fixed speed and using a valve to throttle it.

faqs.question: How does this pump prevent bumping and foaming?
faqs.answer: Continuous speed regulation avoids the sudden pressure steps that a valve-controlled, fixed-speed pump can produce, which is usually what triggers bumping or foaming in the first place.

faqs.question: Does this pump need a separate vacuum controller?
faqs.answer: No. The Vario Station is a fully controllable, stand-alone unit with the vacuum controller built in.

faqs.question: Which rotary evaporators does this pump pair with?
faqs.answer: It's built and recommended for Hei-VAP Core models. For Hei-VAP Expert Control or Ultimate Control evaporators, a valve-controlled Hei-VAC model with a vacuum valve is the typical pairing.

faqs.question: What is gas ballast, and when should I use it?
faqs.answer: Gas ballast admits a controlled amount of air into the pump to prevent solvent vapour from condensing inside it. It shifts the ultimate vacuum from 5 mbar to 7 mbar.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-VAC Vario Station include a secondary condenser?
faqs.answer: No. The secondary condenser is not part of the scope of delivery and needs to be ordered separately.

faqs.question: How deep a vacuum does the Vario Station reach?
faqs.answer: 5 mbar without gas ballast, the deepest ultimate vacuum in the Hei-VAC range.

longForm.heroHook: The Pump Adjusts the Vacuum. You Focus on the Process.
longForm.heroLead: Forget manual valve adjustments. The Hei-VAC Vario Station automatically changes its motor speed from 0 to 2,400 rpm to maintain the vacuum level your process requires. By continuously matching the vacuum to your application, it helps reduce bumping, minimise foaming, and deliver smoother, more controlled evaporation. The vacuum controller is built in, and it is designed to pair seamlessly with Hei-VAP Core rotary evaporators.

body: The Hei-VAC Vario Station automatically adjusts its motor speed to maintain the required vacuum, helping deliver stable and controlled evaporation throughout the process.
Variable motor speed automatically adjusts from 0 to 2,400 rpm to maintain the set vacuum level, and continuous vacuum regulation helps reduce foaming and bumping during rotary evaporation.

It features a built-in vacuum controller, eliminating the need for a separate controller. Simply set the required process parameters, and the pump automatically maintains the desired vacuum throughout the run.

The Vario Station achieves an ultimate vacuum of 5 mbar without gas ballast, or 7 mbar with gas ballast for handling condensable vapours, and is specifically designed to pair with Hei-VAP Core rotary evaporators for integrated evaporation workflows.

sections.title: RPM regulation and vacuum precision
body: A valve-controlled pump runs at one speed and bleeds air to hold vacuum. The Vario Station's pump speed is the control itself.

Because the motor can run anywhere in a continuous 0 to 2,400 rpm range, the vacuum it delivers changes smoothly, not in valve-driven steps. That's a direct answer to bumping and foaming, both of which are usually a response to the vacuum moving too fast rather than the vacuum being too deep.
Gas ballast sits alongside this as a second, independent control: engage it, and the ultimate vacuum shifts from 5 mbar to 7 mbar in exchange for protecting the pump from condensing vapour.

longForm.heroHook: Deep vacuum that holds, even with gas ballast open. Built for DMF, DMSO, and solvents like them.
longForm.heroLead: High boiling point solvents are hard to distill safely. Heat the bath too much, and you risk decomposing what you're trying to purify. The Hei-VAC Vario Control solves this with vacuum depth. It reaches 2 mbar without gas ballast, and opening the gas ballast valve barely moves it, still reaching 4 mbar. That's deep enough to distill solvents like DMF or DMSO at low bath temperatures, without decomposing them. It's built for Hei-VAP Expert Control and Ultimate Control evaporators, and connects to a coolant line through a DN 6-8 mm hose.

body: The Hei-VAC Vario Control is designed for applications that require deep vacuum and precise control, making it well suited for evaporating high boiling point solvents.

It achieves an ultimate vacuum of 2 mbar without gas ballast and 4 mbar with gas ballast, for efficient solvent evaporation while protecting the pump from condensable vapours. This makes it ideal for high boiling point solvents such as DMF and DMSO, helping reduce boiling temperatures during evaporation.

It uses RPM-regulated motor control to continuously maintain the required vacuum without manual valve adjustment, providing stable vacuum control that helps minimise foaming and bumping throughout the evaporation process.

Recommended for use with Hei-VAP Expert Control and Hei-VAP Ultimate Control rotary evaporators, it has a compact, lightweight design at 5.4 kg for easy integration into laboratory workstations, and includes a DN 6-8 mm coolant connection to support operation with high condensable vapour loads.

sections.title: Vacuum depth for high-boiling solvents
body: Distilling a high boiling point solvent safely comes down to one trade: how deep a vacuum you can hold against how much protection you need from the vapour it gives off.

Without gas ballast, the Vario Control reaches 2 mbar, deep enough to bring the effective boiling point of solvents like DMF or DMSO well below their atmospheric value. With gas ballast open, the pump gives up remarkably little of that depth, settling at 4 mbar rather than the steep drop other pumps in the range show.
That's what makes it possible to run condensable, high-boiling solvents with gas ballast protection on, without sacrificing the low bath temperature the whole process depends on.

features: Clear Digital Display: The display shows actual values and set values, allowing users to monitor rotation speed and heating bath temperature during operation.
Separate Dynamic Control Knobs: Two dedicated control knobs make the system easy to operate. Fast turning supports larger value changes, while slow turning allows precise adjustment.
Lock Function: The lock function helps prevent accidental changes to selected values during operation, supporting better repeatability and safer use.
LED Ring Light System: The intuitive LED ring light system makes activated functions clearly visible, even from a distance.
Flexible Flask Positioning: The system allows easy adjustment of the immersion depth up to 155 mm and the inclination angle from 20° to 80°.
Standby Function: The standby function stops active operations. In motor lift versions, the standby button also lifts the evaporating flask from the heating bath.
Residual Heat Warning: The system provides a residual heat warning when the heating bath temperature is above 50°C, helping improve laboratory safety.

Hand Lift and Motor Lift Availability: The Hei-VAP Core is available as both hand lift and motor lift models, allowing laboratories to choose the lifting mechanism that best suits their operating style.

longForm.heroHook: Reliable rotary evaporation for routine laboratory workflows
longForm.heroLead: The Heidolph Hei-VAP Core Rotary Evaporator is designed for laboratories that want reliable solvent evaporation, sample concentration and solvent recovery without unnecessary complexity. With direct access to rotation speed and heating bath temperature, the Hei-VAP Core helps users run everyday evaporation workflows with better control, better visibility and greater confidence. It is available in hand lift and motor lift versions, with multiple glassware configurations to match different solvents, condensation needs and laboratory workflows.

sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the Hei-VAP Core Rotary Evaporator overview, features, applications, specifications, evaporation performance, configurations, documentation and support.
body: The Hei-VAP Core Rotary Evaporator supports routine solvent evaporation, sample concentration, distillation, and solvent recovery workflows.
The Hei-VAP Core from Heidolph is built for laboratories that need a dependable rotary evaporator for routine evaporation, distillation, solvent recovery and sample concentration.
Its operating concept is focused on the essentials. Users can access the two most important parameters; rotation speed and heating bath temperature at any time.

The clear digital display shows both actual values and set values, helping operators monitor the evaporation process without confusion. Separate control knobs allow quick value changes as well as precise fine adjustment.

As a Heidolph Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service to help users get the most from their rotary evaporation workflows.

sections.title: The rotary evaporation cycle
sections.description: How the Hei-VAP Core gently removes solvent in a continuous loop of rotate, heat, evaporate, condense and collect.

steps.title: Rotate
steps.description: The flask spins (10–280 rpm), spreading a thin film for a large surface area.

steps.title: Heat
steps.description: The water/oil bath (20–210 °C) gently warms the sample.

steps.title: Evaporate
steps.description: Under vacuum, solvent boils off at low temperature, protecting the product.

steps.title: Condense
steps.description: Vapour cools on the G3 condenser (0.22 m² surface) back to liquid.

steps.title: Collect
steps.description: Recovered solvent drains into the receiving flask; product stays behind.

longForm.heroHook: Precise, upgrade-ready rotary evaporation for laboratories that want more control.
longForm.heroLead: The Heidolph Hei-VAP Expert Rotary Evaporator is built for laboratories that need accurate, repeatable evaporation, distillation, sample concentration, and solvent recovery with clear process visibility and room to grow. A central 5-inch touch display and dedicated control knobs let users set values precisely or make quick changes during a run. An integrated solvent library, USB and Micro SD interfaces, and the option to upgrade to vacuum and chiller control make it suitable for both routine and more demanding evaporation work. It is available in hand lift and motor lift versions, with multiple glassware configurations to match different solvents, condensation needs, and laboratory setups.

sections.title: Hei-VAP Expert at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the Hei-VAP Expert Rotary Evaporator: overview, features, applications, specifications, evaporation performance, configurations, documentation, and support.
body: The Hei-VAP Expert from Heidolph is built for laboratories that want more than basic solvent removal. It combines digital operation, accurate control of rotation and heating, and safety functions that support both routine work and more demanding evaporation tasks.

A central 5-inch touch display shows actual and set values, with Basic and Advanced modes to match the process requirement. Separate knobs for rotation and heating allow quick changes or precise fine adjustment, while the lock function helps prevent accidental changes during operation.

An integrated solvent library helps identify suitable vacuum settings when working with an external vacuum controller. USB and Micro SD interfaces support data handling, transfer of favorites, and updates.

The Hei-VAP Expert is upgrade-ready. It can be upgraded to Hei-VAP Expert Control, which adds vacuum and chiller control from the same display. This allows the setup to grow with the laboratory requirement without replacing the core system.

As a Heidolph Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training, and after-sales service.

steps.title: Evaporate
steps.description: Reduced pressure lowers the boiling point so solvent can evaporate gently from the sample.

steps.title: Condense
steps.description: Vapour reaches the selected condenser glassware and is cooled back into liquid.

steps.title: Collect
steps.description: Recovered solvent drains into the receiving flask while the concentrated sample remains in the evaporating flask.

longForm.heroHook: Advanced rotary evaporation with 7-inch control visibility and Lab 4.0-ready connectivity.
longForm.heroLead: The Heidolph Hei-VAP Ultimate Rotary Evaporator is designed for laboratories that need controlled evaporation, distillation, sample concentration, and solvent recovery with larger process visibility and stronger connectivity. A central 7-inch touch display gives users access to operating values in Basic and Advanced modes. Dedicated knobs for rotation and heating allow quick adjustment during active operation, while the locking function helps prevent accidental changes. This page focuses on the Hei-VAP Ultimate Standard G3 vertical glassware Handlift, P/N 575-01300-00, with handlift operation, G3 vertical glassware, and no coated condenser or receiving flask. Other lift, glassware, coating, and control configurations can be confirmed with Inkarp based on the application.

sections.title: Hei-VAP Ultimate at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the Hei-VAP Ultimate Rotary Evaporator: overview, features, applications, specifications, evaporation performance, configurations, documentation, connectivity, and support.
sections.subheading: Controlled rotary evaporation with larger visibility and Lab 4.0-ready connectivity
body: The Hei-VAP Ultimate from Heidolph is built for laboratories that need controlled rotary evaporation with larger process visibility, flexible operation, and digital connectivity.

The 7-inch touch display shows values clearly and supports Basic and Advanced modes. Users can manage rotation speed and heating bath temperature through the display or make quick changes during a run using the dedicated control knobs.

The system includes a timer, maximum temperature limitation, multilingual menu, text-based error messages, LED ring lights, pictogram status display, and a locking function to prevent accidental readjustment.

An integrated solvent library helps identify the required vacuum setting when working with an external vacuum controller. USB, Micro SD, LAN, and RS 232 interfaces support Lab 4.0-ready connectivity for laboratories that need stronger digital integration.

The Hei-VAP Ultimate can be upgraded to Hei-VAP Ultimate Control, including vacuum and chiller control. Inkarp supports laboratories in India with product consultation, configuration guidance, installation, user training, application support, genuine spares, and after-sales service.

sections.title: The rotary evaporation cycle
sections.description: How the Hei-VAP Ultimate moves solvent through a continuous loop of rotate, heat, evaporate, condense and collect, at rates matched to Heidolph's published performance data.

steps.title: Rotate
steps.description: The flask spins (10-280 rpm), spreading a thin film across the glass for a larger surface area.

steps.title: Heat
steps.description: The 6 L water/oil bath (20-210 °C) warms the sample under 7-inch display control.

steps.title: Evaporate
steps.description: Under vacuum, solvent boils off at a reduced temperature - up to 8.5 L/h for toluene under continuous operation.

steps.title: Condense
steps.description: Vapour cools across the condenser (0.22 m² surface) and returns to liquid.

steps.title: Collect
steps.description: Recovered solvent drains into the receiving flask while the sample stays behind.

longForm.heroHook: Integrated evaporation control with vacuum, cooling, saved methods, and automated process guidance.
longForm.heroLead: The Heidolph Hei-VAP Expert Control Rotary Evaporator is designed for laboratories that need more control over evaporation, distillation, sample concentration, and solvent recovery. A 5-inch touch display controls the complete evaporation system, including vacuum and cooling temperature. Separate quick-access knobs allow direct control of rotation and vacuum, while the display gives users an overview of all key parameters and the current process. This page focuses on the Hei-VAP Expert Control Standard Handlift, P/N 573-02300-00, with handlift operation, G3 vertical glassware, and no coated condenser or receiving flask. Other lift, glassware, coating, package, vacuum, and cooling configurations should be confirmed with Inkarp before quoting.

sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the Hei-VAP Expert Control Rotary Evaporator: overview, features, applications, specifications, evaporation performance, configurations, automation, packages, documentation, and service support.
sections.subheading: Integrated control of evaporation, vacuum, and cooling from one display
body: The Hei-VAP Expert Control from Heidolph is built for laboratories that need integrated control of rotary evaporation parameters from one operating interface.

Unlike standard rotary evaporator setups where vacuum and cooling may be managed separately, the Expert Control version brings evaporation system control into the 5-inch touch display, including vacuum and cooling temperature.

The display gives users a clear overview of values and the current process. Active functions are shown through pictograms, while quick-access knobs support direct control of rotation and vacuum without navigating through multiple menu layers.

The system supports two favorites on the start screen, an expandable solvent library, user-defined evaporation ramps, and automated evaporation through the Dynamic AUTOaccurate Program, also called DAA. These functions help laboratories improve process repeatability and reduce manual intervention during evaporation work.

As a Heidolph Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp supports laboratories with product consultation, configuration guidance, vacuum and cooling accessory selection, installation, user training, application support, and after-sales service.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-VAP Ultimate Control Rotary Evaporator?
faqs.answer: The Hei-VAP Ultimate Control is a Heidolph rotary evaporator designed for controlled solvent evaporation, vacuum distillation, sample concentration, and solvent recovery. It combines a 7-inch touch display, integrated vacuum and cooling temperature control, saved evaporation ramps, DAA automatic evaporation, and Lab 4.0-ready interfaces.

faqs.question: What is the exact Hei-VAP Ultimate Control model on this page?
faqs.answer: This page focuses on the Hei-VAP Ultimate Control hand lift model with G3 vertical glassware, P/N 575-02300-00. The confirmed configuration is handlift operation, G3 vertical glassware, and no coated condenser or receiving flask.

faqs.question: How is Hei-VAP Ultimate Control different from Hei-VAP Ultimate?
faqs.answer: Hei-VAP Ultimate Control adds integrated control of vacuum and cooling temperature from the 7-inch touch display. It also supports saved evaporation ramps, direct favorites, an expandable solvent library, and Dynamic AUTOaccurate Program for automatic evaporation.

faqs.question: How is Hei-VAP Ultimate Control different from Hei-VAP Expert Control?
faqs.answer: Both models support integrated vacuum and cooling temperature control, saved ramps, favorites, solvent library, and DAA. The main difference is that Hei-VAP Ultimate Control has a 7-inch touch display and USB, Micro SD, LAN, and RS 232 interfaces, making it Lab 4.0 ready.

faqs.question: What does the 7-inch touch display control?
faqs.answer: The 7-inch touch display controls the complete evaporation system, including rotation, vacuum, and cooling temperature. It also gives users an overview of all parameters and the current process.

faqs.question: Which quick-access knobs are available on Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: Hei-VAP Ultimate Control has separate quick-access knobs for vacuum and rotation. The right knob is used for direct vacuum control, and the left knob is used for rotation control.

faqs.question: What is Dynamic AUTOaccurate Program in Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: Dynamic AUTOaccurate Program, also called DAA, supports automatic evaporation with customizable control. It helps users manage evaporation behaviour, including foam avoidance and efficient evaporation.

faqs.question: Can users save evaporation processes on Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: Yes. Users can define and save their own evaporation processes as ramps. This helps laboratories repeat controlled evaporation processes with better consistency.

faqs.question: Can favorite methods be transferred between devices?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Hei-VAP Ultimate Control supports transfer of individual favorites to other devices using a USB stick. This is useful when laboratories want to standardize commonly used evaporation settings across similar systems.

faqs.question: Which interfaces are available on Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: Hei-VAP Ultimate Control includes USB, Micro SD, LAN, and RS 232 interfaces. These interfaces support Lab 4.0-ready connectivity and connection with compatible external systems.

faqs.question: What is the speed range of Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: The Hei-VAP Ultimate Control supports a rotation speed range of 10 to 280 rpm. This allows controlled rotation for routine evaporation, solvent recovery, distillation, and sample concentration workflows.

faqs.question: What is the heating bath volume and temperature range?
faqs.answer: The heating bath volume is 6 L. The heating bath temperature range is 20 to 100 °C with water and 20 to 210 °C with oil.

faqs.question: What evaporation rates are listed for Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: The listed evaporation rates at a temperature difference of 40 °C are 8.5 L/h for toluene, 5.8 L/h for acetone, 3.5 L/h for ethanol, and 1.2 L/h for water. Actual performance depends on solvent type, vacuum level, cooling efficiency, glassware, sample volume, and operating conditions.

faqs.question: Which packages are available for Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: The listed package directions for this product include University Research Package and University Research-Chill Package. Package availability, included accessories, and suitability should be confirmed with Inkarp before quoting.

faqs.question: What accessories may be required with Hei-VAP Ultimate Control?
faqs.answer: Accessory selection may include vacuum pumps, chillers or thermostats, glassware sets, flasks, tubing, receiving flasks, sensors, cables, and additional safety or process accessories. The final accessory set should be selected based on solvent, sample volume, cooling requirement, vacuum requirement, and workflow.

longForm.heroLead: Integrated evaporation control with 7-inch visibility, automation, and Lab 4.0-ready connectivity. The Heidolph Hei-VAP Ultimate Control Rotary Evaporator is designed for laboratories that need controlled evaporation, vacuum distillation, sample concentration, and solvent recovery with integrated process control. A 7-inch touch display controls the complete evaporation system, including vacuum and cooling temperature. Separate quick-access knobs allow direct control of vacuum and rotation, while the display gives users an overview of all parameters and the current process. This page focuses on the Hei-VAP Ultimate Control, hand lift model with G3 vertical glassware, P/N 575-02300-00, with handlift operation, G3 vertical glassware, and no coated condenser or receiving flask. Other lift, glassware, coating, package, vacuum, cooling, and accessory configurations should be confirmed with Inkarp before quoting.

sections.subheading: Integrated control of evaporation, vacuum, cooling, and connectivity from one display
body: The Hei-VAP Ultimate Control from Heidolph is built for laboratories that need integrated control of rotary evaporation parameters with larger process visibility, automation support, and digital connectivity.

The 7-inch touch display controls the complete system, including vacuum and cooling temperature. It gives users an overview of all parameters and the current process, while pictograms on the display show active functions for clear monitoring.

Separate quick-access knobs support direct operation during active use. The right knob provides direct vacuum control, while the left knob supports rotation control. Users can set values either through the touch display or through the quick-access knobs.

The system supports two favorites on the start screen, an expandable solvent library, USB transfer of favorites, user-defined evaporation ramps, and automatic evaporation through the Dynamic AUTOaccurate Program, also called DAA.
With USB, Micro SD, LAN, and RS 232 interfaces, the Hei-VAP Ultimate Control supports Lab 4.0-ready connectivity for laboratories that need connection with compatible external systems.

As a Heidolph Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp supports laboratories with product consultation, configuration guidance, vacuum and cooling accessory selection, installation, user training, application support, genuine spares, and after-sales service.

longForm.heroHook: Large-volume evaporation with enhanced safety enclosure and clear process visibility.
longForm.heroLead: Scale up evaporation without overcomplicating your setup. When benchtop evaporation is no longer enough, the Heidolph Hei-VAP Industrial Rotary Evaporator helps laboratories move into larger batch volumes with a practical, cost-focused industrial configuration. The confirmed configuration is Hei-VAP Industrial with glassware A, P/N 518-13100-00. It includes one descending condenser, one expansion vessel, one 20 L evaporating flask, and one 10 L receiving flask. It is designed for teams handling larger solvent volumes, pilot-scale distillation, solvent recovery, and concentration workflows where bath capacity, vacuum performance, cooling supply, and safe handling all need to be planned together.

longForm.heroHook: Large-volume evaporation with practical configuration support for pilot and process workflows.
longForm.heroLead: Scale up evaporation without overcomplicating your setup. When benchtop evaporation is no longer enough, the Heidolph Hei-VAP Industrial Basic Rotary Evaporator helps laboratories move into larger batch volumes with a practical, cost-focused industrial configuration. The confirmed configuration is Hei-VAP Industrial B with glassware A, P/N 518-23100-00. It includes one descending condenser, one expansion vessel, one 20 L evaporating flask, and one 10 L receiving flask. It is designed for teams handling larger solvent volumes, pilot-scale distillation, solvent recovery, and concentration workflows where bath capacity, vacuum performance, cooling supply, and safe handling all need to be planned together.

sections.title: Hei-VAP Industrial Basic at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the Hei-VAP Industrial Basic Rotary Evaporator: configuration, applications, technical specifications, utility needs, performance data, accessories, documentation, and Inkarp service support.
sections.subheading: Large-volume evaporation, planned around your utilities
body: The Hei-VAP Industrial Basic Rotary Evaporator is designed for laboratories and pilot-scale facilities that need to process larger solvent volumes without moving directly into a fully enclosed industrial evaporation system.

This configuration, Hei-VAP Industrial B with glassware A, gives users a large-volume evaporation setup with a 20 L evaporating flask, 10 L receiving flask, descending condenser, expansion vessel, universal heating bath, receiver cassettes, programmable ramps, and a detachable 7-inch touch panel with control knobs.

The Basic version keeps the core industrial evaporation capability while reducing selected enclosure-based safety elements found in the full Hei-VAP Industrial model. This makes it suitable for labs that need scale, repeatability, and configuration flexibility, but also need to manage investment carefully.

Inkarp helps customers review the complete setup before purchase, including solvent type, batch volume, vacuum pump capacity, cooling liquid supply, bath fluid, installation space, optional base cart, IQ/OQ documentation, operator training, and long-term service needs.

products.overview: Your rotary evaporator stops every time someone has to refill a flask. This module means it does not have to.
features: Sensor or Time-Controlled Filling: Refilling the rotary flask is easy. Doing it every fifteen minutes is not. The module fills the flask either when a sensor detects that liquid is needed or at a time interval you program, so the distillation keeps moving without anyone returning to the bench.

Approx. 330 mL Coated Collector Vessel: A full collector is normally the point at which the process stops. The coated collector vessel holds approximately 330 mL and is emptied automatically on the schedule you set, so the next cycle starts without you.
Integrated Compressor: The compressor that empties the collector is built into the control box. There is no external compressed air line to source, plumb, or maintain.

Removable 7-Inch Touchscreen Control Panel: Filling parameters, collector emptying time, automatic cleaning, and manual operation are all entered on one removable 7 inch touchscreen. Automation should not add a second interface to learn.

Animated Process Display: The animated, easy-to-read screen shows which step is currently running, and a colour scheme tells you what is happening at any moment. You can see the state of the process before you decide whether it needs you.

Illuminated Control Knobs: The illuminated control knobs show from across the laboratory whether the system is being aerated, is under vacuum, or is under overpressure. Status you can read at a glance is status you will actually check.
Automatic Cleaning Mode: Preparing for the next process should not become another manual routine. Automatic cleaning is started directly from the touchscreen, which shortens turnaround between runs.
Manual Operation Mode: When a process needs direct control, manual operation is available from the same screen. Automation is the default, not the only option.

Chemical-Resistant Media Contact Parts: All parts that come into contact with the media, including the supplied tubing, are made of chemical-resistant materials. Your solvent list can change without the module becoming the limiting factor.

Direct Hei-VAP Benchtop Mounting: The control box with its integrated compressor mounts directly onto a Hei-VAP benchtop rotary evaporator using the bracket supplied. Adding automation does not mean redesigning the bench.
Compact Control Box: At 186 x 429 x 521 mm including the control panel and approximately 17 kg, the module keeps the automation close to the instrument instead of spreading it across the workspace.

Unattended Overnight and Weekend Operation: In combination with the corresponding evaporator system, the module enables efficient unattended operation. Solvents and solvent waste can be processed overnight and over the weekend, which is where the cost case usually lives.

Residue Drainage Configuration Choice: The module can be specified according to process need, including a version without automated residue drainage. The configuration follows your process rather than the other way round.

faqs.question: What is the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro used for?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro is a Heidolph continuous automatic distillation module used to automate solvent recovery and continuous distillation on a compatible Hei-VAP benchtop rotary evaporator. It automatically fills the rotary flask, empties the collector vessel using an integrated compressor, and repeats the cycle, so long runs continue without an operator at the bench.

faqs.question: Which rotary evaporator is the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro compatible with?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro is compatible with a Hei-VAP benchtop rotary evaporator, onto which the control box and its integrated compressor mount directly using the bracket supplied. Inkarp confirms compatibility against your existing Hei-VAP configuration before quotation.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro?
faqs.answer: The part number of the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro is 591-62230-00, supplied as the Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro Benchtop G9BXL. Inkarp is the authorized distributor for this Heidolph configuration in India.

faqs.question: How does the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro fill the rotary flask?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro fills the rotary flask by either sensor-controlled or time-controlled filling, selected on the removable 7 inch touchscreen control panel. Sensor control responds to the actual flask level, while time control follows an interval you program.

faqs.question: What is the collector vessel capacity of the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro has a coated collector vessel of approximately 330 mL. The integrated compressor empties it on a time you program from the touchscreen, so the next distillation cycle begins without manual draining.

faqs.question: Does the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro need an external compressed air supply?
faqs.answer: No, the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro does not need an external compressed air supply, because the compressor that empties the collector vessel is integrated into the control box. This keeps the installation compact and removes the need to plumb a separate air line.

faqs.question: Can the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro run unattended overnight?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro is designed for unattended operation, and in combination with the corresponding evaporator system it allows solvents and solvent waste to be processed overnight and over weekends. Automatic filling, automatic collector emptying, and repeat cycles remove the interventions that normally stop a run.

faqs.question: Is the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro suitable for aggressive solvents?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro is built so that every part in contact with the media, including the supplied tubing, is made of chemical-resistant material, which supports a wide range of laboratory solvents. Share your solvent list with Inkarp to confirm suitability for your specific application.

faqs.question: Does the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro have an automatic cleaning mode?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro has an automatic cleaning mode that is started directly from the removable 7 inch touchscreen, alongside automatic and manual operation. This shortens turnaround between distillation runs.

faqs.question: What power supply does the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro require?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro requires 100 to 240 V AC at 50/60 Hz, with an L+N+PE connection, a maximum power input of 1,500 W, and a 15 A fuse. It carries IP42 protection to EN 60529.

faqs.question: What are the dimensions and weight of the Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro?
faqs.answer: The Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro measures 186 x 429 x 521 mm including the control panel and weighs approximately 17 kg. Confirm bench space next to your Hei-VAP rotary evaporator before installation.

longForm.heroHook: Your rotary evaporator stops every time someone has to refill a flask. This module means it does not have to.
longForm.heroLead: The Heidolph Large Scale Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro is a continuous automatic distillation module that turns a compatible Hei-VAP benchtop rotary evaporator into an unattended distillation system. It fills the rotary flask, empties the collector vessel, and repeats the cycle, so long solvent recovery runs no longer need someone standing beside the instrument. The confirmed configuration is the Hei-VOLUME Distimatic Pro Benchtop G9BXL, P/N 591-62230-00. It includes a removable 7 inch touchscreen control panel, an integrated compressor, a coated collector vessel of approximately 330 mL, and a mounting bracket that fixes the control box directly to the evaporator. Every part that touches your media, including the supplied tubing, is made of chemical-resistant material. Filling can be sensor-controlled or time-controlled. Cleaning has its own automatic mode. The workflow you already run does not change. The hours you spend supervising it do.

features: Gentle Stirring Without Heating: The Hei-Plate Mix 20 L was developed from Heidolph's stirring hotplate series and built deliberately without heating, for applications involving thermolabile substances. When your sample degrades with heat, the absence of a heater is not a missing feature, it is the specification.

Soft Start: The instrument accelerates gradually to the set speed. That gradual ramp prevents splashing, erratic starts, and the abrupt movement of the stirring rod that throws it out of coupling and can damage a delicate preparation.

Patented Kera-Disk Plate: The Kera-Disk plate is made of aluminium with a ceramic coating, and it is both chemical-resistant and scratch-resistant. Its distinctive composition and colour run across the Heidolph magnetic stirrer range, and it survives the spills that ruin a lesser plate.

Stirring Volumes Up to 20 Litres: The instrument handles solutions up to 20 litres, which covers preparation vessels well beyond the benchtop beaker range without asking you to stir them aggressively.
145 mm Plate Diameter: The 145 mm plate is compact for the volume it carries, which makes it workable with a range of accessories and vessels where bench space is tight.

Speed Range of 100 to 1,400 rpm: The range is tuned to gentle, controlled stirring of large volumes rather than fast homogenisation of small ones. Choosing this instrument means choosing control over speed.

25 kg Maximum Permissible Load: The plate carries up to 25 kg. This matters more here than on any small stirrer, because a filled large-volume vessel approaches that figure quickly. Check your filled weight before you order.
EC Motor Drive: The left-turning EC motor provides consistent torque across the speed range and is efficient, drawing 25 W in normal operation and 1.7 W in standby.
Quiet Operation: Acoustic pressure is below 50 dB(A). In a preparation laboratory running several stirrers at once, that is the difference between background noise and a nuisance.

10-Year Warranty: After registering the instrument, Heidolph warrants the magnetic stirrer for at least 10 years. The design has been refined over decades for dependable operation in demanding environmental conditions.
Built for Continuous Operation: A certificate for continuous operation is available for the Hei-PLATE range, which supports long, uninterrupted preparation and dissolution runs.
IP42 Protection: The instrument carries IP42 protection to EN 60529 and is a Protection Class I device.

faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer is a Heidolph large-volume magnetic stirrer used for gentle stirring of solutions up to 20 litres without heating. It was developed specifically for applications involving thermolabile substances, where heat would damage the sample.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer have a heating plate?
faqs.answer: No, the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer does not heat. It was developed from Heidolph's stirring hotplate series and built deliberately without heating, for thermolabile substances. If your method requires a heated plate, select from the Heidolph Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat range instead.

faqs.question: What is the maximum stirring volume of the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer stirs solutions of up to 20 litres. For volumes of 5 litres or less, the Hei-Mix S Magnetic Stirrer may be the more appropriate model.

faqs.question: What is the speed range of the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer has a speed range of 100 to 1,400 rpm, driven by a left-turning EC motor. The range is tuned for controlled, gentle stirring of large volumes rather than fast homogenisation.

faqs.question: What is the soft start on the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The soft start on the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer brings the stirring rod up to the set speed gradually. This prevents splashing, erratic starts, and the abrupt movement of the stirring rod that can throw it out of coupling and damage a delicate preparation.

faqs.question: What is the Kera-Disk plate on the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Kera-Disk plate on the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer is a patented Heidolph plate made of aluminium with a ceramic coating, 145 mm in diameter. It is both chemical-resistant and scratch-resistant, which allows it to survive spills and aggressive media.

faqs.question: What is the maximum permissible load on the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The maximum permissible load on the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer is 25 kg. This matters in practice, because 20 litres of water alone weighs about 20 kg before the vessel is added, so weigh your filled vessel before selecting the instrument.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?

faqs.question: How loud is the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?

products.overview: Two knobs. Stir and heat. Everything else Heidolph put into the parts you do not touch.
features: Two Rotary Knobs, Direct Control: Speed and temperature are set on two rotary knobs against a scale. There is no menu, no display to read, and nothing between you and the two things you came to do.
Heating to 300 °C: The plate heats from 20 °C to 300 °C, which covers the great majority of heated stirring, dissolution, and reaction work carried out on a laboratory bench.
800 W Heating Power at 230 V: On an Indian 230 V supply the instrument delivers 800 W of heating output, which is what allows it to bring a liquid to temperature quickly rather than gradually.

PID Heating Control: The control algorithm holds the set temperature without overshooting past it. Overshoot is not a cosmetic problem, it is the difference between a controlled reaction and a spoiled one.

Separately Activated Heating: The heating function is switched on independently of stirring, and an LED in the button lights to show it is live. You cannot heat a plate by accident while reaching for the stirrer.

Optical Residual Heat Indicator: The indicator remains lit while the plate is above 50 °C. The most common burn on a hot plate stirrer happens after the heat has been switched off, and this is the feature that prevents it.
Large Safety Gap: The controls are separated from the heating plate by a large gap, so reaching for a knob does not mean reaching over a hot surface.
Die-Cast Aluminium Housing: The housing is die-cast aluminium: robust, durable, and chemical-resistant. The design is optimised to minimise operating errors as well as to survive spills.

Patented Kera-Disk Plate: The Kera-Disk surface is anodized aluminium, chemical-resistant and scratch-proof, and it transfers heat rapidly. Its distinctive colour and composition run across the Heidolph magnetic stirrer range.
25 kg Maximum Permissible Load: The plate carries up to 25 kg, including the vessel and its contents, which covers the vessel range this instrument is built for.

Temperature Probe Compatibility: With the EKT Hei-Con temperature control unit, the indication and measurement range extends from -80 °C to 350 °C. If your method needs the temperature of the medium rather than the plate, this is how you get it.
10-Year Warranty: After registering the instrument with Heidolph, the magnetic stirrer is warranted for at least 10 years, in a design refined over decades for demanding conditions.

sections.description: Heating performance and temperature control on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer are governed by 800 W of heating power at 230 V, PID control to 300 °C, the rapid heat transfer of the Kera-Disk plate, and optional probe control through the EKT Hei-Con.
body: Heating performance and temperature control on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer are governed by 800 W of heating power at 230 V, PID control to 300 °C, the rapid heat transfer of the Kera-Disk plate, and optional probe control through the EKT Hei-Con.

Two numbers decide whether a hot plate stirrer is any good: how fast it reaches temperature, and whether it stops there. The Core answers the first with 800 W and a plate designed for rapid heat transfer, and the second with PID control that does not overshoot.

One limit is worth being clear about. The Core sets and holds the plate temperature. If your method depends on the temperature of the medium, you need the EKT Hei-Con temperature control unit, which reads the medium directly and extends the range to -80 to 350 °C.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + Magnetic Stirrer used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + Magnetic Stirrer is a Heidolph digital hot plate magnetic stirrer used for precise heated stirring, stirring gently to 1,400 rpm and heating with high precision to 300 °C. Temperature is set on an LCD display, and two selectable heating modules control how the setpoint is reached.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core and the Core +?
faqs.answer: The Core+ adds a digital LCD display, FAST and PRECISE heating modules, an optional Pt1000 external temperature sensor with ±0.2 K measurement accuracy, dynamic rotary knobs, a locking function, and a patented LED ring system. Both models heat at 800 W to 300 °C under PID control.

faqs.question: What are the FAST and PRECISE heating modules on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: FAST heats liquids to the target temperature in record time. PRECISE reaches the target with little to no overshoot, which is useful for temperature-sensitive methods.

faqs.question: What is the temperature measurement accuracy of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The temperature measurement accuracy is ±0.2 K, plus the tolerance of the Pt1000 sensor, at a resolution of 1 K.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + Magnetic Stirrer measure the temperature of the liquid?
faqs.answer: It measures and controls the temperature of the medium when the optional external Pt1000 sensor is fitted, across an indication range of 15 to 325 °C. Without the sensor, it controls the plate temperature.

faqs.question: What is the maximum temperature of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Core+ heats from 20 °C to 300 °C at 800 W on a 230 V supply, under PID control.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + Magnetic Stirrer have a display?
faqs.answer: Yes. It has an LCD display, allowing the desired temperature to be set precisely as a figure rather than as a position on a scale.

faqs.question: What is the locking function on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The locking function prevents accidental changes to the settings. On shared or teaching benches, it protects a running method from being altered by mistake.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The part number for the 145 mm Core+ configuration is 506-21100-00. Inkarp is the authorized distributor for this Heidolph configuration in India.

faqs.question: What safety features does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + Magnetic Stirrer have?
faqs.answer: It has a visual residual heat indicator above 50 °C, a patented LED ring system, illuminated keys and knobs, a locking function, and an optimized design intended to reduce operating errors and burn risk.

faqs.question: What warranty does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + Magnetic Stirrer carry?

The entry-level Core asks you to trust a mark on a scale. The Core+ shows you the number, holds it, and stops anyone from changing it.

With the optional external Pt1000 sensor, the temperature you control is the one your sample is actually at, not only the plate temperature.
Dynamic rotary knobs provide fine adjustment with a slow turn and large changes with a fast turn, while the locking function protects running settings on shared benches.
A lock, so nobody undoes your method. The locking function prevents accidental changes to a running setting on a shared bench.
The instrument tells you what is live. Illuminated keys, a patented LED ring, and a residual heat indicator stay visible while the plate is still dangerous.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer used for?
faqs.answer: It is used for connected, documented, and data-logged heated stirring workflows where interfaces, USB logging, e-Lift compatibility, and external temperature sensing are required.

faqs.question: Is the Ultimate compatible with e-Lift?
faqs.answer: Yes. e-Lift compatibility is documented through the USB C interface.

faqs.question: What is the maximum temperature of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer heats from 20 °C to 350 °C, with a setting accuracy of 1 K. This is 50 °C beyond the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core and Core+, which both stop at 300 °C.

faqs.question: What are the three heating modules on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer has three selectable heating modules. FAST heats quickly. PRECISE and PRECISE+ provide exact temperature control without overshoot, for optimal protection of sensitive samples.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The part number of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer, with the 145 mm plate, is 506-41100-00. Inkarp is the authorized distributor for this Heidolph configuration in India.

faqs.question: What interfaces does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer have?
faqs.answer: The instrument has four interfaces. RS232 and USB B allow control through the Hei-PROCESS solution, a front USB A port enables standalone data logging to a USB stick, and a USB C port connects the electric Heidolph e-Lift lab jack.

faqs.question: Can the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer log data?
faqs.answer: Yes, it logs data directly to a USB stick through its front USB A port. No software, computer, or network connection is required.

faqs.question: What is the e-Lift on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The e-Lift is an electric lab jack designed specifically for the instrument. It connects by USB C, carries both power and data, and lowers automatically in response to an error such as overtemperature or a timer expiring.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer detect the stir bar?
faqs.answer: Yes, it has an automatic stir bar detector, which supports optimal mixing and catches a stir bar that has decoupled and stopped turning.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + and the Core Ultimate?
faqs.answer: The Ultimate adds RS232, USB A, USB B and USB C interfaces, standalone data logging, e-Lift compatibility, PRECISE+, dual Pt1000 support, automatic stir bar detection, bidirectional stirring, 0.1 K measurement resolution, and a 350 °C temperature range.

faqs.question: What temperature sensors work with the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: It is compatible with the Pt1000 temperature sensor and the dual Pt1000 sensor. The dual sensor allows individual temperature profiles to be created simultaneously.

faqs.question: What is the maximum permissible load on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The maximum permissible load is 25 kg, including the vessel and its contents.

faqs.question: What is the price of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on the sensors selected, whether the e-Lift lab jack is included, and whether Hei-PROCESS integration is required. Inkarp provides a quotation once your automation, logging, and temperature requirements are confirmed.
