body: Eliminate the need to buy separate pumps for single-channel and multi-channel applications. The Hei-FLOW Core 120 Multi uses one drive that accepts either a single-channel or multi-channel pump head, and you simply change the head to match your workflow as application requirements evolve.

It delivers 0.85 to 861 mL/min with a single-channel head, or 0.005 to 364 mL/min per channel with a multi-channel head, depending on the pump head and tubing selected. Speed is controlled across a 10 to 120 rpm range.
Reverse the pumping direction with a single button, no need to remove the tubing or pump head. There is no display or programming required, which keeps day-to-day operation simple and intuitive.

The drive is built with no user-serviceable internal components, for dependable, low-maintenance performance. It suits straightforward fluid transfer and multi-channel dispensing rather than automated dosing or stored programs.

body: The flow rate this pump delivers depends entirely on which head is fitted, and that's the point. One drive, two very different flow profiles.

With a single-channel head, the pump covers 0.85 to 861 mL/min, a wide enough span for most general transfer work. Fit a multi-channel head instead, and the same drive splits its output across several channels, each running 0.005 to 364 mL/min.
That range makes the multi-channel configuration suited to fine, low-volume work spread across parallel lines, where the single-channel head is built for a single, larger flow.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 120 Multi Channel Peristaltic Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Ultimate 120 Multi is used for precision dosing in pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and food-grade processes, with +/-1% precision and the flexibility to run single-channel or multi-channel pump heads.

faqs.question: What makes this the most precise pump in the Hei-FLOW range?
faqs.answer: Its +/-1% precision is the tightest across the range, tighter than the Ultimate 600's +/-2%, a result of its lower, more tightly controllable 5 to 120 rpm speed range.

faqs.question: Can the Ultimate 120 Multi run both single-channel and multi-channel heads?
faqs.answer: Yes. The drive accepts either configuration, so one instrument covers precise dosing on a single flow or across several parallel channels.

faqs.question: What is the retraction function?
faqs.answer: After each pumping run, the drive briefly reverses to pull the tube back and clear the last drop at the tip, protecting accuracy at the smallest dosed volumes.

faqs.question: Can the pump be operated inside a closed exhaust hood?
faqs.answer: Yes. The optional foot switch lets you start and stop the pump from outside a closed exhaust hood, so hazardous or sensitive media can be handled without reaching into the enclosure.

faqs.question: Can the Ultimate 120 Multi be automated?
faqs.answer: Yes. RS232 and analogue interfaces, 0 to 10 V or 4 to 20 mA, put speed, direction, and start/stop under external control from a PLC or process system.

faqs.question: What is interval dosing?
faqs.answer: A programmable dosing volume paired with a pause time, from 0.1 seconds to 750 hours, so a multi-step dosing sequence runs unattended exactly as specified.

faqs.question: Does the pump include the pump head and tubing?
faqs.answer: No. The pump drive is supplied on its own; the pump head and tubing are selected separately to match your channel configuration and fluid, and Inkarp confirms this before quotation.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Ultimate 120 Multi and the Ultimate 600?
faqs.answer: Both offer full dosing automation, retraction, and RS232 connectivity. The Ultimate 120 Multi adds channel flexibility and reaches tighter +/-1% precision, while the Ultimate 600 covers a higher 24 to 600 rpm speed range for faster conveying, single-channel only.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 120 Multi?
faqs.answer: The part number is 523-52013-00. Inkarp is the authorized distributor for this configuration in India.

faqs.question: What is the price of the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 120 Multi in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on the pump head, tubing, and accessories your application needs. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your precision and channel requirements are confirmed.

sections.subheading: The precision flagship of the Hei-FLOW range
body: The Hei-FLOW Ultimate 120 Multi is built for applications where accurate, repeatable dosing is more important than moving high volumes of liquid. It achieves +/-1% dosing precision with +/-0.5% control accuracy, the highest precision in the Hei-FLOW range.

Use the same drive with either a single-channel or multi-channel pump head to suit different dosing applications. Program and save key parameters, including speed, tubing diameter, flow display, dosing volume, and interval dosing with pauses of up to 750 hours.

Integrate with laboratory software or PLC systems using RS232 and analogue interfaces for automated control of speed, direction, and start/stop functions. The retraction function briefly reverses the pump after each run to minimise droplet formation and improve dosing accuracy.

Operate the pump safely with the optional foot switch, allowing start and stop control from outside a closed exhaust hood. Designed for pharmaceutical, cosmetic, food, and other applications where precise, repeatable dispensing is essential.

sections.title: Channel flow and dosing precision
body: Precision here means two things at once: how tightly the drive holds a set speed, and how tightly repeat doses land against each other. This pump is rated +/-0.5% on the first and +/-1% on the second, both tighter than the equivalent 600 rpm Ultimate.
Channel configuration changes what that precision applies to. A single-channel head puts the full 0.36 to 813 mL/min range and the full +/-1% precision behind one flow.

A multi-channel head splits the drive across several channels, each running 0.005 to 329 mL/min at the same precision, which is what makes parallel, validated dosing across multiple lines possible from one instrument.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-VAC Valve Control Vacuum Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-VAC Valve Control is a vacuum pump built for rotary evaporation, supplying suction to up to three rotary evaporators at once, with an ultimate vacuum of 7 mbar without gas ballast.

faqs.question: What is gas ballast, and when should I use it?
faqs.answer: Gas ballast admits a controlled amount of air into the pump to prevent solvent vapour from condensing inside it. It shifts the ultimate vacuum from 7 mbar to 12 mbar, and is worth engaging when running high vapour loads or condensable solvents.

faqs.question: How many rotary evaporators can this pump run at once?
faqs.answer: Up to three, drawing suction from the same pump simultaneously.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-VAC Valve Control include a secondary condenser?
faqs.answer: No. The secondary condenser is not part of the scope of delivery and needs to be ordered separately for full solvent recovery.

faqs.question: Can this pump be used with a Hei-VAP Expert Control or Ultimate Control evaporator?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a vacuum valve, which is required for that pairing and sold separately.

faqs.question: How is the vacuum controlled on this pump?
faqs.answer: Through valve-operated or manual vacuum controllers, and the pump switches on and off via a switchbox.

faqs.question: What is the pumping speed of the Hei-VAC Valve Control?
faqs.answer: The pump reaches a maximum pumping speed of 2.0 to 2.3 m³/h, depending on the supply frequency.

faqs.question: What voltage does the Hei-VAC Valve Control run on?
faqs.answer: It accepts 100 to 115 V or 230 V supply, at 50 or 60 Hz, within +/-10%.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Valve Control and the RPM-regulated Vario models?
faqs.answer: The Valve Control uses valve-operated or manual vacuum control, while the Vario Station and Vario Control models regulate vacuum through pump speed instead. Inkarp confirms which control method suits your process.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Hei-VAC Valve Control?

body: The Hei-VAC Valve Control provides the vacuum performance needed for reliable solvent evaporation while supporting multiple rotary evaporators from a single pump.
It achieves an ultimate vacuum of 7 mbar without gas ballast for efficient solvent recovery, and operates at 12 mbar with gas ballast, helping protect the pump when handling condensable vapours.

The pump supplies vacuum to up to three rotary evaporators simultaneously, making it suited to shared laboratory workflows, and is compatible with valve-operated and manual vacuum controllers for flexible operation. It is controlled through an external switchbox, keeping operation simple and convenient.

When used with Hei-VAP Expert Control or Ultimate Control rotary evaporators, a vacuum valve is required and supplied separately. A secondary condenser is also available separately to complete the vacuum system.

sections.title: Vacuum depth and pumping speed
body: Two numbers decide how well this pump serves your evaporation: how deep a vacuum it reaches, and how fast it gets there.
Without gas ballast, the pump reaches 7 mbar, the deeper of the two figures and the one to use for straightforward solvent removal where vapour condensation inside the pump isn't a concern.

Switch gas ballast on, and the ultimate vacuum settles at 12 mbar instead, shallower, but the controlled air bleed keeps solvent vapour from condensing inside the pump chamber, which protects it during runs with high vapour loads.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-VAC Valve Tec Vacuum Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-VAC Valve Tec is a compact vacuum pump recommended for solvents with low or medium boiling points, reaching an ultimate vacuum of 12 mbar without gas ballast.

faqs.question: Why is the ultimate vacuum shallower than the Valve Control?
faqs.answer: Low and medium boiling point solvents evaporate at higher pressures and don't need the deeper 7 mbar vacuum the Valve Control reaches. The Valve Tec is sized to match, not to pull harder than the process requires.

faqs.question: What is gas ballast, and when should I use it?
faqs.answer: Gas ballast admits a controlled amount of air into the pump to prevent solvent vapour from condensing inside it. It shifts the ultimate vacuum from 12 mbar to 20 mbar, worth engaging with moderate vapour loads.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-VAC Valve Tec include a secondary condenser?
faqs.answer: No. The secondary condenser is not part of the scope of delivery and needs to be ordered separately for full solvent recovery.

faqs.question: Can this pump be used with a Hei-VAP Expert Control or Ultimate Control evaporator?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a vacuum valve, which is required for that pairing and sold separately.

faqs.question: How compact is the Hei-VAC Valve Tec?
faqs.answer: It measures 338 x 183 x 143 mm and weighs 7.9 kg, a footprint built for a single-station bench rather than a shared multi-evaporator setup.

faqs.question: How is the vacuum controlled on this pump?
faqs.answer: Through valve-operated or manual vacuum controllers.

faqs.question: What voltage does the Hei-VAC Valve Tec run on?
faqs.answer: It accepts 100 to 115 V, 120 V, or 220 to 230 V supply, at 50 or 60 Hz, within +/-10%. The 120 V version includes an additional 2.5 AT fuse.

longForm.heroHook: Built for Low & Medium Boiling Solvents. Nothing More Than You Need.
longForm.heroLead: Not every evaporation process requires a deep vacuum. For low and medium boiling point solvents, the Hei-VAC Valve Tec delivers the vacuum performance you need in a compact, space-saving design. Achieve an ultimate vacuum of 12 mbar without gas ballast or 20 mbar with gas ballast, balancing performance with pump protection when handling condensable vapours. Weighing just 7.9 kg with a compact 338 x 183 x 143 mm footprint, it's ideal for single-station rotary evaporator setups where bench space matters. It is compatible with valve-operated and manual vacuum controllers, and can be paired with Hei-VAP Expert Control and Ultimate Control rotary evaporators using an optional vacuum valve; a secondary condenser is available separately.

sections.subheading: Right-sized vacuum for low and medium boiling point solvents
body: The Hei-VAC Valve Tec is designed for laboratories working with low and medium boiling point solvents, delivering the right level of vacuum without unnecessary complexity.

It achieves an ultimate vacuum of 12 mbar without gas ballast, or 20 mbar with gas ballast, providing the vacuum level needed while helping reduce the risk of bumping and foaming caused by excessive vacuum.

A compact 338 x 183 x 143 mm footprint and 7.9 kg weight make it suited to single rotary evaporator workstations, and it is compatible with valve-operated and manual vacuum controllers for straightforward vacuum control.
When paired with Hei-VAP Expert Control or Ultimate Control rotary evaporators, an optional vacuum valve is required. A secondary condenser is available separately to complete the vacuum system.

sections.title: Vacuum depth and solvent matching
body: The right vacuum pump isn't the one that pulls hardest. It's the one matched to what your solvent actually needs.

Low and medium boiling point solvents evaporate at higher pressures than the deepest vacuums a pump can reach, so the Valve Tec's 12 mbar (without gas ballast) is calibrated to that reality rather than chasing a depth the process doesn't use.
Engage gas ballast and the ultimate vacuum settles at 20 mbar instead, trading a little depth for protecting the pump against condensing vapour during runs with a heavier vapour load.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-VAC Vario Station RPM-Regulated Vacuum Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Vario Station is a stand-alone vacuum pump built for Hei-VAP Core rotary evaporators, using continuous RPM regulation to hold a precise vacuum and prevent bumping and foaming.

faqs.question: What does RPM-regulated mean?
faqs.answer: The pump's motor speed adjusts continuously, from 0 to 2,400 rpm, to hold the target vacuum, rather than running at a fixed speed and using a valve to throttle it.

faqs.question: How does this pump prevent bumping and foaming?
faqs.answer: Continuous speed regulation avoids the sudden pressure steps that a valve-controlled, fixed-speed pump can produce, which is usually what triggers bumping or foaming in the first place.

faqs.question: Does this pump need a separate vacuum controller?
faqs.answer: No. The Vario Station is a fully controllable, stand-alone unit with the vacuum controller built in.

faqs.question: Which rotary evaporators does this pump pair with?
faqs.answer: It's built and recommended for Hei-VAP Core models. For Hei-VAP Expert Control or Ultimate Control evaporators, a valve-controlled Hei-VAC model with a vacuum valve is the typical pairing.

faqs.question: What is gas ballast, and when should I use it?
faqs.answer: Gas ballast admits a controlled amount of air into the pump to prevent solvent vapour from condensing inside it. It shifts the ultimate vacuum from 5 mbar to 7 mbar.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-VAC Vario Station include a secondary condenser?
faqs.answer: No. The secondary condenser is not part of the scope of delivery and needs to be ordered separately.

faqs.question: How deep a vacuum does the Vario Station reach?
faqs.answer: 5 mbar without gas ballast, the deepest ultimate vacuum in the Hei-VAC range.

sections.title: RPM regulation and vacuum precision
body: A valve-controlled pump runs at one speed and bleeds air to hold vacuum. The Vario Station's pump speed is the control itself.

Because the motor can run anywhere in a continuous 0 to 2,400 rpm range, the vacuum it delivers changes smoothly, not in valve-driven steps. That's a direct answer to bumping and foaming, both of which are usually a response to the vacuum moving too fast rather than the vacuum being too deep.
Gas ballast sits alongside this as a second, independent control: engage it, and the ultimate vacuum shifts from 5 mbar to 7 mbar in exchange for protecting the pump from condensing vapour.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-VAC Vario Control RPM-Regulated Vacuum Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Vario Control is built for distilling high boiling point, easily condensable solvents such as DMF or DMSO, reaching a deep enough vacuum to allow distillation at low bath temperatures.

faqs.question: How deep a vacuum does this pump reach?
faqs.answer: 2 mbar without gas ballast, and 4 mbar with gas ballast, the deepest ultimate vacuum in the Hei-VAC range.

faqs.question: Why doesn't gas ballast cost much vacuum depth on this pump?
faqs.answer: The Vario Control is engineered to hold an excellent vacuum even with the gas ballast valve open, which is what makes it suited to easily condensable vapours that need that protection without sacrificing the deep vacuum the process depends on.

faqs.question: Can this pump distill DMF or DMSO?
faqs.answer: Yes. Its deep vacuum lowers the effective boiling point of solvents like these enough to distill them at a low bath temperature, reducing the risk of decomposition.

faqs.question: Which rotary evaporators does this pump pair with?

faqs.question: Does the Hei-VAC Vario Control include a secondary condenser?

faqs.question: Does this pump use RPM regulation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Like the Vario Station, it regulates vacuum through continuous motor speed control rather than a valve.

faqs.question: How compact is the Hei-VAC Vario Control?
faqs.answer: It measures 236 x 167 x 196 mm and weighs 5.4 kg, the lightest and most compact pump in the Hei-VAC range.

longForm.heroHook: Deep vacuum that holds, even with gas ballast open. Built for DMF, DMSO, and solvents like them.
longForm.heroLead: High boiling point solvents are hard to distill safely. Heat the bath too much, and you risk decomposing what you're trying to purify. The Hei-VAC Vario Control solves this with vacuum depth. It reaches 2 mbar without gas ballast, and opening the gas ballast valve barely moves it, still reaching 4 mbar. That's deep enough to distill solvents like DMF or DMSO at low bath temperatures, without decomposing them. It's built for Hei-VAP Expert Control and Ultimate Control evaporators, and connects to a coolant line through a DN 6-8 mm hose.

sections.title: Hei-VAC Vario Control at a glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the Vario Control: how it holds vacuum depth with gas ballast open, what solvents it's built for, the coolant connection it needs, the full technical data, and Inkarp installation and service support.
sections.subheading: Deep vacuum for DMF, DMSO, and similarly demanding solvents
body: The Hei-VAC Vario Control is designed for applications that require deep vacuum and precise control, making it well suited for evaporating high boiling point solvents.

It achieves an ultimate vacuum of 2 mbar without gas ballast and 4 mbar with gas ballast, for efficient solvent evaporation while protecting the pump from condensable vapours. This makes it ideal for high boiling point solvents such as DMF and DMSO, helping reduce boiling temperatures during evaporation.

It uses RPM-regulated motor control to continuously maintain the required vacuum without manual valve adjustment, providing stable vacuum control that helps minimise foaming and bumping throughout the evaporation process.

Recommended for use with Hei-VAP Expert Control and Hei-VAP Ultimate Control rotary evaporators, it has a compact, lightweight design at 5.4 kg for easy integration into laboratory workstations, and includes a DN 6-8 mm coolant connection to support operation with high condensable vapour loads.
Confirmed model: Hei-VAC Vario Control, P/N 591-00141-00. Recommended for Hei-VAP Expert Control and Ultimate Control rotary evaporators. Secondary condenser sold separately.

sections.title: Vacuum depth for high-boiling solvents
body: Distilling a high boiling point solvent safely comes down to one trade: how deep a vacuum you can hold against how much protection you need from the vapour it gives off.

Without gas ballast, the Vario Control reaches 2 mbar, deep enough to bring the effective boiling point of solvents like DMF or DMSO well below their atmospheric value. With gas ballast open, the pump gives up remarkably little of that depth, settling at 4 mbar rather than the steep drop other pumps in the range show.
That's what makes it possible to run condensable, high-boiling solvents with gas ballast protection on, without sacrificing the low bath temperature the whole process depends on.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the DSC200 and DSC600?
faqs.answer: Both share the NEXTA platform and the −150 to 725 °C range. The DSC600 adds three thermocouples to the centric sensor for a 3 s time constant, 0.05 µW noise and 0.1 µW sensitivity — ideal for resolving overlapping or weak transitions. The DSC200 is a 6.5 s centric sensor (0.1 µW noise, 0.2 µW sensitivity) tuned for routine and general research.

faqs.question: What temperature range can it cover?
faqs.answer: −150 °C to 725 °C. The low end depends on the cooling accessory: an electric cooler for moderate sub-ambient work, or an intracooler to reach −150 °C.

faqs.question: Is Real View standard?
faqs.answer: Real View is an option on both models. The camera synchronises sample video with the thermogram; a Polarized Micro unit (20 MP, 50× zoom, 1.2 µm) is available for crystal observation.

faqs.question: Are the software modules extra?
faqs.answer: No. All core analysis modules are supplied as standard. The Data I/O package (barcode, 5000-sample library, CSV/Excel export) is an optional add-on.

faqs.question: Can it do photo-DSC / UV-cure studies?
faqs.answer: Yes, with the PDC-8 (Hg-Xe, 240–550 nm, up to 500 mW/cm²) or PDC-8LED (365/385/395/405 nm, 150 mW/cm²) photochemical calorimeter accessory.

sections.title: 01 — Product Information
body: Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) measures the difference in heat flow between a sample and an inert reference as both follow a controlled temperature program. The resulting thermogram reveals melting, crystallisation, glass transition, curing, oxidation and other events — each with its characteristic temperature and enthalpy. The NEXTA DSC uses a heat-flux design with a highly symmetric sensor to keep baselines flat and transitions sharp.

Two models share the same platform so you can match performance to your work. The DSC200 is a centric heat-flux sensor tuned for routine and general research with a 6.5 s time constant. The DSC600 adds three thermocouples to the centric sensor for the fastest response (3 s time constant) and the lowest noise, resolving closely spaced events that a standard sensor would blur together.
Value in one line: stable baselines, class-leading sensitivity, Real View observation and software that makes method setup and reporting effortless — all backed by Inkarp service in India.

faqs.question: What does 'simultaneous' TG-DSC mean?
faqs.answer: The instrument measures mass change (TG) and heat flow (DSC) from the same sample at the same time, under one atmosphere and one temperature program. This lets you link every mass loss directly to its thermal event — something separate TG and DSC runs cannot do unambiguously.

faqs.question: Which model should I choose?
faqs.answer: STA200 reaches 1,100 °C for general TG-DSC; STA200RV reaches 1,000 °C with Real View included for colour and visual-change studies; STA300 reaches 1,500 °C for ceramics, metals and high-temperature inorganics.

faqs.question: How stable is the balance?
faqs.answer: The horizontal differential balance holds baseline drift and stability below 10 µg, with temperature precision ±0.07 °C and accuracy ±0.2 °C.

faqs.question: Can I control the atmosphere?
faqs.answer: Yes. Integrated mass-flow control with up to four controllers lets you run inert or reactive gases and switch mid-run — for example inert pyrolysis followed by an air burn for carbon-black analysis.

faqs.question: What is Real View?
faqs.answer: A camera that records the sample during the run and links each image to the curve by timestamp, with colour quantification in LAB, CMYK and RGB. It is standard on the STA200RV and optional on the STA200 and STA300.

faqs.question: Is the software extra?
faqs.answer: No. All software modules are included at no extra cost — guidance mode, automated analysis, data management and reporting. The Cp (specific heat) module is an option.

faqs.question: Which standards are built in?
faqs.answer: ASTM E1269, E1641-16, E794-06, E793-06 and ISO 11357-2/3/4, ISO 11358-3, ISO 22768, with conformance to ISO/ASTM/DIN/JIS generally.

sections.title: 01 — Product Information
body: Simultaneous Thermal Analysis (STA) measures thermogravimetry (TG — mass versus temperature) and differential scanning calorimetry (DSC — heat flow versus temperature) at the same time on the same specimen. Because both signals come from one sample under one atmosphere and one temperature program, you can correlate a mass loss directly with its thermal event — for example confirming that an endotherm is dehydration rather than melting, or that an exotherm is oxidation of a specific component.

The NEXTA STA uses a horizontal differential balance for an exceptionally stable baseline (drift and stability < 10 µg) and an innovative furnace design for fast, uniform heating. Choose the model by the top temperature your work needs: STA200 to 1,100 °C, STA200RV (Real View ready) to 1,000 °C, or STA300 to 1,500 °C for ceramics, metals and high-temperature inorganics.
Value in one line: one sample, two measurements, a rock-steady balance and all software included — backed by Inkarp service across India.

sections.title: 01 — Product Information
body: Thermomechanical Analysis (TMA) measures how the dimensions of a material change with temperature under a defined load. A probe rests on the sample and tracks its length as the furnace follows a temperature program; the result is the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE), softening point, glass-transition-related dimensional change, and — with the right probe and load — penetration, creep and stress relaxation. TMA is the method of choice when dimensional stability is the engineering question.

The TMA7000 series pairs a high-sensitivity 0.01 µm displacement system with ultra-low noise, so even the tiny expansion of low-CTE ceramics, glass and electronic laminates is clearly resolved. The TMA7100 covers −170 °C to 600 °C with quartz or metal sample cylinders and three deformation modes; the TMA7300 extends expansion measurement to 1,500 °C with an alumina system for ceramics and high-temperature inorganics.
Value in one line: sub-micron dimensional measurement from cryogenic to 1,500 °C, with NEXTA software and Inkarp service across India.

sections.title: 01 — Product Information
body: Dynamic Mechanical Analysis (DMA) applies a small oscillating force to a sample and measures the resulting deformation. From the amplitude and phase of the response the instrument derives the storage modulus (E′ — elastic stiffness), loss modulus (E″ — viscous dissipation) and loss tangent (tan δ — damping). Running these while scanning temperature or frequency exposes the glass transition, secondary relaxations, cure, softening and the frequency dependence of mechanical properties.

The NEXTA DMA200 uses an LVDT displacement sensor and a spring-mounted drive shaft, so no compressed-air supply is needed. A 20 N maximum force combined with 5×10⁻⁶ N force resolution lets one instrument span from rigid carbon-fibre laminates to soft gels. The Real View camera records the sample throughout the run, linking every image to the curve by timestamp.
Value in one line: one analyzer for stiff and soft materials, with guided method setup, standard TTS/master-curve analysis and Inkarp service across India.

sections.title: 01 — Product Information
body: Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) measures the difference in heat flow between a sample and an inert reference as both follow a controlled temperature program. The resulting thermogram reveals melting, crystallisation, glass transition, curing, oxidation and other events — each with its characteristic temperature and enthalpy. The NEXTA DSC uses a heat-flux design with a highly symmetric sensor to keep baselines flat and transitions sharp.

Two models share the same platform so you can match performance to your work. The DSC200 is a centric heat-flux sensor tuned for routine and general research with a 6.5 s time constant. The DSC600 adds three thermocouples to the centric sensor for the fastest response (3 s time constant) and the lowest noise, resolving closely spaced events that a standard sensor would blur together.
Value in one line: stable baselines, class-leading sensitivity, Real View observation and software that makes method setup and reporting effortless — all backed by Inkarp service in India.

faqs.question: What does 'simultaneous' TG-DSC mean?
faqs.answer: The instrument measures mass change (TG) and heat flow (DSC) from the same sample at the same time, under one atmosphere and one temperature program. This lets you link every mass loss directly to its thermal event — something separate TG and DSC runs cannot do unambiguously.

faqs.question: Which model should I choose?
faqs.answer: STA200 reaches 1,100 °C for general TG-DSC; STA200RV reaches 1,000 °C with Real View included for colour and visual-change studies; STA300 reaches 1,500 °C for ceramics, metals and high-temperature inorganics.

faqs.question: How stable is the balance?
faqs.answer: The horizontal differential balance holds baseline drift and stability below 10 µg, with temperature precision ±0.07 °C and accuracy ±0.2 °C.

faqs.question: Can I control the atmosphere?
faqs.answer: Yes. Integrated mass-flow control with up to four controllers lets you run inert or reactive gases and switch mid-run — for example inert pyrolysis followed by an air burn for carbon-black analysis.

faqs.question: What is Real View?
faqs.answer: A camera that records the sample during the run and links each image to the curve by timestamp, with colour quantification in LAB, CMYK and RGB. It is standard on the STA200RV and optional on the STA200 and STA300.

faqs.question: Is the software extra?
faqs.answer: No. All software modules are included at no extra cost — guidance mode, automated analysis, data management and reporting. The Cp (specific heat) module is an option.

sections.title: 01 — Product Information
body: Simultaneous Thermal Analysis (STA) measures thermogravimetry (TG — mass versus temperature) and differential scanning calorimetry (DSC — heat flow versus temperature) at the same time on the same specimen. Because both signals come from one sample under one atmosphere and one temperature program, you can correlate a mass loss directly with its thermal event — for example confirming that an endotherm is dehydration rather than melting, or that an exotherm is oxidation of a specific component.

The NEXTA STA uses a horizontal differential balance for an exceptionally stable baseline (drift and stability < 10 µg) and an innovative furnace design for fast, uniform heating. Choose the model by the top temperature your work needs: STA200 to 1,100 °C, STA200RV (Real View ready) to 1,000 °C, or STA300 to 1,500 °C for ceramics, metals and high-temperature inorganics.
Value in one line: one sample, two measurements, a rock-steady balance and all software included — backed by Inkarp service across India.

sections.title: 01 — Product Information
body: Thermomechanical Analysis (TMA) measures how the dimensions of a material change with temperature under a defined load. A probe rests on the sample and tracks its length as the furnace follows a temperature program; the result is the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE), softening point, glass-transition-related dimensional change, and — with the right probe and load — penetration, creep and stress relaxation. TMA is the method of choice when dimensional stability is the engineering question.

The TMA7000 series pairs a high-sensitivity 0.01 µm displacement system with ultra-low noise, so even the tiny expansion of low-CTE ceramics, glass and electronic laminates is clearly resolved. The TMA7100 covers −170 °C to 600 °C with quartz or metal sample cylinders and three deformation modes; the TMA7300 extends expansion measurement to 1,500 °C with an alumina system for ceramics and high-temperature inorganics.
Value in one line: sub-micron dimensional measurement from cryogenic to 1,500 °C, with NEXTA software and Inkarp service across India.

sections.title: 01 — Product Information
body: Dynamic Mechanical Analysis (DMA) applies a small oscillating force to a sample and measures the resulting deformation. From the amplitude and phase of the response the instrument derives the storage modulus (E′ — elastic stiffness), loss modulus (E″ — viscous dissipation) and loss tangent (tan δ — damping). Running these while scanning temperature or frequency exposes the glass transition, secondary relaxations, cure, softening and the frequency dependence of mechanical properties.

The NEXTA DMA200 uses an LVDT displacement sensor and a spring-mounted drive shaft, so no compressed-air supply is needed. A 20 N maximum force combined with 5×10⁻⁶ N force resolution lets one instrument span from rigid carbon-fibre laminates to soft gels. The Real View camera records the sample throughout the run, linking every image to the curve by timestamp.
Value in one line: one analyzer for stiff and soft materials, with guided method setup, standard TTS/master-curve analysis and Inkarp service across India.

sections.title: Choosing the Right Mixer Type
body: Not every slurry needs the same mixing mechanism, and choosing the right one can make a real difference in dispersion quality and final electrode performance.

Conventional 2-blade mixers, built around twisted blades, are a dependable choice for general slurry preparation where standard mixing is enough. 3-blade mixers step up from there, adding dedicated dispersion capability that helps break up agglomerated particles rather than just blending them together. For work where particle size drops to the nano scale, where standard blade mixing may not achieve the uniformity needed, thin-film spin mixers are purpose-built for exactly that level of fine dispersion.

faqs.question: What is the NanoPhotometer N60/N50 used for?
faqs.answer: It's a microvolume UV/Vis spectrophotometer for routine nucleic acid and protein quantification across a wide concentration range, without needing dilution.

faqs.question: What's the difference between N60 and N50?
faqs.answer: N60 covers a wider dsDNA and BSA detection range, includes a built-in vortex for sample homogeneity, and offers 21 CFR Part 11 compliance with an IQOQ option; N50 covers a narrower range without these extras.

faqs.question: What is the smallest sample volume it can read?
faqs.answer: 0.3 µl, on both N60 and N50, without dilution.

faqs.question: What concentration ranges does each model detect?
faqs.answer: N60 detects dsDNA from 1 to 16,500 ng/µl and BSA from 0.03 to 478 mg/ml; N50 detects dsDNA from 5 to 7,500 ng/µl and BSA from 0.15 to 217 mg/ml.

faqs.question: Does N50 include the built-in vortex?
faqs.answer: No, the built-in low-vibration vortex is exclusive to N60.

faqs.question: Is either model suitable for regulated lab environments?
faqs.answer: N60 is built GMP, GLP, and GxP ready, with 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and an IQOQ option; this compliance path is specific to N60.

faqs.question: Can the instrument be operated remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes, both N60 and N50 run standalone or remotely from Windows, Mac, Android, or iOS devices.

faqs.question: Can it be used outside a standard lab bench?
faqs.answer: Yes, its compact 20 x 20 x 12 cm footprint and optional battery support use in a glove box, under a fume hood, or in the field.

faqs.question: What support is available if something goes wrong?
faqs.answer: Live application support is available 24 hours a day, 5 days a week, on both models.

faqs.question: What is the price of the NanoPhotometer N60/N50 in India?
faqs.answer: Get in touch and Inkarp will put together a quote based on which model, N60 or N50, fits the lab's requirements.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: NanoPhotometer N60/N50 product information: detection range, sample homogeneity, and remote operation.

body.text: Both models read samples starting at 0.3 µl, scanning the full 200 to 900 nm range without needing dilution first.
N60 detects dsDNA from 1 to 16,500 ng/µl and BSA from 0.03 to 478 mg/ml. N50 covers a narrower range: dsDNA from 5 to 7,500 ng/µl and BSA from 0.15 to 217 mg/ml.
N60 includes a built-in vortex, low vibration and low energy, that improves sample homogeneity directly before measurement. This feature is exclusive to N60.
Both models run standalone or get controlled remotely from Windows, Mac, Android, or iOS.
A compact 20 x 20 x 12 cm footprint, with an optional battery, means either unit moves easily between a glove box, fume hood, open bench, or field location.

Preprogrammed applications cover nucleic acid quantification (DNA, RNA, mRNA, oligos) with 260/280 and 260/230 QC ratios, protein UV with 260/280 QC ratio, fluorescent dye-labeled nucleic acid and protein measurement via absorbance, and potential contaminant identification.
Additional life science applications include OD600, protein assays (Bradford, BCA, Biuret), and kinetics measured directly in a drop.
UV-Vis spectroscopy applications extend to wavelength scanning with a formula editor, wavescan, standard curve generation, concentration calculation, and absorbance ratio analysis.
N60 is built GMP, GLP, and GxP ready, with 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and an IQOQ option, exclusive to this model.
Live application support runs 24 hours a day, 5 days a week, on both models.

body: Both models share the same 0.3 µl minimum sample volume and 200-900 nm scan range, so the real decision comes down to detection range and two extra N60 features.
N60 covers a substantially wider concentration span, dsDNA up to 16,500 ng/µl versus N50's 7,500 ng/µl ceiling, meaningful for labs regularly working with highly concentrated preps.
Only N60 includes the built-in vortex for sample homogenization and the 21 CFR Part 11 compliance path with an IQOQ option, relevant specifically for regulated environments.
N50 remains a fully capable microvolume instrument for labs whose samples reliably fall within its narrower range and who don't need the regulatory documentation path.

items: A sample that isn't fully mixed before measurement introduces variability the instrument can't correct for after the fact. N60's built-in vortex addresses that directly, right before the reading happens.
Low vibration and low energy operation mean the vortex mixes the sample without introducing its own disruption or heat into a small, precious volume.
Better homogeneity translates directly into more accurate, more consistent readings, particularly valuable for viscous or unevenly distributed sample types.

body.text: N30-Touch measures from just 0.3 µl, using Sample Compression Technology to form a capillary film between two scratch-resistant, metal-free quartz surfaces, eliminating surface tension issues and evaporation risk during measurement.
True Path Technology holds two fixed anchor points for exact path length, giving recalibration-free accuracy for the lifetime of the instrument.

Standard detection covers dsDNA from 5 to 1,500 ng/µl and BSA from 0.15 to 44 mg/ml, across a 200 to 650 nm scan range, expandable to 1 to 16,500 ng/µl, 0.03 to 478 mg/ml, and 200 to 900 nm with the Performance Package.
A full scan completes in 2.5 to 4 seconds, with no lamp warm-up time needed thanks to the xenon flash lamp, rated for 10⁹ flashes and up to 10 years of service life.
A 7" color touchscreen with adjustable angle runs the onboard NPOS operating system, with an illuminated sample window and easy-to-clean surfaces, including compatibility with alcohol-based solvents.
Three upgrade packages, Performance, Applications, and Connectivity, let the instrument's capabilities expand later without replacing the hardware.
Over 10,000 units are installed globally, and the NanoPhotometer platform is referenced in more than 15,000 scientific publications worldwide.
The instrument carries CE, IEC 61010-1:2012, and EN 61326-1:2013 certification, with a 12-month warranty as standard.

body.text: Twelve channels run a complete measurement cycle in 20 seconds, scanning the full 200 to 900 nm range without needing to dilute the sample first.
dsDNA reads from 2 to 8,000 ng/µl and BSA from 0.06 to 230 mg/ml, covering a broad concentration span in a single instrument.
A built-in web application server with REST API lets the instrument run standalone or get operated remotely from Windows, Mac, Android, or iOS devices.
A compact 20 x 20 x 12 cm footprint, with an optional battery, means the unit moves easily between a glove box, fume hood, open bench, or field location.

Preprogrammed applications cover nucleic acid quantification (DNA, RNA, mRNA, oligos) with 260/280 and 260/230 QC ratios, protein UV with 260/280 QC ratio, fluorescent dye-labeled nucleic acid and protein measurement via absorbance, and potential contaminant identification.
Additional life science applications include OD600, protein assays (Bradford, BCA, Biuret), and kinetics measured directly in a drop.
UV-Vis spectroscopy applications extend to wavelength scanning with a formula editor, wavescan, standard curve generation, concentration calculation, and absorbance ratio analysis.
The system is built GMP, GLP, and GxP ready, with 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and an IQOQ option available.
Live application support runs 24 hours a day, 5 days a week.

faqs.question: What is the NanoPhotometer C40 used for?
faqs.answer: It's a cuvette-based UV/Vis spectrophotometer offering flexible sample-volume measurement across nucleic acid, protein, and general life-science applications.

faqs.question: What cuvette types does it support?
faqs.answer: Standard and microvolume cuvettes in quartz, glass, or plastic, at an 8.5 mm z-height, without needing manufacturer-specific consumables.

faqs.question: Does the instrument include temperature control?
faqs.answer: Yes, measurement runs temperature controlled across the full 200 to 900 nm scan range.

faqs.question: Can the instrument be operated remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes, a built-in web application server with REST API enables standalone or remote operation from Windows, Mac, Android, or iOS devices.

faqs.question: Is the C40 suitable for regulated lab environments?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's built GMP, GLP, and GxP ready, with 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and an IQOQ option available.

faqs.question: Can it be used outside a standard lab bench?
faqs.answer: Yes, its compact 20 x 20 x 12 cm footprint and optional battery support use in a glove box, under a fume hood, or in the field.

faqs.question: What preprogrammed applications are included?
faqs.answer: Nucleic acid quantification with QC ratios, protein UV analysis, fluorescent dye-labeled sample measurement, contaminant identification, OD600, protein assays, and general UV-Vis spectroscopy tools.

faqs.question: What support is available if something goes wrong?
faqs.answer: Live application support is available 24 hours a day, 5 days a week.

faqs.question: How does C40 differ from NP80?
faqs.answer: C40 is built around cuvette-based measurement with universal material compatibility and temperature control, while NP80 combines microvolume measurement starting at 0.3 µl with cuvette mode on the same instrument.

body.text: C40 is optimized for all standard and microvolume cuvettes, quartz, glass, or plastic, at an 8.5 mm z-height, removing the need for manufacturer-specific consumables.

UV-Vis spectroscopy applications extend to wavelength scanning with a formula editor, wavescan, standard curve generation, concentration calculation, and absorbance ratio analysis.

sections.description: NanoPhotometer N30-Touch product information: sample compression technology, upgrade packages, and touchscreen operation.

body.text: N30-Touch measures from just 0.3 µl, using Sample Compression Technology to form a capillary film between two scratch-resistant, metal-free quartz surfaces, eliminating surface tension issues and evaporation risk during measurement.
True Path Technology holds two fixed anchor points for exact path length, giving recalibration-free accuracy for the lifetime of the instrument.

Standard detection covers dsDNA from 5 to 1,500 ng/µl and BSA from 0.15 to 44 mg/ml, across a 200 to 650 nm scan range, expandable to 1 to 16,500 ng/µl, 0.03 to 478 mg/ml, and 200 to 900 nm with the Performance Package.
A full scan completes in 2.5 to 4 seconds, with no lamp warm-up time needed thanks to the xenon flash lamp, rated for 10⁹ flashes and up to 10 years of service life.
A 7" color touchscreen with adjustable angle runs the onboard NPOS operating system, with an illuminated sample window and easy-to-clean surfaces, including compatibility with alcohol-based solvents.
Three upgrade packages, Performance, Applications, and Connectivity, let the instrument's capabilities expand later without replacing the hardware.
Over 10,000 units are installed globally, and the NanoPhotometer platform is referenced in more than 15,000 scientific publications worldwide.
The instrument carries CE, IEC 61010-1:2012, and EN 61326-1:2013 certification, with a 12-month warranty as standard.

body: Recalibration cycles cost time and, over the life of an instrument, money. N30-Touch's sealed optics remove that recurring task entirely, guaranteeing lifetime accuracy without it.
Sample Compression Technology forms a contained capillary film between two fixed quartz surfaces, removing dependence on surface tension and preventing evaporation throughout the entire measurement.
True Path Technology locks path length in place using two fixed anchor points, so there's no drift to correct for over time, and no costly recalibration visit required.
Durable, inert, scratch-resistant surfaces also mean no reconditioning is needed to keep those surfaces performing accurately.

longForm.heroLead: Manual scrubbing cleans what the brush can physically reach. Blood, saliva, and biofilm settle into the places it can't, the pin joints on forceps, the serrations on scalers, the fine channels inside a handpiece and stay there through cycle after cycle of visible-clean instruments. Ultrasonic cavitation doesn't have that limit. Sound waves at 40 kHz generate microscopic bubbles that collapse against every surface a solution touches, dislodging contamination from geometry a brush never contacts. Three tank sizes — 2.5 L, 5.7 L, and 12 L — cover everything from a single instrument between patients to a full clinical tray, with heating from ambient to 80°C and cycle times adjustable from 5 to 60 minutes to match how dirty the load actually is. Every model ships with a carry handle and a discharge outlet, so moving it and draining it are never the bottleneck. The result reaches deeper than manual cleaning, protects delicate instruments better than abrasive scrubbing does, and gives sterilization a genuinely clean surface to work from.

Built around a 5.6-inch colour touch controller, excellent thermal insulation and a double-sealed door, the TH3-E delivers dependable temperature and humidity reproducibility even under repeated and long-duration testing.
It is available in 200 L and 400 L chamber volumes, making it suitable for stability studies, material testing, shelf-life evaluation and general environmental testing.

sections.title: TH3-E at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the TH3-E Temperature & Humidity Chamber overview, features, applications, specifications, control system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The TH3-E Temperature & Humidity Chamber supports stability testing, quality control, material evaluation and routine environmental testing workflows.
body: The TH3-E from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a basic-type environmental chamber engineered for laboratories that need reliable climate control across a defined set of temperature and humidity conditions.

Its operating concept is focused on the essentials. A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives clear access to set values, actual values and operating status, and the operating process can be reviewed as a graph for easier monitoring.

A simplified direct water line and electric circuit reduce the chance of faults, while a water level check function prompts refilling at the right time, supporting stable operation during longer tests.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service to help users get the most from their environmental testing workflows.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the TH3-E Temperature & Humidity Chamber include a 0–90°C temperature range, 35–85 %RH humidity range, 201 L / 398 L chamber volumes and ± 0.5°C temperature fluctuation.

Specifications tested per DIN 12880 and IEC 60068. Set values based on 40°C / 75 %RH. Permissible ambient: 18–30°C (recommended 20°C), ≤85 %RH, below 2000 m altitude. DI water: pH 6.2–7.2, conductivity < 20 µS/cm.

sections.title: Control and Program Capacity
body: The TH3-E offers programmable multi-segment control with auto-tuning, temperature calibration and 9-zone PID for precise, repeatable testing.
Reliable control with temperature/humidity auto-tuning and temperature calibration.
PID control subdivided into 9 zones for improved stability.
Control and data handling for up to 32 devices via RS-485.
Graph display for convenient status monitoring.
Optional integration with 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper for GMP audits.
sections.disclaimer: Up to 100 segments can be set per pattern; the overall maximum is 2000 segments (not 100 × 100).

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH3-PE Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a compact tabletop environmental chamber built for laboratories that need accurate, repeatable climate control in a small footprint. Available in 25 L, 65 L and 100 L volumes, it covers 0 to 100°C without humidity and 30 to 95 %RH.
features: Compact, Space-Saving Design: A structural design optimised for miniaturisation delivers proven reproducibility and reliability while saving valuable bench space.
Colour Touch Controller: A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives convenient access to settings and lets users check operating status as graphs from the front of the chamber.

External Humidification System: Because humidification is handled externally rather than inside the chamber, the testing space stays clean and maintenance is simpler, with fewer deposits to remove between runs.
Stable Temperature and Humidity: Excellent thermal insulation and sealing ensure stable temperature and humidity reproducibility even under repeated test use.
Double-Sealed Door: The door uses a double-sealed structure for enhanced airtightness, helping maintain set conditions during operation.

Dual Over-Temperature Protection: An electronic advanced over-temperature limiter (A-OT) with an independent sensor works alongside a mechanical backup limiter (B-OT) for safer, more accurate over-temperature shutdown, and surface temperature is kept below 60°C.
Water Level Management: A water level check function, an easy-cap water inlet, and low and empty water level alarms with automatic shut-off help prevent dry operation and keep extended runs safe.
Sample Observation: A tempered glass door with a built-in heating wire and LED lamp allows easy observation of samples, and an LED status indicator identifies chamber condition from a distance.
Easy Maintenance: The refrigerator condenser grill is easy to remove, making it simple to maintain refrigeration efficiency.

Multi-Device Control and Monitoring: RS-232 is supported as standard and RS-485 as an option, allowing up to 32 units to be connected to a PC. Remote monitoring is available through the Lab Companion mobile app with LC Connected (via LC GreenBox).

features: Compact, Space-Saving Design: A structural design optimised for miniaturisation delivers proven reproducibility and reliability while saving valuable bench space.
Colour Touch Controller: A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives convenient access to settings and lets users check operating status as graphs from the front of the chamber.

External Humidification System: Because humidification is handled externally rather than inside the chamber, the testing space stays clean and maintenance is simpler, with fewer deposits to remove between runs.
Stable Temperature and Humidity: Excellent thermal insulation and sealing ensure stable temperature and humidity reproducibility even under repeated test use.
Double-Sealed Door: The door uses a double-sealed structure for enhanced airtightness, helping maintain set conditions during operation.

Dual Over-Temperature Protection: An electronic advanced over-temperature limiter (A-OT) with an independent sensor works alongside a mechanical backup limiter (B-OT) for safer, more accurate over-temperature shutdown, and surface temperature is kept below 60°C.
Water Level Management: A water level check function, an easy-cap water inlet, and low and empty water level alarms with automatic shut-off help prevent dry operation and keep extended runs safe.
Sample Observation: A tempered glass door with a built-in heating wire and LED lamp allows easy observation of samples, and an LED status indicator identifies chamber condition from a distance.
Easy Maintenance: The refrigerator condenser grill is easy to remove, making it simple to maintain refrigeration efficiency.

Multi-Device Control and Monitoring: RS-232 is supported as standard and RS-485 as an option, allowing up to 32 units to be connected to a PC. Remote monitoring is available through the Lab Companion mobile app with LC Connected (via LC GreenBox).

faqs.question: What is the temperature range of the TH3-ME?
faqs.answer: The TH3-ME operates from -20 to 100°C without humidity control.

faqs.question: What is the humidity range?
faqs.answer: The chamber supports 20 to 95 %RH.

faqs.question: Which chamber sizes are available?
faqs.answer: The TH3-ME is available in 25 L (025), 65 L (065) and 100 L (100) volumes.

faqs.question: How is the TH3-ME different from the other tabletop models?
faqs.answer: It is part of a three-model series selected by temperature range: TH3-KE (-40 to 100°C), TH3-ME (-20 to 100°C) and TH3-PE (0 to 100°C). The ME sits in the middle, adding sub-zero reach to -20°C.

faqs.question: What controller does it use?
faqs.answer: It uses a 5.6-inch colour touch display with graph-based status monitoring.

faqs.question: What safety features are included?
faqs.answer: Dual over-temperature protection (A-OT and B-OT), surface temperature kept below 60°C, water level alarms with auto shut-off, door-open warning, overcurrent and short-circuit protection, and compressor overload stop.

faqs.question: How accurate is the control?
faqs.answer: Temperature fluctuation is ±0.3°C and humidity fluctuation is ±1 %RH under the reference conditions.

faqs.question: Can it be placed on a bench and moved easily?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is a compact tabletop unit, and optional 1-stage and 2-stage stands with casters support placement, movement and stacking.

faqs.question: Can multiple units be controlled together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Up to 32 units can be connected to a PC (RS-232 standard, RS-485 optional), with mobile monitoring via the Lab Companion app.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for GMP environments?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can be integrated with 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper software (option).

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help select the right configuration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help select the right chamber size, shelving, water supply, monitoring, stand and software options for your workflow.

faqs.question: What is the temperature range of the TH3-KE?
faqs.answer: The TH3-KE operates from -40 to 100°C without humidity control. The minimum is -35°C at 50 Hz and -40°C at 60 Hz.

faqs.question: What is the humidity range?
faqs.answer: The chamber supports 20 to 95 %RH.

faqs.question: Which chamber sizes are available?
faqs.answer: The TH3-KE is available in 25 L (025), 65 L (065) and 100 L (100) volumes.

faqs.question: How is the TH3-KE different from the other tabletop models?
faqs.answer: It is part of a three-model series selected by temperature range: TH3-KE (-40 to 100°C), TH3-ME (-20 to 100°C) and TH3-PE (0 to 100°C). The KE offers the deepest cold, reaching -40°C (-35°C at 50 Hz).

faqs.question: What controller does it use?
faqs.answer: It uses a 5.6-inch colour touch display with graph-based status monitoring.

faqs.question: What safety features are included?
faqs.answer: Dual over-temperature protection (A-OT and B-OT), surface temperature kept below 60°C, water level alarms with auto shut-off, door-open warning, overcurrent and short-circuit protection, and compressor overload stop.

faqs.question: How accurate is the control?
faqs.answer: Temperature fluctuation is ±0.3°C and humidity fluctuation is ±1 %RH under the reference conditions.

faqs.question: Can it be placed on a bench and moved easily?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is a compact tabletop unit, and optional 1-stage and 2-stage stands with casters support placement, movement and stacking.

faqs.question: Can multiple units be controlled together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Up to 32 units can be connected to a PC (RS-232 standard, RS-485 optional), with mobile monitoring via the Lab Companion app.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for GMP environments?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can be integrated with 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper software (option).

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help select the right configuration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help select the right chamber size, shelving, water supply, monitoring, stand and software options for your workflow.

longForm.heroHook: Compact benchtop temperature and humidity testing with a wide -40 to 100°C range and precise control
longForm.heroLead: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH3-KE Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a compact tabletop environmental chamber built for laboratories that need accurate, repeatable climate control in a small footprint.
heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH3-KE Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a compact tabletop environmental chamber built for laboratories that need accurate, repeatable climate control in a small footprint.

Built around a 5.6-inch colour touch controller, a differentiated external humidification system and a double-sealed door, the TH3-KE delivers stable temperature and humidity reproducibility even under repeated testing.

It is available in 25 L, 65 L and 100 L chamber volumes, and belongs to a three-model tabletop series (KE, ME, PE) selected by temperature range. The KE model covers -40 to 100°C and 20 to 95 %RH, the deepest sub-zero reach of the series, making it well suited to low-temperature stability, material and cold-storage simulation testing where bench space is limited.

sections.title: TH3-KE at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the TH3-KE Temperature & Humidity Chamber overview, features, applications, specifications, control system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The TH3-KE Temperature & Humidity Chamber brings wide-range, precise climate testing to the benchtop for stability, material and routine environmental work.
body: The TH3-KE from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a tabletop environmental chamber engineered for laboratories that need reliable temperature and humidity control without dedicating floor space to a full-size chamber.

Its structural design is optimised for miniaturisation, giving proven reproducibility and reliability in a compact body. A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives clear access to set values, actual values and operating status, which can also be followed as a graph.

A differentiated external humidification system provides stable humidity control and keeps the testing space easy to clean and maintain, while an efficient water supply and recirculation system minimises refilling even during long high-humidity tests.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH-G Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a large-capacity floor-standing environmental chamber built for laboratories that need deep low-temperature and humidity testing at high sample volumes.
features: Dual-Stage Refrigeration: Two-stage compression with R-507 refrigerant and an air-cooled condenser gives the TH-G the cooling power to reach and hold -40°C reliably, even during extended low-temperature runs.

Colour Touch LCD Controller: A 5.7-inch colour interactive touch LCD shows set and present values together, displays operating progress as a graph, includes a built-in SD card drive and supports English, Chinese and Korean.
Microprocessor PID Control: Microprocessor PID control with temperature calibration and automatic tuning provides precise, repeatable temperature and humidity performance.

Advanced Humidity Handling: A humidification tank mounted on the chamber exterior improves low and high humidity control, and a water recycling and filtering system reduces water consumption for longer operation.

Tight Sealing and Insulation: Heat-resistant silicone packing blocks heat leakage and a two-point door latch enhances airtightness, while optimised insulation improves energy efficiency and keeps the surface below 60°C even at maximum temperature.

Water Supply Convenience: A front-mounted water tank and a portable water container make water supply and maintenance easy, water can be supplied during operation, and an optional direct water system supports long-term tests.
Sample Observation: A tempered glass door with a built-in heating wire and energy-efficient LED lighting gives a clear view of samples, and an optional inner glass door improves monitoring.

Mobility and Access: Casters allow easy movement during installation or relocation, and a 50 mm cable port is standard on the left side, with optional additional 50 mm or 80 mm ports for external probes and wiring.

Multi-Unit Control: RS-232 is standard and an optional RS-485 port allows up to 9 units to be connected for simultaneous monitoring and operation, with program setup, backup and recovery via software.

faqs.question: What is the temperature range of the TH-G?
faqs.answer: The TH-G operates from -40 to 100°C without humidity control (-35°C at 50 Hz, -40°C at 60 Hz).

faqs.question: What is the humidity range?
faqs.answer: The chamber supports 25 to 95 %RH.

faqs.question: Which chamber sizes are available?
faqs.answer: The TH-G is available in 800 L (TH-G-800), 1000 L (TH-G-1000) and 1450 L (TH-G-1500) volumes.

faqs.question: What refrigeration system does it use?
faqs.answer: A mechanical dual-stage refrigeration system with an air-cooled condenser and R-507 refrigerant.

faqs.question: What controller does it use?
faqs.answer: A 5.7-inch colour interactive touch LCD with graph display, a built-in SD card drive and trilingual support (English / Chinese / Korean).

faqs.question: What safety features are included?
faqs.answer: A key door lock, automatic shut-off after an overheat alarm, low and empty water level alarms, power supply leakage breaker, over-current protection, open-door alarm, and a surface kept below 60°C.

faqs.question: How accurate is the control?
faqs.answer: Temperature fluctuation is ±0.3°C and humidity fluctuation is ±1.0 %RH (±2.0 %RH on the TH-G-1500) at the reference conditions.

faqs.question: Can multiple units be controlled together?
faqs.answer: Yes. RS-232 is standard and an optional RS-485 port allows up to 9 units to be connected for monitoring and operation.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for long-term testing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Water recycling, a front water tank, water supply during operation and an optional direct water system support long-term tests.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help select the right configuration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help select the right chamber size, shelving, water supply, monitoring and recording options for your workflow.

heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH-G Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a large-capacity floor-standing environmental chamber built for laboratories that need deep low-temperature and humidity testing at high sample volumes.

Built around a 5.7-inch colour touch LCD controller, a dual-stage refrigeration system and a two-point sealed door, the TH-G delivers stable, reproducible conditions across long-duration low-temperature tests.
It is available in 800 L, 1000 L and 1450 L chamber volumes, covering -40 to 100°C and 25 to 95 %RH, making it suited to large-scale stability, material, cold-storage and environmental testing.

body: The TH-G from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a floor-standing environmental chamber engineered for laboratories that need reliable temperature and humidity control across large sample volumes and demanding low-temperature conditions.

A dual-stage mechanical refrigeration system with an air-cooled condenser reaches down to -40°C, while a 5.7-inch colour touch LCD gives clear access to set values, actual values and operating status, which can also be followed as a graph, with a built-in SD card drive and trilingual support.

A humidification tank fitted to the chamber exterior, plus a water recycling and filtering system, provides stable low and high humidity control and reduces water consumption during long-term testing.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH-KH Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a floor-standing environmental chamber built for laboratories that need deep sub-zero testing down to -70°C alongside humidity control.
features: Dual-Stage Refrigeration: Cascade two-stage compression with R-507 and R-23 refrigerants and an air-cooled condenser gives the TH-KH the cooling power to reach and hold -70°C reliably, even during extended low-temperature runs.

Colour Touch LCD Controller: A 5.7-inch colour interactive touch LCD shows set and present values together, displays operating progress as a graph, includes a built-in SD card drive and supports English, Chinese and Korean.
Microprocessor PID Control: Microprocessor PID control with temperature calibration and automatic tuning provides precise, repeatable temperature and humidity performance.

Advanced Humidity Handling: A humidification tank mounted on the chamber exterior improves low and high humidity control, and a water recycling and filtering system reduces water consumption for longer operation.

Tight Sealing and Insulation: Heat-resistant silicone packing blocks heat leakage and a two-point door latch enhances airtightness, while optimised insulation improves energy efficiency and keeps the surface below 60°C even at maximum temperature.

Water Supply Convenience: A front-mounted water tank and a portable water container make water supply and maintenance easy, water can be supplied during operation, and an optional direct water system supports long-term tests.
Sample Observation: A tempered glass door with a built-in heating wire and energy-efficient LED lighting gives a clear view of samples, and an optional inner glass door improves monitoring.

Mobility and Access: Casters allow easy movement during installation or relocation, and a 50 mm cable port is standard on the left side, with optional additional 50 mm or 80 mm ports for external probes and wiring.

Multi-Unit Control: RS-232 is standard and an optional RS-485 port allows up to 9 units to be connected for simultaneous monitoring and operation, with program setup, backup and recovery via software.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH4-ICH Pharmaceutical Stability Test Chamber is designed specifically to conduct ICH Q1A(R2) long-term stability testing and ICH Q1B Option 2 photostability testing.
features: 7-Inch Integrated Controller: A 7-inch touch display controls temperature, humidity, illuminance and UV together, with graph-based monitoring and internal plus USB data storage.

ICH Q1B Photostability Lighting: VIS and UV-A light sources compliant with ICH Q1B Option 2 are independently controlled; a specially manufactured filter and optimised lamp arrangement deliver uniform illuminance across the vertical area.

Light Exposure Measurement: Light sensors measure actual and accumulated VIS and UV-A exposure, display accumulated time and remaining time to target, and trigger an auto lamp-off when each preset target is reached.

Stable Long-Term Stability Testing: An energy-saving inverter refrigeration system with PID control holds stable temperature and humidity, maintains the same control range regardless of lamp on/off status, and runs continuously without defrosting even at 5°C.

Level-Checker Water Monitoring: A Level-Checker system provides real-time water level monitoring, and an external humidification system improves stable humidity control while keeping the test space clean and easy to maintain.

Uniform Conditions Under Load: Stable horizontal airflow ensures consistent temperature and humidity even with large sample loads, and excellent insulation and sealing give reproducible conditions across repeated long-term testing.
Sample Access and Observation: An inner glass door of tempered glass allows internal observation and sample access during testing, and a sliding shelf makes sample handling convenient.

Multi-Zone PID and Communication: PID control divided into 16 zones enables precise, stable control; RS-232 is standard and RS-485 optional, with dedicated PC monitoring software for up to 4 units and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox.

Data Integrity and Compliance: Temperature, humidity, VIS and UV-A calibration functions support reliable control, and the chamber supports LC DataKeeper, a 21 CFR Part 11-compliant data integrity software, for GMP audit readiness.

heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH4-ICH Pharmaceutical Stability Test Chamber is designed specifically to conduct ICH Q1A(R2) long-term stability testing and ICH Q1B Option 2 photostability testing.

Built around a 7-inch touch display that controls temperature, humidity, illuminance and UV together, the TH4-ICH delivers stable, documented conditions for pharmaceutical stability and photostability workflows.
It is available in two 400 L models: the TH4-ICH-400 with a VIS and UV-A photostability lighting system for ICH Q1B, and the TH4-ICH-400A for temperature and humidity stability testing.

body: The TH4-ICH from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a stability chamber engineered for pharmaceutical laboratories that need to run ICH-compliant stability and photostability studies in a single unit.

An energy-saving inverter refrigeration system with PID control maintains stable temperature and humidity while reducing energy use, and enables continuous operation without defrosting even during 5°C long-term stability testing.

For photostability, VIS and UV-A light sources compliant with ICH guidelines are independently controlled, with light sensors measuring actual and accumulated exposure and an auto lamp-off function when the target is reached.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) Plant Growth Chambers are designed to provide optimal photosynthesis conditions, combining precise temperature, illumination and humidity control for reliable, reproducible plant growth studies.
features: Uniform Illumination System: Uniform luminescence distribution with a broad spread of side lamps hastens plant growth, and high-intensity upper lamps on the GC-1000 give light-efficient growth with a low thermal load.

Low Heat Load Design: A unique construction minimises heat increase from surrounding lamps, a tempered glass door blocks heated air from the lamps, and the GC-1000TLH exhausts heated air through upper vent holes.
Stable, Long-Lasting Lighting: High-frequency electronic ballast lamps provide stable, long-lasting lighting for consistent, repeatable illumination across long growth runs.
Precise Temperature Control: Microprocessor PID control with temperature calibration and automatic tuning holds temperature to ±0.1°C fluctuation for reproducible growth conditions.
Programmable Growth Profiles: 10-step programmable temperature, humidity and illumination profiles with up to 999 repeat cycles support day/night cycling and seasonal simulation.
Optional CO2 Enrichment: An optional CO2 control system up to 5,000 ppm with an NDIR CO2 sensor supports photosynthesis and enrichment studies.

Dual-Sealed Observation Door: An inner glass door with silicone sealing and an external door with magnetic sealing provide dual airtight packing, and a wide inner tempered glass door allows clear observation without disturbing the chamber environment.
Flexible Loading: Adjustable shelf levels allow tall plants to be grown inside the chamber, and the door is designed to open smoothly to minimise damage to plants.

Easy Water and Filter Maintenance: A front water tank with a water-level bar, water supply during operation, an adjustable tank position on the GC-300TLH, and a detachable condenser air filter make maintenance simple. The refrigerant is CFC-free.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) RS-2 Funnel Shaker is designed for efficient mixing of samples in separatory funnels, combining double-sided vertical reciprocation with an adjustable tilt of up to 20 degrees for enhanced mixing efficiency.
features: Vertical and Tilted Reciprocation: Vertical reciprocation up to 300 rpm with a 40 mm stroke, plus an adjustable shake tilt from 0 to 20 degrees, achieves high mixing efficiency even at low rpm.
Durable BLDC Motor: A BLDC motor provides outstanding durability, a lower noise level and enhanced stability compared with competitor products that use DC motors.
One-Touch Funnel Handling: A one-touch mechanism allows swift, easy funnel installation and removal, so samples can be loaded and unloaded quickly and comfortably.
Stable, Low-Vibration Design: A stable centre-of-gravity design minimises vibration even with one-sided sample installation or high-speed tilted movement.
High Funnel Capacity: The RS-2 fits cone or cylindrical funnels up to 2 L, and can hold up to ten <0.5 L funnels, six 0.5-1 L funnels or four 2 L funnels, with up to five holders per side.
Tilted Controller: A controller with the display panel set at a 20-degree angle gives good visibility even from floor level, with an error alarm and status indicator for easy operation.
Safety Features: Safety devices protect the user and the experiment, including overcurrent protection and automatic resumption of operation when power returns after a failure.
Flexible Scheduling: A count-down timer up to 999 hr 59 min and an optional LC Connected mobile monitoring network give flexibility in experiment planning.

faqs.question: What is the RS-2 Funnel Shaker used for?
faqs.answer: It is used to mix samples in separatory funnels, mainly for liquid-liquid extraction and sample preparation.

faqs.question: What motion does it use?
faqs.answer: Double-sided vertical reciprocation combined with an adjustable tilt from 0 to 20 degrees.

faqs.question: What is the speed range?
faqs.answer: 30 to 300 rpm in vertical motion and 30 to 250 rpm in inclined motion, with a 40 mm stroke.

faqs.question: How many funnels can it hold?

faqs.question: What funnels are compatible?
faqs.answer: Cone or cylindrical separatory funnels up to 2 L. Funnels are not supplied.

faqs.question: What motor does it use?
faqs.answer: A BLDC motor, which offers better durability, lower noise and improved stability than DC-motor designs.

faqs.question: What is the maximum load?
faqs.answer: Up to 5 kg per side; the load should be balanced across both sides.

faqs.question: What safety features are included?
faqs.answer: Overcurrent protection and automatic resumption of operation after a power failure, plus an error alarm and status indicator.

faqs.question: Can it be monitored remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes, optionally via the LC Connected mobile network using LC GreenBox.

faqs.question: How much space does it need?
faqs.answer: 600 x 460 x 470 mm, or 900 x 460 x 670 mm allowing for the 20-degree tilt.

faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help with holder selection, loading, installation and user training.

faqs.question: What motion does the OS Series use?
faqs.answer: Dual-action shaking with both orbital and reciprocating motion (the OS-4000 offers orbital to 500 rpm and reciprocal to 450 rpm).

faqs.question: What is the speed range?
faqs.answer: 20 to 500 rpm, with ±1 rpm or ±1% speed stability.

faqs.question: What amplitude options are available?
faqs.answer: 19.1 mm default, with 12.7 mm available on the OS-2000 and 25.4 mm available on the OS-3000 and OS-4000.

faqs.question: What is the largest flask it can hold?
faqs.answer: Up to 6 L on the OS-3000 and OS-4000 (the OS-2000 handles up to 1 L).

faqs.question: How much load can it take?
faqs.answer: Up to 16 kg on the OS-2000, 18 kg on the OS-3000 and 21 kg on the OS-4000 at 300 rpm; up to 500 rpm at lighter loads.

faqs.question: What happens if I overload it?
faqs.answer: A best-effort run function intelligently manages rpm to keep the platform shaking even beyond rated capacity.

faqs.question: Does the platform stop in a fixed position?
faqs.answer: Yes. It stops where it starts, which helps with automated dosing or sampling.

faqs.question: What motor does it use?
faqs.answer: A maintenance-free BLDC motor for smooth, quiet, uniform and powerful shaking.

faqs.question: Can it be monitored remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes, via RS-232, USB, and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring using LC GreenBox.

faqs.question: Do I need a platform and clamps?
faqs.answer: Yes. A universal platform is sold separately, and clamps, racks or holders are chosen for your vessels.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help with platform and clamp selection?

heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) OS Series Dual Action Shakers are benchtop platform shakers that combine orbital and reciprocating motion for flexible, efficient mixing of flasks, funnels, tubes and microplates.
Built around a maintenance-free BLDC motor and a low-profile, low-vibration design, the OS Series delivers smooth, quiet, powerful shaking up to 500 rpm even under heavy workloads.
