sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the OS Series Dual Action Shaker overview, features, applications, specifications, control system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The OS Series Dual Action Shakers provide flexible orbital and reciprocating platform shaking for culturing, mixing, extraction and sample preparation.
body: The OS Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of benchtop platform shakers engineered for laboratories that need versatile, reliable shaking across a wide range of vessels.

Dual-action motion lets users switch between orbital and reciprocating shaking, while a wide speed range up to 500 rpm and selectable amplitude suit everything from gentle mixing to vigorous culturing.

Its maintenance-free BLDC motor runs quietly and reliably with little upkeep, and an intelligent load-handling function keeps the platform moving steadily even when a run is loaded beyond the rated capacity.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) SKC-7000 Series Program Shakers are programmable open-air orbital platform shakers built around an innovative triple-cam shaking mechanism that offers reliable performance across a wide speed range.
features: Programmable Multi-Step Operation: Progressive program operation supports up to 20 patterns with up to 20 segments each, with forward and backward shaking and pause steps timed from 1 minute to 99 hr 59 min.

Triple-Cam Direct-Drive System: An ideal DD (Direct Drive) brushless motor and triple cam system support heavy loads with high torque at high speed, quiet running, smooth rotation and maintenance-free operation.
High Speed with PID Control: Microprocessor PID control maintains a constant speed and delivers a competitive high speed up to 500 rpm, with a wide speed range even under heavy workloads.

Best-Effort Run and Auto Adjustment: A best-effort run function keeps the platform shaking even beyond rated capacity, and automatic speed adjustment responds to unbalanced load placement, unusual vibration or external shock.
Smooth Start and Stop: Smooth acceleration and deceleration control, with smooth start and smooth stop functions, prevents chemical spills from flasks or test tubes.
Exceptional Low-Profile Design: At only 12 cm from the bottom to the platform, the low-profile design minimises vibration and sliding caused by high-speed shaking and keeps loading comfortable.
Repeatable Positioning: The platform stops where it starts, so repetitive tasks are easy and the fixed stop position benefits automated dosing or sampling.
Slide-Type Platform Option: An easy-exchange slide-type universal platform (optional) reduces physical fatigue when handling heavy-load samples.

Clear VFD Display and Safety: A user-friendly control panel with a bright VFD display, durable membrane touch switch and control knob is complemented by a shaking-speed deviation alarm and overcurrent protection.

Sample Preparation: Suitable for multi-step sample preparation across flasks, tubes and microplates.

Built around a maintenance-free BLDC motor and a chemical-resistant polypropylene body, the CMS-350 delivers smooth, quiet, uniform shaking and is light enough to use inside cold rooms or incubators.

body: The CMS-350 from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a compact orbital shaker engineered for laboratories that need gentle, reliable shaking in a small, portable footprint.
A real-time responsive speed-control knob and a low, gentle 13 mm orbit make it well suited to low-rpm-sensitive work such as hybridization, immunocytochemistry and gel staining or destaining.
A maintenance-free BLDC motor gives smooth, quiet, uniform and yet powerful shaking, and the compact, lightweight design (only 8 kg) allows use inside cold rooms and incubators.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) CRS-350 Rocking Shaker combines an adjustable tilt angle with precise digital speed control to deliver the desired rocking motion for gentle mixing and staining.
features: Adjustable Tilt Angle: An easy-to-adjust tilt angle from 7 to 13 degrees lets users set the rocking motion to suit the sample and vessel.
Precise Digital Speed Control: Microprocessor PID control with digital speed control from 5 to 100 rpm provides gentle to vigorous motion with smooth, quiet, uniform and powerful shaking.
Three Removable Trays: Three removable tray options - a standard dimpled mat plus an optional rubber mat and universal harness - allow easy transport of well-plates, test tubes and other vessels.
Wide Vessel Compatibility: The shaker accommodates a variety of test tube sizes, beakers, vials, micro-well plates, culture dishes and plastic or glass trays.
VFD Display and Timer: A vivid, colourful VFD with a touch-sensitive keypad and a one-touch timer (1 minute to 99 hr 59 min) make time-dependent rocking simple.
Compact, Portable Design: A compact, lightweight design (only 3.7 kg) allows use inside cold rooms or incubators.
Chemical-Resistant Body and Safety: The polypropylene body is highly chemical-resistant and easy to clean, and a self-diagnostic function and overcurrent protection safeguard the shaker.

Cell and Tissue Work: Used for delicate cell and tissue applications inside incubators or cold rooms.
Gentle Mixing: Used for gentle mixing of tubes, beakers, vials and trays.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) CBS-350 Heating Shaker combines precise temperature control with high-speed orbital mixing, and its interval-mix function in program mode can be set to match each user's experimental conditions.
features: Combined Heating and Mixing: The CBS-350 heats from ambient +5 to 100°C and mixes orbitally at high speed, combining a heating block and shaker in one instrument.
Wide High-Speed Range: Microprocessor PID control ensures consistent, precise shaking across a wide 150 to 1500 rpm range (block-dependent), with a 2 mm orbit suited to tubes and plates.
Programmable Interval Mix: An interval-mix function continuously switches between shaking and phasing, and can be set precisely in program mode to match each experimental condition.
Program Memory: A memory function stores relevant parameters - temperature, rpm and time - for each program step, with up to 10 programs of up to 10 steps each.
Dual Wait-Timer Modes: Advanced dual wait on/off timer modes let the user start the timer immediately, or only after the set temperature is reached.
Optimal Heat Transfer: A tight coupling design between the main body and corrosion-resistant anodized aluminum blocks achieves optimal, uniform heat transfer.
Automatic Temperature Calibration: Automatic temperature calibration keeps readings accurate, displayed on a bright VFD with 0.1°C resolution and responsive touch buttons.

Low-Vibration Design and Safety: A low-profile design with rubber feet minimises vibration and noise, and safety features include over-temperature protection on the heating plate and PCB, current-limit protection, a self-diagnostic function and a chemical-resistant polypropylene body.

longForm.heroLead: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) IST Series Incubated Shakers (Tabletop) are digital incubating and refrigerating benchtop shakers that combine precise temperature control with high-speed orbital shaking for culturing and mixing.
heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) IST Series Incubated Shakers (Tabletop) are digital incubating and refrigerating benchtop shakers that combine precise temperature control with high-speed orbital shaking for culturing and mixing.

Built around microprocessor PID control, a maintenance-free BLDC motor and an intuitive touch-screen LCD, the IST Series delivers stable temperature, uniform airflow and smooth, quiet, powerful shaking.
Four models - IST-3075, IST-3075R, IST-4075 and IST-4075R - offer 53 L or 83 L chambers, with the R models adding refrigeration down to ambient -15°C using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant.

sections.title: IST Series Incubated Shaker at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the IST Series Incubated Shaker (Tabletop) overview, features, applications, specifications, control system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The IST Series Incubated Shakers combine precise incubation, optional refrigeration and high-speed orbital mixing in a benchtop unit.
body: The IST Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of benchtop incubated shakers engineered for laboratories that need controlled-temperature culturing with reliable high-speed shaking.

An orbital motion up to 500 rpm with a 19.1 mm amplitude, combined with ±0.1°C temperature control, suits microbial and cell culturing, while a high-velocity fan and air-tight silicone door seal give uniform temperature distribution and rapid recovery after opening.
The refrigerated R models add cooling to ambient -15°C using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant, and a maintenance-free BLDC motor with smooth start/stop provides quiet, spill-free operation.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the IST Series include an ambient +5 to 80°C range (R models to ambient -15°C), 20 to 500 rpm orbital shaking and 53 or 83 L chambers.

Temperature accuracy is ±0.1°C fluctuation and ±0.5°C variation at 37°C in flask. Speed accuracy is ±1% of set speed above 100 rpm and ±1 rpm at or below 100 rpm. R models add refrigeration with R-600a. A universal platform is sold separately.

Microprocessor PID control with three-point calibration and auto-tuning.

Digital timer from 1 minute to 999 hr 59 min.
Built-in RS-232 and USB ports; optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) ISF Series Incubated Shakers (Floor) deliver large capacity - up to five 6 L flasks - and heavy-workload shaking with rapid heating and cooling, in a robust floor-standing design built for years of trouble-free service.
features: Direct-Drive Triple-Cam Mechanism: An ideal DD (Direct Drive) brushless motor and triple cam system support heavy loads with high torque at high speed, quiet running, smooth rotation and maintenance-free operation.

Best-Effort Run and Auto Adjustment: A best-effort run function intelligently manages rpm to keep shaking even beyond capacity, and automatic speed adjustment responds to unbalanced loads, unusual vibration or external shock.

Precise Temperature Control: Microprocessor PID control with three-point calibration and automatic tuning holds temperature to ±0.1°C fluctuation at 37°C in flask, and a triple independent temperature monitor system adds protection.
Optional Refrigeration: R models cool to ambient -20°C (minimum +4°C) using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant; a defrost function is recommended below 25°C.

Uniform Temperature Distribution: A high-velocity fan ensures uniform temperature distribution and rapid thermal recovery after opening, with an air-tight silicone door seal and a lockable door for safe sample storage.
Smooth Start and Stop: Smooth acceleration and deceleration, with smooth start and smooth stop, prevents chemical spills from flasks or test tubes.

Easy Sample Monitoring and Access: A transparent top viewing window with bright LED lamps, gently inclined toward the front, allows clear observation without affecting the chamber, and gas-spring lid supports give smooth opening and closing. An easy-access drain with a quick-disconnect valve simplifies clean-up, and sturdy foot casters ease mobility.

Connectivity and Compliance: An intuitive touch-screen LCD, a digital timer to 999 hr 59 min, built-in RS-232 and USB ports, optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox, and optional 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper support operation, data collection and GMP audits.

Safety: Safety features include auto-run after power interruption, temperature and speed deviation alarms, overcurrent protection, a triple independent temperature monitor system (deviation alarm, electronic limiter and mechanical over-temperature limiter), a corrosion-resistant stainless-steel interior and CFC-free refrigerant on R models.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) ISS Series Incubated Shakers (Multi-Stackable) are large-capacity, triple-stackable incubated shakers that let laboratories multiply throughput in the same floor footprint, with reliable temperature control and stable shaking of high-load samples.
features: Triple-Stackable Design: Up to three large-capacity units stack using exclusive stacking kits and stands, saving bench and floor space while multiplying throughput.
Three Operating Modes: Each unit runs in Temperature and Shaking, Temperature only, or Shaking only mode, so different protocols can share a stack.

Durable Direct-Drive Motor: A direct-drive motor with outstanding durability - backed by a 5-year motor warranty - delivers minimized-vibration shaking, and a patented shaking structure (KR 10-1678160) keeps high-load samples stable.

Dual Over-Temperature Protection: An electronic advanced over-temperature limiter (A-OT) with an independent precision sensor and controller, plus a conventional backup mechanical limiter (B-OT), provide reliable protection even during electronic faults.

Smart Self-Diagnosis and Connectivity: Real-time self-diagnostics monitor rpm and temperature against setpoints and raise alarms, the unit restarts automatically after power recovery, a controller-lock prevents accidental changes, and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring (via LC GreenBox) and 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper support remote oversight and GMP audits.

faqs.question: What makes the ISS Series different?
faqs.answer: It is triple-stackable, so up to three large-capacity units share one floor footprint to multiply throughput.

faqs.question: What is the temperature range?
faqs.answer: Ambient +10 to 80°C on standard models, and ambient -20 (minimum +4) to 80°C on the refrigerated R models.

faqs.question: What is the speed range?
faqs.answer: 30 to 400 rpm on the ISS-7100 and 30 to 300 rpm on the ISS-7200 as single units; stacked units run at reduced maximum speeds.

faqs.question: Why is the stacked speed lower?
faqs.answer: Stacking limits maximum speed to keep the stack stable - 250 rpm (7100) or 200 rpm (7200) when stacked.

faqs.question: What are the three operating modes?
faqs.answer: Temperature and Shaking, Temperature only, or Shaking only, selectable per unit.

faqs.question: What motor does it use?
faqs.answer: A durable direct-drive motor with a 5-year motor warranty and a patented low-vibration shaking structure.

faqs.question: What do the R models add?
faqs.answer: Refrigeration to ambient -20°C using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant.

faqs.question: How is it protected against over-temperature?
faqs.answer: A dual system: an electronic advanced limiter (A-OT) with independent sensor and a mechanical backup limiter (B-OT).

faqs.question: Is it suitable for GMP environments?
faqs.answer: Yes. It integrates with 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper (option) and has smart self-diagnosis.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help plan and install a stack?

longForm.heroHook: Space-efficient double-stackable incubated and refrigerated shakers for bench or floor
longForm.heroLead: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) ISS-3075/4075 Series Incubated Shakers (Stackable) are specially designed to be double-stacked on the floor or placed on lab benches for space saving, while delivering precise temperature control and high-speed shaking.
heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) ISS-3075/4075 Series Incubated Shakers (Stackable) are specially designed to be double-stacked on the floor or placed on lab benches for space saving, while delivering precise temperature control and high-speed shaking.

Three operating modes - Temperature and Shaking, Temperature, or Shaking - a low-vibration shaking structure and an internal power outlet make these compact incubated shakers flexible and convenient for a wide range of experimental conditions.

Four models - ISS-3075, ISS-3075R, ISS-4075 and ISS-4075R - offer 80 L or 150 L chambers with a 19.1 mm orbit, and the R models add refrigeration to ambient -20°C using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant.

body: The ISS-3075/4075 Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of space-efficient stackable incubated shakers engineered for laboratories that need controlled-temperature shaking without dedicating a lot of bench or floor area.

Two units can be double-stacked using exclusive stacking kits, or a unit can sit on the bench, and three operating modes - Temperature and Shaking, Temperature only, or Shaking only - let each unit match its protocol.

An orbital motion up to 500 rpm (19.1 mm amplitude) with ±0.1°C temperature control, a low-vibration structure and an internal power outlet make these units flexible, and R models add cooling to ambient -20°C using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Applications
sections.description: From space-constrained microbial culturing to parallel small-batch work, the ISS-3075/4075 Series suits microbiology, molecular biology, biotechnology and pharmaceutical laboratories.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the ISS-3075/4075 Series include an ambient +5 to 80°C range (R to ambient -20°C), 20 to 500 rpm shaking and 80 or 150 L chambers.

Standard models control from 5°C above ambient (15 to 40°C) to 80°C; R models control from ambient down to -20°C, lowest 4°C. Stacked units run at reduced maximum speed (20 to 250 rpm). Use the defrost function below 25°C. Speed accuracy is ±1 rpm at or below 100 rpm and ±1% above 100 rpm. A universal platform is sold separately, and exclusive stacking kits are required to stack two units.

sections.title: Control and Operation
body: The ISS-3075/4075 Series offers colour touch-screen PID control with three modes, timer, self-diagnosis and optional compliance software.
Microprocessor PID control with temperature auto-tuning and calibration.
Three operating modes: Temperature and Shaking, Temperature, or Shaking.
Intuitive colour touch display with controller-lock and full status/error display.
Countdown timer to 999 hr 59 min; auto-restart after power recovery.
Optional LC Connected mobile monitoring (LC GreenBox) and LC DataKeeper (21 CFR Part 11).

heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) BW3-G Series Heating Baths (General) are outstanding temperature-control water baths built for diverse applications, from routine warming to critical research, quality control and regulatory tests.

Built around microprocessor PID control with automatic tuning and calibration, the BW3-G Series adds dual wait-timer modes, programming functions and a three-temperature memory in a corrosion-resistant stainless-steel body.
Three bath volumes - BW3-05G (3.5 L), BW3-10G (11.5 L) and BW3-20G (20 L) - heat from ambient +7 C to 100 C and accept water, silicone and other bath fluids.

sections.subheading: The BW3-G Series Heating Baths provide precise, programmable temperature control for routine and regulated work.
body: The BW3-G Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of general-purpose heating water baths engineered for laboratories that need dependable, precise warming across many applications.

Microprocessor PID control with automatic tuning and calibration is paired with dual wait-timer modes, programming functions and a three-temperature memory, making it well suited to critical research, quality control and regulatory testing.
A corrosion-resistant stainless-steel construction accepts water, silicone and other bath fluids, and an isolated heater and sensor design protects users and samples from direct contact.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) VB-G Series Heating Baths (Visible) deliver ultra-precise temperature control with excellent visibility, ideal for viscometry and other applications that need a clear view of the sample.
features: Ultra-Precise PID Control: Microprocessor PID control with automatic tuning and calibration holds temperature to +/- 0.1 C at 50 C across an ambient +5 to 150 C range.
Vane-Type Stirrer Circulation: A vane-type stirrer with strong circulation power achieves optimal temperature equilibrium throughout the bath.
High-Resolution Display: Easy-readout digital LED displays show 0.01 C resolution from 0 to 99.9 C and 0.1 C resolution from 100 to 150 C.
Clear Through-View Windows: Double tempered safety-glass windows on the front and rear give clear visibility (for operation from 10 C, use an optional cooling circulator).
Viscometer and Thermometer Ports: Ø51 mm holes accept glass capillary viscometer tubes, and a Ø12.6 mm hole holds a thermometer.
Dual Timer and Memory: Dual wait on/off timer modes (1 minute to 99 hr 59 min) and a memory function for up to three frequently used temperatures simplify repeated work.
Isolated, Low-Turbulence Design: An isolated design separates the agitator, heater and sensor with a baffle plate to minimise turbulence and protect users and samples from direct contact.

Connectivity and Safety: An RS-232 interface supports external control and data collection, optional LC Connected mobile monitoring is available via LC GreenBox, and a complete safety protection system covers low fluid level, dry-running, over-temperature and over-current with warning alarms.

sections.title: CTB-10 Cold Trap Bath at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the CTB-10 Cold Trap Bath overview, features, applications, specifications, control system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The CTB-10 Cold Trap Bath captures moisture and condensate down to -40 C and doubles as a fast cooling bath.
body: The CTB-10 from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a cold trap bath engineered for laboratories that need to protect vacuum pumps and lines from moisture and condensate, or need a quick, low-temperature cooling bath.
It cools from ambient down to -40 C, and two glass traps with transparent acrylic lids capture condensate while letting the user watch the level and protect downstream equipment.

A built-in dissolving system removes ice or solid matter stuck to the bath, a durable stainless-steel bath and 30 mm polyurethane insulation keep it robust and efficient, and compact, silent operation makes it easy to place.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) RW3 Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulators (General) deliver rapid heating and cooling throughout the entire temperature range, combining a built-in cooling coil with a powerful five-speed pump for both internal and external circulation.
features: Rapid Heating and Cooling: A built-in cooling coil and heater deliver rapid heating and cooling throughout the entire range, from -35 C (or -25 C) up to 150 C.
Five-Speed Pump: A five-speed adjustable pump reduces turbulence and suits both internal (steps 1-3) and external (steps 4-5) circulation, reaching up to 5.9 psi and 28 L/min.
Ultra-Stable PID Control: Microprocessor PID control with three-point calibration, automatic tuning and automatic run holds temperature to +/- 0.05 C.

Efficient, Low-Maintenance Cooling: CFC-free refrigerant (R-507 or R-404A) with a double service valve prevents leakage, and a detachable condenser air-filter plus a quick-release front grill make cleaning and maintenance easy.
Bright VFD Display: A bright VFD display with a quick adjustable dial knob shows temperature at 0.1 C resolution.
Dual Timer and Memory: Dual wait on/off timer modes (1 minute to 99 hr 59 min) and a three-temperature memory simplify repeated work.

Easy-Clean Bath and Connectivity: A corrosion-resistant, leak-proof, round-cornered, easy-to-clean stainless-steel bath with a drain valve and side handles, RS-232 and USB interfaces, an optional external temperature sensor and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox complete the package.
Safety: An isolated agitator, heater and sensor design, low-level, dry-running, over-temperature and over-current protection, warning alarms and a keypad lock keep operation safe.

faqs.question: What bath fluid does it use?
faqs.answer: Water near ambient; ethanol or silicone oil for wide-range work (replace silicone tube fittings with copper or Teflon at high temperature).

faqs.question: Is the condenser easy to maintain?
faqs.answer: Yes. A detachable condenser air-filter and a quick-release front grill make cleaning easy.

faqs.question: Can I record data?
faqs.answer: Yes, via RS-232 and USB, and optionally via LC Connected mobile monitoring using LC GreenBox.

sections.title: RW3 Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulator at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the RW3 Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulator (General) overview, features, applications, specifications, control system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The RW3 Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulators heat and cool rapidly across the entire range with powerful internal and external circulation.
body: The RW3 Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of refrigerated and heating bath circulators engineered for laboratories that need precise, stable temperature control both above and below ambient, delivered inside the bath and to external apparatus.

A five-speed adjustable pump and a built-in cooling coil reduce turbulence and suit both internal and external circulation - 1 to 3 steps for internal mixing and 4 to 5 steps for external supply - with strong pressure and flow.

Microprocessor PID control with three-point calibration holds temperature to +/- 0.05 C, and CFC-free refrigerant with a double service valve, a detachable condenser air-filter and a quick-release front grill keep cooling efficient and maintenance simple.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) RW3-P Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulators (Program) add a smart programmable controller to wide-range refrigerated and heating circulation, automating temperature ramp-up and dwell profiles from -35 C up to 150 C.

Ten programs of up to ten steps each - with up to 99 hr 59 min per step, linkable programs and up to 99 repeat cycles - combine with a five-speed pump and built-in cooling coil for both internal and external circulation, all held to +/- 0.05 C.

sections.title: RW3-P Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulator at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the RW3-P Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulator (Program) overview, features, applications, specifications, control system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The RW3-P Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulators automate wide-range ramp-and-dwell profiles with powerful internal and external circulation.
body: The RW3-P Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of programmable refrigerated and heating bath circulators engineered for laboratories that need automated, repeatable temperature profiles both above and below ambient, delivered inside the bath and to external apparatus.
A smart programmable touch-screen controller stores ten programs of up to ten steps each, links programs, repeats up to 99 cycles, and sets pre-heating and heating times before a program starts.

A five-speed pump and built-in cooling coil reduce turbulence and suit internal (steps 1-3) and external (steps 4-5) circulation, and microprocessor PID control with three-point calibration holds temperature to +/- 0.05 C across -35 to 150 C with CFC-free refrigerant.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the RW3-P Series include a -25 to 150 C or -35 to 150 C range, +/- 0.05 C stability, programmable control and 5 to 30 L bath volumes.

Technical data according to DIN 12876 (stability measured with ethanol at -10 C; cooling capacity with ethanol, at 230V/60Hz). Pump performance measured with water. Refrigerant: R-507 or R-404A depending on model. The -35P class offers different cooling-capacity figures (for example, 280 to 880 W at +20 C). When using silicone oil, replace the silicone tube fittings (inlet/outlet) with copper or Teflon tube. Contact technical support for consultation before purchasing.

sections.title: Control and Operation
body: The RW3-P Series offers programmable touch-LCD control with a five-speed pump, digital I/O and connectivity.
10 programs x 10 steps (up to 99 hr 59 min/step), linkable, up to 99 cycles, with pre-heat/heat time.
Intuitive touch-screen LCD controller with easy icons and logical menus.
Microprocessor PID with three-point calibration, auto-tuning and auto-run.
Five-speed pump: 1-3 steps internal, 4-5 steps external; digital I/O for interlocking.
RS-232 and USB; optional external sensor; optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox; keypad lock and splash-proof keypad.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) ST-G Series Autoclaves (Vertical Type) use microprocessor control with reliable safety functions to guarantee an optimum sterilization temperature, in a top-loading vertical design suited to high-volume sterilization.
features: High-Precision Control: A microprocessor controller with a temperature-calibration function allows high-precision temperature control, with sterilization from 110 to 123 C and melting (liquefaction of coagulated agar media) from 60 to 100 C.

Vertical Top-Loading: The vertical, top-loading design suits high-volume sterilization, and baskets stack two high or more to make full use of the chamber.
Low-Maintenance Build: A corrosion-resistant stainless-steel chamber and an easy-to-replace silicone gasket keep maintenance low.

Documentation and Connectivity: An optional dot-type (6-point) data recorder supports documentation, LC GreenBox enables mobile monitoring, and 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper suits GMP audits.

heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) DC2 Series Dry Cabinets (Auto Desiccator) store moisture-sensitive materials and samples in a controlled low-humidity environment, using an automatic electronic desiccator that removes the need for desiccant.

Convenient humidity setting and control, with a real-time temperature and humidity display, deviation notification and calibration, keep the cabinet interior reliably dry across a 20 to 60%RH setting range.
Six configurations - DC2-11/11A, DC2-21L/21LA and DC2-41/41A - offer 120, 240 or 480 L of storage, with the A models adding anti-static protection.

sections.subheading: The DC2 Series Dry Cabinets keep moisture-sensitive samples dry automatically, without desiccant.
body: The DC2 Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of automatic electronic dry cabinets engineered for laboratories that need to store moisture-sensitive materials, components and samples in a reliably low-humidity environment.

An automatic electronic desiccator unit controls the set humidity inside the cabinet without any desiccant, so maintenance is simple, and deviation notification and calibration for humidity and temperature keep control reliable.
A large transparent acrylic window allows convenient internal observation, height-adjustable shelves and optional drawers handle varied samples, and a key lock blocks unauthorised access.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the DC2 Series include a 20 to 60%RH control range and 120 to 480 L storage volumes.

Actual set-up humidity is 20 to 40%RH within a 20 to 60%RH setting range (1% scale). Internal humidity and temperature may temporarily rise during drying of the dehumidifier element. DC2-A models are anti-static products that prevent static electricity. The DC2-11(A) is stackable; the DC2-41(A) includes casters as standard. Contact technical support for consultation before purchasing.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) SC3-90F Series Fire Safety Storage Cabinets (Type 90) safeguard flammable hazardous materials from fire, with proven refractory performance certified to the strictest European standard, EN 14470-1.
features: High Fire Resistance: Fire resistance performance is in accordance with the strictest European standard (EN 14470-1), with the internal temperature kept below a 180 K rise for up to 90 minutes in the event of fire.

Fire Response Sealing System: When the temperature reaches 50 C the door automatically closes, and when the ambient temperature reaches 70 +/- 10 C the exhaust holes and ventilation openings automatically close, totally blocking the flow of heat from outside.

Application-Matched Model Selection: The right model can be selected to suppress fire at the natural ignition point of the dangerous goods being handled, considering prediction time and other factors.
Chemical-Resistant Interior: The interior material is coated with polyphenol resin for excellent chemical resistance, even in long-term use.
Triple Insulation Structure: All walls use the same triple-insulated structure, and all gaps are treated with fire-retardant finishes to protect flammable materials in a surrounding fire.

Safe Ventilation of Flammable Vapour: Vent inlet and outlet openings discharge gas easily to prevent accidents from accumulated flammable vapour and protect the operator, keeping vapours below the LEL concentration.
Solid, Secure Shelving: A solid shelf structure holds up to 80 kg per shelf and fixes firmly to the inside walls, with 30 mm-deep shelf edges to safely retain any leaked contents.

Effluent Reservoir and Key Lock: A bottom collecting sump safely handles any leaked material and prevents leakage out of the cabinet, and a key lock is provided as standard to block unauthorised access.
Easy Movement and Installation: Forklift fork space allows convenient movement, and leveling feet provide stable installation; under-bench models offer selectable 750 mm or 820 mm working height.

faqs.question: What fire rating does it have?
faqs.answer: Type 90: the internal temperature is kept below a 180 K rise for up to 90 minutes in fire, certified to EN 14470-1.

faqs.question: Is it certified?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is CE-certified to EN 14470-1, the strictest European standard for dangerous-goods storage.

faqs.question: What happens automatically in a fire?
faqs.answer: The door closes at 50 C, and the exhaust and ventilation openings seal at 70 +/- 10 C to block external heat.

faqs.question: What models are available?
faqs.answer: Two stand models (SC3-90F-1912D2-C, 1906D1-C) and two under-bench models (0812D2D-C, 0806D1D-C).

faqs.question: What are the storage volumes?

faqs.question: How much can each shelf hold?

faqs.question: Is the interior chemical-resistant?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is coated with polyphenol resin for excellent chemical resistance.

faqs.question: Can I filter fumes without a duct?
faqs.answer: Yes, with the optional EM-33 ductless fume extraction module (carbon/HEPA), convertible to external exhaust.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) SC3-30F Series Fire Safety Storage Cabinets (Type 30) safeguard flammable hazardous materials from fire, with proven refractory performance certified to the strictest European standard, EN 14470-1.
features: High Fire Resistance: Fire resistance performance is in accordance with the strictest European standard (EN 14470-1), with the internal temperature kept below a 180 K rise for up to 30 minutes in the event of fire.

Fire Response Sealing System: When the temperature reaches 50 C the door automatically closes, and when the ambient temperature reaches 70 +/- 10 C the exhaust holes and ventilation openings automatically close, totally blocking the flow of heat from outside.

Application-Matched Model Selection: The right model can be selected to suppress fire at the natural ignition point of the dangerous goods being handled, considering prediction time and other factors.
Chemical-Resistant Interior: The interior material is coated with polyphenol resin for excellent chemical resistance, even in long-term use.
Triple Insulation Structure: All walls use the same triple-insulated structure, and all gaps are treated with fire-retardant finishes to protect flammable materials in a surrounding fire.

Safe Ventilation of Flammable Vapour: Vent inlet and outlet openings discharge gas easily to prevent accidents from accumulated flammable vapour and protect the operator, keeping vapours below the LEL concentration.
Solid, Secure Shelving: A solid shelf structure holds up to 80 kg per shelf and fixes firmly to the inside walls, with 30 mm-deep shelf edges to safely retain any leaked contents.

Effluent Reservoir and Key Lock: A bottom collecting sump safely handles any leaked material and prevents leakage out of the cabinet, and a key lock is provided as standard to block unauthorised access.
Easy Movement and Installation: Forklift fork space allows convenient movement, and leveling feet provide stable installation; under-bench models offer selectable 750 mm or 820 mm working height.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) FSC Series Filtering Storage Cabinets store reagents in a ductless, recirculating-filtration cabinet, keeping the laboratory environment clean without connecting to an existing exhaust system.
features: Cost-Effective Ductless Filtration: Flexible installation is possible with no cost-intensive exhaust air ducts, and internal air circulation prevents the heating and cooling loss - and high energy consumption - of ducted exhaust.

Customised Filter Configuration: An ISO class 4 (US class 10) HEPA filter removes 0.3 um and larger particulates at 99.99% efficiency; a polyester pre-filter (85% arrestance) traps larger particles and extends HEPA life; and VOC, MA and MB activated-carbon filters are available - selected to suit the chemicals used.
Real-Time VOC Indication: A clear, symbolic VOC level bar indicates the VOC measurement inside the cabinet, with real-time detecting and displaying via an internal VOC sensor.

Powerful Air Purification (Turbo Fan): A turbo-fan button activates the fan at maximum speed before the door is opened, protecting users from any remaining hazardous gas; this can also be interlocked with door opening.

Safety Alarms and Protection: Safety warning alarms with LED indicators cover high temperature (with automatic fan stop), fan failure, door open, sensor error and check-filter, plus over-temperature and over-current protection.

Energy-Saving Sleep Mode: A sleep mode (for example, running only 8 am to 6 pm) saves up to 60% of energy consumption and extends the life of the fan and filter, and auto run resumes automatically after a power failure.

SEFA-Tested, Durable Storage: Doors and drawers are tested to SEFA (door-hinge and drawer static-load tests), with an additional overturning test, and drawers sustain up to 40 kg on smooth full-extension slides.

Chemical-Resistant Build: Corrosion-resistant epoxy-coated steel throughout and a tempered-glass door give clear observation, a full-length handle, a spill tray and a door lock for clean, safe storage.

body: The VDP Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of cylindrical vacuum desiccators engineered for laboratories that need to store tall equipment and moisture-sensitive samples under a stable, clean vacuum.
The cylindrical design suits tall items, holds a maximum vacuum of 1 Torr (1.33 x 10-4 MPa) for 72 hours, and a greaseless silicone gasket keeps the seal clean and cost-effective.

Transparent shatterproof polycarbonate allows clear observation and easy cleaning, a three-way valve and barbed ports make vacuum draw, release and gas exchange convenient, a flange lock secures the halves under non-vacuum conditions, a lid vacuum gauge is standard, and UG variants add an amber UV-block body for light-sensitive samples.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the VDP Series include a 1.33 x 10-4 MPa maximum vacuum, 16 to 25 L volumes and a tall cylindrical polycarbonate body.

Body and base: polycarbonate; perforated sample tray/shelf: polypropylene; locker: polypropylene; vacuum seal: silicone rubber. Maximum vacuum of 1 Torr (1.33 x 10-4 MPa) held for 72 hours. A lid vacuum gauge is standard (G); UG models add an amber UV-block body. Perforated shelves fit at up to 5 positions (40 mm spacing) or 3 positions (70 mm spacing). RoHS compliant except for VDP-U models. Round and cylindrical tops/bottoms are cross-compatible. Contact technical support for consultation before purchasing.

sections.title: Operation
body: The VDP Series offers simple, clean vacuum operation with a valve, flange lock and standard gauge.
Draw and hold up to 1 Torr (1.33 x 10-4 MPa) for 72 hours.
Three-way valve for vacuum draw, release or gas exchange; barbed ports for tubing.
Flange lock holds top and bottom together under non-vacuum conditions.
Standard lid vacuum gauge for at-a-glance checking.
Adjustable perforated shelves; UG models block UV for light-sensitive samples.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) OV4 Series Vacuum Ovens dry heat-sensitive and moisture-laden samples gently under vacuum, with improved usability, tight temperature distribution and comprehensive safety.
features: Wide-Range Vacuum Drying: A wide temperature range controllable up to 250 C, with improved temperature distribution (+/-1.5 C at 100 C) and 3-point calibration for high accuracy across the range.
Clean, Corrosion-Resistant Interior: Inner stainless steel and aluminium shelves provide excellent corrosion resistance and clean maintenance.
Separated Vacuum and Release Lines: The vacuum line and release line are separated for convenient, controlled operation, and a top-mounted display minimises the floor footprint.
Confined, Repeatable Sealing: When a vacuum is formed and maintained, the toughened glass is drawn onto the gasket and kept confined for long-time repeated use.

Outstanding Safety: A buffered door releases internal pressure through upper and lower vent holes on stable vacuum or internal explosion, a polycarbonate safety cover guards against glass breakage, and a patented overheating-protection system, over-temperature limit, controller lock and deviation alarm protect users and samples.

body: The OV4-S Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of standard vacuum ovens engineered for laboratories that need to dry heat-sensitive, oxidation-prone or moisture-laden samples gently under reduced pressure, with simple, reliable control.

Vacuum lowers the effective drying temperature and protects sensitive samples, a wide range reaches 250 C, distribution is tight (+/-1.5 C at 100 C), and 3-point calibration keeps accuracy high, with stainless-steel and aluminium shelves for clean, corrosion-resistant use.

Separated vacuum and release lines, a top-mounted 3.5-inch display and a buffered safety door with pressure-release vent holes and a polycarbonate cover make the OV4-S safe, precise and easy to operate.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, validation support, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the OV4-S Series include 28 and 65 L volumes, an Amb. +15 to 250 C range and +/-1.5 C distribution at 100 C.

Controller: 3.5-inch LCD. The lowest controllable temperature depends on room and sample temperatures. Technical data per DIN 12880 (after 2013). Adding an extra bottom shelf lets you run more samples but may slightly increase variation and fluctuation. A cold trap bath on the vacuum line is recommended to protect the pump from water/solvent or to supply dry air. The OV4-S does not include the advanced controller's Ramp Control, real-time graphs or automatic CSV data export (see the OV4 model for those). 120V versions have their own catalog numbers. Contact technical support for consultation before purchasing.

features: Intuitive Touch Controller: A 3.5-inch touch controller enables intuitive control, with a Wait on / Wait off timer for efficient test-schedule management.

Reliable Temperature Control: A wide range up to 250 C, 3-point calibration for accuracy, settable upper and lower temperature limits with deviation alarms, and optimal airflow for uniform heat transfer (variation +/-1.9 C or below at 100 C).

faqs.answer: Forced convection uses a fan for faster, more uniform heating; natural convection (ON4) is gentler for light or loose samples.

faqs.question: Can I stack two ovens?
faqs.answer: Yes, with the double-stacked bracket - note the upper oven's control range narrows to Amb.+30 to 250 C.

sections.title: OF4-V Series Forced Convection Oven at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the OF4-V Series Forced Convection Ovens (Advanced) overview, features, applications, specifications, control and safety system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The OF4-V Series Forced Convection Ovens dry and heat samples fast and uniformly up to 250 C, with advanced control and data.
body: The OF4-V Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of advanced forced convection ovens engineered for laboratories that need fast, uniform, fan-driven heating with programmable ramping, adjustable airflow, on-screen graphs and full data traceability.

Superb air dispersion optimised for uniform heat transfer heats quickly and evenly (variation +/-1.9 C or below at 100 C), a wide range reaches 250 C from Amb. +10, 3-point calibration keeps accuracy high, and Ramp Control sets the rate of temperature rise per test.

A 5-inch touch controller shows events, alarms and real-time graphs in a single view, suggests three frequent temperatures, provides Opti-flow adjustable fan speed, stores test data automatically in CSV for USB export, and logs the last 36 events, with PC, mobile, BMS and GMP-compliant monitoring built in.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, validation support, user training and after-sales service.

sections.description: From programmed drying to curing and general heating, the OF4-V Series suits chemistry, biology, materials, pharmaceutical and general laboratories.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the OF4-V Series include 26 to 147 L volumes, an Amb. +10 to 250 C range, Ramp Control and Opti-flow forced convection.

Controller: 5-inch TFT colour LCD touch with real-time and stored graphs. Communication USB, RS-232 and BMS standard. Opti-flow three-step fan speed; suggests three frequently used temperatures; stores data in CSV; logs the last 36 events. Distribution figures are measured at fan speed Step 5; lower fan steps increase fluctuation/variation. Each model is available with a solid or window door (add W). When the double-stack bracket is fitted, the upper oven's control range narrows to Amb.+30 to 250 C. 120V versions have their own catalog numbers. Contact technical support for consultation before purchasing.

faqs.question: What makes the OF4-P a program oven?

faqs.question: Can it run unattended?
faqs.answer: Yes. A scheduler sets the day, time and program number so the oven starts automatically, making unattended operation absolutely available.

faqs.question: What can I set per step?
faqs.answer: Start temperature, temperature and time for each step, Ramp Control (C/min) and Opti-flow fan speed.

faqs.question: How uniform and fast is it?
faqs.answer: Optimised airflow keeps variation within +/-1.9 C at 100 C, and it can reach 100 C in as little as 8 minutes.

faqs.question: What is the temperature range?

faqs.question: What sizes and doors are available?

faqs.question: Is connectivity built in?

body: The OF4-P Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of programmable forced convection ovens engineered for laboratories that need multi-step, repeatable, unattended heating and drying programs with full data traceability.

An intelligent programmable controller runs up to 10 programs of 10 steps each - repeatable up to 99 times - with start temperature, temperature and time per step, Opti-flow fan speed and Ramp Control all adjustable, and a scheduler to begin a program at a set day and time.

Superb air dispersion keeps distribution tight (variation +/-1.9 C or below at 100 C), a 5-inch touch controller shows real-time graphs, three suggested frequent temperatures and 36-event logging, and test data are stored automatically in CSV for USB export, with PC, mobile, BMS and GMP-compliant monitoring built in.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, validation support, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the OF4-P Series include 26 to 147 L volumes, an Amb. +10 to 250 C range, 10x10-step programming and Opti-flow forced convection.

Controller: 5-inch TFT colour LCD touch with real-time and stored graphs. Program setting: 10 programs, 10 steps, start temperature, repeatable up to 99 times, with a scheduler (day, time, program No.). Communication USB, RS-232 and BMS standard. Opti-flow three-step fan speed; logs the last 36 events; stores data in CSV. Distribution figures measured at fan speed Step 5; lower fan steps increase fluctuation/variation. Each model is available with a solid or window door (add W). When the double-stack bracket is fitted, the upper oven's control range narrows to Amb.+30 to 250 C. 120V versions have their own catalog numbers. Contact technical support for consultation before purchasing.

heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) OF3 Series Forced Convection Ovens (Large-General) are heavy-duty, large-volume ovens specially designed for large-volume and fast-drying applications, up to 760 L and 300 C, with simple and quick control.

Rapid heating from two powerful, noiseless sirocco fans gives uniform temperature distribution and short heat-up times, and a bright VFD display with a quick adjustable dial knob makes everyday operation fast and straightforward.

Two temperature classes - OF3 (to 200 C) and OF3-H (to 300 C) - in three volumes each (314 / 450 / 760 L) suit industrial and high-throughput laboratories needing quick, uniform, large-batch drying without programming.

body: The OF3 Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of heavy-duty, large-volume forced convection ovens engineered for industrial and high-throughput laboratories that need rapid, uniform drying of large or numerous samples with straightforward, everyday control.

Two noiseless, powerful sirocco fans generate optimal air circulation for temperature uniformity and short heat-up times, microprocessor PID control with 3-point calibration and automatic tuning keeps accuracy high, and the range reaches 200 C (OF3) or 300 C (OF3-H).

A bright VFD display with a quick adjustable dial knob shows set and present values at once for the simplest control, a corrosion-resistant incoloy heater and stainless interior with rounded corners ease cleaning, and casters, dual slide vents and an optional tempered-glass window add convenience.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, validation support, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH3-E Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a cost-beneficial environmental chamber designed for laboratories that need stable, repeatable climate control for a defined range of test conditions without unnecessary complexity.
features: Colour Touch Controller: A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives convenient access to settings and lets users check operating status as graphs, making everyday testing easier to monitor.

Stable Temperature and Humidity: Excellent thermal insulation and sealing ensure stable temperature and humidity reproducibility, even for repeated test use, while air is circulated at an optimum speed for uniform conditions.
Double-Sealed Door: The door uses a double-sealed structure for enhanced airtightness, helping maintain set conditions and reducing losses during operation.

Dual Over-Temperature Protection: An electronic advanced over-temperature limiter (A-OT) with an independent sensor works alongside a mechanical backup limiter (B-OT), providing safer and more accurate over-temperature shutdown even during electronic faults.
Water Level Management: A water level check function, plus low and empty water level alarms with automatic shut-off, helps prevent dry operation and keeps extended runs safe and uninterrupted.
Efficient Water Recirculation: An efficient water supply and recirculation system minimises refilling even for long-term high-humidity tests, with an optional direct water supply system available.
Sample Observation: A tempered glass door with a built-in heating wire and LED lamp allows easy observation of samples without disturbing chamber conditions.

Multi-Device Control and Monitoring: Up to 32 units can be connected to a PC via RS-485 for centralised control, and remote monitoring is available through the Lab Companion mobile app with LC Connected (via LC GreenBox).
Energy-Saving Operation: An energy-saving system performs temperature and humidity tests efficiently, reducing power consumption during operation.
applications: Pharmaceutical Laboratories: Used for stability studies, shelf-life evaluation, packaging testing and general storage-condition simulation within defined temperature and humidity ranges.
Chemical and Material Laboratories: Supports material ageing, environmental exposure testing and reproducibility studies under controlled climate conditions.
Electronics and Component Testing: Suitable for evaluating the behaviour of components and assemblies under controlled temperature and humidity conditions.
Food and Beverage Testing: Used for shelf-life assessment, storage simulation and quality-control testing of food and beverage samples.
Academic and Research Laboratories: Suitable for teaching and research labs that need reliable, repeatable environmental testing with straightforward operation.
Quality Control Laboratories: Supports routine QC workflows where consistent, documented temperature and humidity conditions are required.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH3-PE Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a compact tabletop environmental chamber built for laboratories that need accurate, repeatable climate control in a small footprint. Available in 25 L, 65 L and 100 L volumes, it covers 0 to 100°C without humidity and 30 to 95 %RH.
features: Compact, Space-Saving Design: A structural design optimised for miniaturisation delivers proven reproducibility and reliability while saving valuable bench space.
Colour Touch Controller: A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives convenient access to settings and lets users check operating status as graphs from the front of the chamber.

External Humidification System: Because humidification is handled externally rather than inside the chamber, the testing space stays clean and maintenance is simpler, with fewer deposits to remove between runs.
Stable Temperature and Humidity: Excellent thermal insulation and sealing ensure stable temperature and humidity reproducibility even under repeated test use.
Double-Sealed Door: The door uses a double-sealed structure for enhanced airtightness, helping maintain set conditions during operation.

Dual Over-Temperature Protection: An electronic advanced over-temperature limiter (A-OT) with an independent sensor works alongside a mechanical backup limiter (B-OT) for safer, more accurate over-temperature shutdown, and surface temperature is kept below 60°C.
Water Level Management: A water level check function, an easy-cap water inlet, and low and empty water level alarms with automatic shut-off help prevent dry operation and keep extended runs safe.
Sample Observation: A tempered glass door with a built-in heating wire and LED lamp allows easy observation of samples, and an LED status indicator identifies chamber condition from a distance.
Easy Maintenance: The refrigerator condenser grill is easy to remove, making it simple to maintain refrigeration efficiency.

Multi-Device Control and Monitoring: RS-232 is supported as standard and RS-485 as an option, allowing up to 32 units to be connected to a PC. Remote monitoring is available through the Lab Companion mobile app with LC Connected (via LC GreenBox).

faqs.question: What is the temperature range of the TH3-PE?
faqs.answer: The TH3-PE operates from 0 to 100°C without humidity control.

faqs.question: What is the humidity range?
faqs.answer: The chamber supports 30 to 95 %RH.

faqs.question: Which chamber sizes are available?
faqs.answer: The TH3-PE is available in 25 L (025), 65 L (065) and 100 L (100) volumes.

faqs.question: How is the TH3-PE different from the other tabletop models?
faqs.answer: It is part of a three-model series selected by temperature range: TH3-KE (-40 to 100°C), TH3-ME (-20 to 100°C) and TH3-PE (0 to 100°C).

faqs.question: What controller does it use?
faqs.answer: It uses a 5.6-inch colour touch display with graph-based status monitoring.

faqs.question: What safety features are included?
faqs.answer: Dual over-temperature protection (A-OT and B-OT), surface temperature kept below 60°C, water level alarms with auto shut-off, door-open warning, overcurrent and short-circuit protection, and compressor overload stop.

faqs.question: How accurate is the control?
faqs.answer: Temperature fluctuation is ±0.3°C and humidity fluctuation is ±1 %RH under the reference conditions.

faqs.question: Can it be placed on a bench and moved easily?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is a compact tabletop unit, and optional 1-stage and 2-stage stands with casters support placement, movement and stacking.

faqs.question: Can multiple units be controlled together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Up to 32 units can be connected to a PC (RS-232 standard, RS-485 optional), with mobile monitoring via the Lab Companion app.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for GMP environments?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can be integrated with 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper software (option).

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help select the right configuration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help select the right chamber size, shelving, water supply, monitoring, stand and software options for your workflow.

Built around a 5.6-inch colour touch controller, a differentiated external humidification system and a double-sealed door, the TH3-PE delivers stable temperature and humidity reproducibility even under repeated testing.

faqs.question: What is the temperature range of the TH3-ME?
faqs.answer: The TH3-ME operates from -20 to 100°C without humidity control.

faqs.question: What is the humidity range?
faqs.answer: The chamber supports 20 to 95 %RH.

faqs.question: Which chamber sizes are available?
faqs.answer: The TH3-ME is available in 25 L (025), 65 L (065) and 100 L (100) volumes.

faqs.question: How is the TH3-ME different from the other tabletop models?
faqs.answer: It is part of a three-model series selected by temperature range: TH3-KE (-40 to 100°C), TH3-ME (-20 to 100°C) and TH3-PE (0 to 100°C). The ME sits in the middle, adding sub-zero reach to -20°C.

faqs.question: What controller does it use?
faqs.answer: It uses a 5.6-inch colour touch display with graph-based status monitoring.

faqs.question: What safety features are included?
faqs.answer: Dual over-temperature protection (A-OT and B-OT), surface temperature kept below 60°C, water level alarms with auto shut-off, door-open warning, overcurrent and short-circuit protection, and compressor overload stop.

faqs.question: How accurate is the control?
faqs.answer: Temperature fluctuation is ±0.3°C and humidity fluctuation is ±1 %RH under the reference conditions.

faqs.question: Can it be placed on a bench and moved easily?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is a compact tabletop unit, and optional 1-stage and 2-stage stands with casters support placement, movement and stacking.

faqs.question: Can multiple units be controlled together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Up to 32 units can be connected to a PC (RS-232 standard, RS-485 optional), with mobile monitoring via the Lab Companion app.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for GMP environments?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can be integrated with 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper software (option).

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help select the right configuration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help select the right chamber size, shelving, water supply, monitoring, stand and software options for your workflow.

longForm.heroHook: Compact benchtop temperature and humidity testing with a wide -20 to 100°C range and precise control
longForm.heroLead: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH3-ME Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a compact tabletop environmental chamber built for laboratories that need accurate, repeatable climate control in a small footprint.
heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH3-ME Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a compact tabletop environmental chamber built for laboratories that need accurate, repeatable climate control in a small footprint.

Built around a 5.6-inch colour touch controller, a differentiated external humidification system and a double-sealed door, the TH3-ME delivers stable temperature and humidity reproducibility even under repeated testing.

It is available in 25 L, 65 L and 100 L chamber volumes, and belongs to a three-model tabletop series (KE, ME, PE) selected by temperature range. The ME model covers -20 to 100°C and 20 to 95 %RH, making it well suited to sub-zero and ambient stability, material and general environmental testing where bench space is limited.

sections.title: TH3-ME at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the TH3-ME Temperature & Humidity Chamber overview, features, applications, specifications, control system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The TH3-ME Temperature & Humidity Chamber brings wide-range, precise climate testing to the benchtop for stability, material and routine environmental work.
body: The TH3-ME from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a tabletop environmental chamber engineered for laboratories that need reliable temperature and humidity control without dedicating floor space to a full-size chamber.

Its structural design is optimised for miniaturisation, giving proven reproducibility and reliability in a compact body. A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives clear access to set values, actual values and operating status, which can also be followed as a graph.

A differentiated external humidification system provides stable humidity control and keeps the testing space easy to clean and maintain, while an efficient water supply and recirculation system minimises refilling even during long high-humidity tests.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH3-KE Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a compact tabletop environmental chamber built for laboratories that need accurate, repeatable climate control in a small footprint. Available in 25 L, 65 L and 100 L volumes, it covers -40 to 100°C without humidity and 20 to 95 %RH.
features: Compact, Space-Saving Design: A structural design optimised for miniaturisation delivers proven reproducibility and reliability while saving valuable bench space.
Colour Touch Controller: A 5.6-inch colour touch display gives convenient access to settings and lets users check operating status as graphs from the front of the chamber.

External Humidification System: Because humidification is handled externally rather than inside the chamber, the testing space stays clean and maintenance is simpler, with fewer deposits to remove between runs.
Stable Temperature and Humidity: Excellent thermal insulation and sealing ensure stable temperature and humidity reproducibility even under repeated test use.
Double-Sealed Door: The door uses a double-sealed structure for enhanced airtightness, helping maintain set conditions during operation.

Dual Over-Temperature Protection: An electronic advanced over-temperature limiter (A-OT) with an independent sensor works alongside a mechanical backup limiter (B-OT) for safer, more accurate over-temperature shutdown, and surface temperature is kept below 60°C.
Water Level Management: A water level check function, an easy-cap water inlet, and low and empty water level alarms with automatic shut-off help prevent dry operation and keep extended runs safe.
Sample Observation: A tempered glass door with a built-in heating wire and LED lamp allows easy observation of samples, and an LED status indicator identifies chamber condition from a distance.
Easy Maintenance: The refrigerator condenser grill is easy to remove, making it simple to maintain refrigeration efficiency.

Multi-Device Control and Monitoring: RS-232 is supported as standard and RS-485 as an option, allowing up to 32 units to be connected to a PC. Remote monitoring is available through the Lab Companion mobile app with LC Connected (via LC GreenBox).

faqs.question: What is the temperature range of the TH3-KE?

faqs.question: Which chamber sizes are available?

faqs.question: How is the TH3-KE different from the other tabletop models?
faqs.answer: It is part of a three-model series selected by temperature range: TH3-KE (-40 to 100°C), TH3-ME (-20 to 100°C) and TH3-PE (0 to 100°C). The KE offers the deepest cold, reaching -40°C (-35°C at 50 Hz).

faqs.question: How accurate is the control?
faqs.answer: Temperature fluctuation is ±0.3°C and humidity fluctuation is ±1 %RH under the reference conditions.

faqs.question: Can it be placed on a bench and moved easily?

faqs.question: Can multiple units be controlled together?

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH-G Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a large-capacity floor-standing environmental chamber built for laboratories that need deep low-temperature and humidity testing at high sample volumes.
features: Dual-Stage Refrigeration: Two-stage compression with R-507 refrigerant and an air-cooled condenser gives the TH-G the cooling power to reach and hold -40°C reliably, even during extended low-temperature runs.

Colour Touch LCD Controller: A 5.7-inch colour interactive touch LCD shows set and present values together, displays operating progress as a graph, includes a built-in SD card drive and supports English, Chinese and Korean.
Microprocessor PID Control: Microprocessor PID control with temperature calibration and automatic tuning provides precise, repeatable temperature and humidity performance.

Advanced Humidity Handling: A humidification tank mounted on the chamber exterior improves low and high humidity control, and a water recycling and filtering system reduces water consumption for longer operation.

Tight Sealing and Insulation: Heat-resistant silicone packing blocks heat leakage and a two-point door latch enhances airtightness, while optimised insulation improves energy efficiency and keeps the surface below 60°C even at maximum temperature.

Water Supply Convenience: A front-mounted water tank and a portable water container make water supply and maintenance easy, water can be supplied during operation, and an optional direct water system supports long-term tests.
Sample Observation: A tempered glass door with a built-in heating wire and energy-efficient LED lighting gives a clear view of samples, and an optional inner glass door improves monitoring.

Mobility and Access: Casters allow easy movement during installation or relocation, and a 50 mm cable port is standard on the left side, with optional additional 50 mm or 80 mm ports for external probes and wiring.

Multi-Unit Control: RS-232 is standard and an optional RS-485 port allows up to 9 units to be connected for simultaneous monitoring and operation, with program setup, backup and recovery via software.

faqs.question: What is the temperature range of the TH-KH?
faqs.answer: The TH-KH operates from -70 to 100°C without humidity control, and 15 to 90°C with humidity. The best programmable control range is -60 to 140°C.

faqs.question: What is the humidity range?
faqs.answer: The chamber supports 25 to 95 %RH.

faqs.question: Which chamber sizes are available?
faqs.answer: The TH-KH is available in 189 L (TH-KH-180), 302 L (TH-KH-300) and 408 L (TH-KH-408) volumes.

faqs.question: What refrigeration system does it use?
faqs.answer: A mechanical cascade dual-stage refrigeration system with an air-cooled condenser and R-507 plus R-23 refrigerants, which enables the -70°C low-temperature reach.

faqs.question: What controller does it use?
faqs.answer: A 5.7-inch colour interactive touch LCD with graph display, a built-in SD card drive and trilingual support (English / Chinese / Korean).

faqs.question: What safety features are included?
faqs.answer: A key door lock, automatic shut-off after an overheat alarm, low and empty water level alarms, power supply leakage breaker, over-current protection, open-door alarm, and a surface kept below 60°C.

faqs.question: How accurate is the control?
faqs.answer: Temperature fluctuation is ±0.3°C and humidity fluctuation is ±0.4 %RH at the reference conditions.

faqs.question: Can multiple units be controlled together?
faqs.answer: Yes. RS-232 is standard and an optional RS-485 port allows up to 9 units to be connected for monitoring and operation.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for long-term testing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Water recycling, a front water tank, water supply during operation and an optional direct water system support long-term tests.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help select the right configuration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help select the right chamber size, shelving, water supply, monitoring and recording options for your workflow.

heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH-KH Temperature & Humidity Chamber is a floor-standing environmental chamber built for laboratories that need deep sub-zero testing down to -70°C alongside humidity control.

Built around a 5.7-inch colour touch LCD controller, a dual-stage refrigeration system and a two-point sealed door, the TH-KH delivers stable, reproducible conditions across long-duration low-temperature tests.

It is available in 189 L, 302 L and 408 L chamber volumes, covering -70 to 100°C (without humidity) and 25 to 95 %RH, making it suited to deep-cold stability, material, cold-storage and cryo-adjacent environmental testing.

body: The TH-KH from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a floor-standing environmental chamber engineered for laboratories that need reliable temperature and humidity control across large sample volumes and demanding low-temperature conditions.

A dual-stage mechanical refrigeration system with an air-cooled condenser reaches down to -70°C, while a 5.7-inch colour touch LCD gives clear access to set values, actual values and operating status, which can also be followed as a graph, with a built-in SD card drive and trilingual support.

A humidification tank fitted to the chamber exterior, plus a water recycling and filtering system, provides stable low and high humidity control and reduces water consumption during long-term testing.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH4-ICH Pharmaceutical Stability Test Chamber is designed specifically to conduct ICH Q1A(R2) long-term stability testing and ICH Q1B Option 2 photostability testing.
features: 7-Inch Integrated Controller: A 7-inch touch display controls temperature, humidity, illuminance and UV together, with graph-based monitoring and internal plus USB data storage.

ICH Q1B Photostability Lighting: VIS and UV-A light sources compliant with ICH Q1B Option 2 are independently controlled; a specially manufactured filter and optimised lamp arrangement deliver uniform illuminance across the vertical area.

Light Exposure Measurement: Light sensors measure actual and accumulated VIS and UV-A exposure, display accumulated time and remaining time to target, and trigger an auto lamp-off when each preset target is reached.

Stable Long-Term Stability Testing: An energy-saving inverter refrigeration system with PID control holds stable temperature and humidity, maintains the same control range regardless of lamp on/off status, and runs continuously without defrosting even at 5°C.

Level-Checker Water Monitoring: A Level-Checker system provides real-time water level monitoring, and an external humidification system improves stable humidity control while keeping the test space clean and easy to maintain.

Uniform Conditions Under Load: Stable horizontal airflow ensures consistent temperature and humidity even with large sample loads, and excellent insulation and sealing give reproducible conditions across repeated long-term testing.
Sample Access and Observation: An inner glass door of tempered glass allows internal observation and sample access during testing, and a sliding shelf makes sample handling convenient.

Multi-Zone PID and Communication: PID control divided into 16 zones enables precise, stable control; RS-232 is standard and RS-485 optional, with dedicated PC monitoring software for up to 4 units and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox.

Data Integrity and Compliance: Temperature, humidity, VIS and UV-A calibration functions support reliable control, and the chamber supports LC DataKeeper, a 21 CFR Part 11-compliant data integrity software, for GMP audit readiness.

faqs.question: What standards does the TH4-ICH support?
faqs.answer: It is built to conduct ICH Q1A(R2) stability testing and ICH Q1B Option 2 photostability testing.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the -400 and -400A?
faqs.answer: The TH4-ICH-400 has the VIS and UV-A photostability lighting system with 2 shelves; the TH4-ICH-400A is a stability-only model with up to 8 shelves.

faqs.question: What is the temperature range?
faqs.answer: 0 to 70°C without light, and 5 to 70°C with light on the -400 model.

faqs.question: What is the humidity range?
faqs.answer: 20 to 75 %RH, with ±2 %RH fluctuation.

faqs.question: What light output does the photostability model provide?
faqs.answer: VIS cool white at 12,000 Lux and UV-A at 8 W/m² (at 25°C), with ±10 % uniformity.

faqs.question: How is light exposure tracked?
faqs.answer: Light sensors measure actual and accumulated VIS and UV-A exposure, show time to target, and auto lamp-off when the target is reached.

faqs.question: Can it run long-term 5°C stability studies?
faqs.answer: Yes. It runs continuously at 5°C without defrosting.

faqs.question: What controller and communication does it use?
faqs.answer: A 7-inch touch controller with 16-zone PID, RS-232 standard and RS-485 optional, PC software for up to 4 units, and optional mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for GMP environments?
faqs.answer: Yes. It supports LC DataKeeper, a 21 CFR Part 11-compliant data integrity software (option).

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help select and qualify the right model?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help select between the -400 and -400A, configure options, and support installation, qualification and training.
