longForm.heroHook: Purpose-built for ICH Q1A(R2) stability and ICH Q1B photostability testing in one chamber
longForm.heroLead: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH4-ICH Pharmaceutical Stability Test Chamber is designed specifically to conduct ICH Q1A(R2) long-term stability testing and ICH Q1B Option 2 photostability testing.
heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) TH4-ICH Pharmaceutical Stability Test Chamber is designed specifically to conduct ICH Q1A(R2) long-term stability testing and ICH Q1B Option 2 photostability testing.

Built around a 7-inch touch display that controls temperature, humidity, illuminance and UV together, the TH4-ICH delivers stable, documented conditions for pharmaceutical stability and photostability workflows.
It is available in two 400 L models: the TH4-ICH-400 with a VIS and UV-A photostability lighting system for ICH Q1B, and the TH4-ICH-400A for temperature and humidity stability testing.

sections.title: TH4-ICH at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the TH4-ICH Pharmaceutical Stability Test Chamber overview, features, applications, specifications, control system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The TH4-ICH Pharmaceutical Stability Test Chamber supports ICH Q1A(R2) stability and ICH Q1B photostability testing with documented, audit-ready control.
body: The TH4-ICH from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a stability chamber engineered for pharmaceutical laboratories that need to run ICH-compliant stability and photostability studies in a single unit.

An energy-saving inverter refrigeration system with PID control maintains stable temperature and humidity while reducing energy use, and enables continuous operation without defrosting even during 5°C long-term stability testing.

For photostability, VIS and UV-A light sources compliant with ICH guidelines are independently controlled, with light sensors measuring actual and accumulated exposure and an auto lamp-off function when the target is reached.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) Plant Growth Chambers are designed to provide optimal photosynthesis conditions, combining precise temperature, illumination and humidity control for reliable, reproducible plant growth studies.
features: Uniform Illumination System: Uniform luminescence distribution with a broad spread of side lamps hastens plant growth, and high-intensity upper lamps on the GC-1000 give light-efficient growth with a low thermal load.

Low Heat Load Design: A unique construction minimises heat increase from surrounding lamps, a tempered glass door blocks heated air from the lamps, and the GC-1000TLH exhausts heated air through upper vent holes.
Stable, Long-Lasting Lighting: High-frequency electronic ballast lamps provide stable, long-lasting lighting for consistent, repeatable illumination across long growth runs.
Precise Temperature Control: Microprocessor PID control with temperature calibration and automatic tuning holds temperature to ±0.1°C fluctuation for reproducible growth conditions.
Programmable Growth Profiles: 10-step programmable temperature, humidity and illumination profiles with up to 999 repeat cycles support day/night cycling and seasonal simulation.
Optional CO2 Enrichment: An optional CO2 control system up to 5,000 ppm with an NDIR CO2 sensor supports photosynthesis and enrichment studies.

Dual-Sealed Observation Door: An inner glass door with silicone sealing and an external door with magnetic sealing provide dual airtight packing, and a wide inner tempered glass door allows clear observation without disturbing the chamber environment.
Flexible Loading: Adjustable shelf levels allow tall plants to be grown inside the chamber, and the door is designed to open smoothly to minimise damage to plants.

Easy Water and Filter Maintenance: A front water tank with a water-level bar, water supply during operation, an adjustable tank position on the GC-300TLH, and a detachable condenser air filter make maintenance simple. The refrigerant is CFC-free.

Entomology and Ecology: Used to rear insects and study organisms under controlled temperature, light and humidity.

Education and Teaching: Ideal for teaching labs demonstrating plant growth, photosynthesis and environmental control.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) RS-2 Funnel Shaker is designed for efficient mixing of samples in separatory funnels, combining double-sided vertical reciprocation with an adjustable tilt of up to 20 degrees for enhanced mixing efficiency.
features: Vertical and Tilted Reciprocation: Vertical reciprocation up to 300 rpm with a 40 mm stroke, plus an adjustable shake tilt from 0 to 20 degrees, achieves high mixing efficiency even at low rpm.
Durable BLDC Motor: A BLDC motor provides outstanding durability, a lower noise level and enhanced stability compared with competitor products that use DC motors.
One-Touch Funnel Handling: A one-touch mechanism allows swift, easy funnel installation and removal, so samples can be loaded and unloaded quickly and comfortably.
Stable, Low-Vibration Design: A stable centre-of-gravity design minimises vibration even with one-sided sample installation or high-speed tilted movement.
High Funnel Capacity: The RS-2 fits cone or cylindrical funnels up to 2 L, and can hold up to ten <0.5 L funnels, six 0.5-1 L funnels or four 2 L funnels, with up to five holders per side.
Tilted Controller: A controller with the display panel set at a 20-degree angle gives good visibility even from floor level, with an error alarm and status indicator for easy operation.
Safety Features: Safety devices protect the user and the experiment, including overcurrent protection and automatic resumption of operation when power returns after a failure.
Flexible Scheduling: A count-down timer up to 999 hr 59 min and an optional LC Connected mobile monitoring network give flexibility in experiment planning.

faqs.question: What is the RS-2 Funnel Shaker used for?
faqs.answer: It is used to mix samples in separatory funnels, mainly for liquid-liquid extraction and sample preparation.

faqs.question: What motion does it use?
faqs.answer: Double-sided vertical reciprocation combined with an adjustable tilt from 0 to 20 degrees.

faqs.question: What is the speed range?
faqs.answer: 30 to 300 rpm in vertical motion and 30 to 250 rpm in inclined motion, with a 40 mm stroke.

faqs.question: How many funnels can it hold?
faqs.answer: Up to four 2 L funnels, six 0.5-1 L funnels, or ten funnels under 0.5 L, with up to five holders per side.

faqs.question: What funnels are compatible?
faqs.answer: Cone or cylindrical separatory funnels up to 2 L. Funnels are not supplied.

faqs.question: What motor does it use?
faqs.answer: A BLDC motor, which offers better durability, lower noise and improved stability than DC-motor designs.

faqs.question: What is the maximum load?
faqs.answer: Up to 5 kg per side; the load should be balanced across both sides.

faqs.question: What safety features are included?
faqs.answer: Overcurrent protection and automatic resumption of operation after a power failure, plus an error alarm and status indicator.

faqs.question: Can it be monitored remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes, optionally via the LC Connected mobile network using LC GreenBox.

faqs.question: How much space does it need?
faqs.answer: 600 x 460 x 470 mm, or 900 x 460 x 670 mm allowing for the 20-degree tilt.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help with setup and training?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help with holder selection, loading, installation and user training.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) OS Series Dual Action Shakers are benchtop platform shakers that combine orbital and reciprocating motion for flexible, efficient mixing of flasks, funnels, tubes and microplates.
features: Dual-Action Motion: Orbital and reciprocating shaking motions in a single platform shaker give flexibility for a wide range of mixing and culturing applications.
High Speed with PID Control: Microprocessor PID control with shaking-speed calibration delivers a competitive high speed up to 500 rpm, with a wide speed range even under heavy workloads.
Maintenance-Free BLDC Motor: A maintenance-free BLDC motor generates smooth, quiet, uniform and powerful shaking, with smooth acceleration and deceleration control for a pleasant test environment.
Best-Effort Run Function: A best-effort run function intelligently manages rpm to keep the platform shaking even when the workload exceeds its rated capacity.
Low-Vibration Design: A low-profile design minimises vibration and sliding caused by high-speed shaking, keeping the shaker stable on the bench.
Repeatable Positioning: The platform stops where it starts, so repetitive tasks are easy and the fixed stop position benefits automated dosing or sampling.

Clear VFD Display and Timer: A user-friendly control panel with Lab Companion's bright VFD display, a durable membrane touch switch and control knob, and an easy-set digital timer from 1 minute to 999 hr 59 min make operation simple.
Flexible Speed Setting: Speed is set and displayed in 1 rpm increments, and the increment interval can be changed among 1, 5 or 10 rpm to suit user preference.
Connectivity and Monitoring: RS-232 and USB ports allow external control and data collection, and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox enables monitoring anytime, anywhere.
Safety Features: Safety features include automatic run after a power interruption, a shaking-speed deviation alarm, overcurrent protection and a stalled-platform check.

faqs.question: What motion does the OS Series use?
faqs.answer: Dual-action shaking with both orbital and reciprocating motion (the OS-4000 offers orbital to 500 rpm and reciprocal to 450 rpm).

faqs.question: What is the speed range?
faqs.answer: 20 to 500 rpm, with ±1 rpm or ±1% speed stability.

faqs.question: What amplitude options are available?
faqs.answer: 19.1 mm default, with 12.7 mm available on the OS-2000 and 25.4 mm available on the OS-3000 and OS-4000.

faqs.question: What is the largest flask it can hold?
faqs.answer: Up to 6 L on the OS-3000 and OS-4000 (the OS-2000 handles up to 1 L).

faqs.question: How much load can it take?
faqs.answer: Up to 16 kg on the OS-2000, 18 kg on the OS-3000 and 21 kg on the OS-4000 at 300 rpm; up to 500 rpm at lighter loads.

faqs.question: What happens if I overload it?
faqs.answer: A best-effort run function intelligently manages rpm to keep the platform shaking even beyond rated capacity.

faqs.question: Does the platform stop in a fixed position?
faqs.answer: Yes. It stops where it starts, which helps with automated dosing or sampling.

faqs.question: What motor does it use?
faqs.answer: A maintenance-free BLDC motor for smooth, quiet, uniform and powerful shaking.

faqs.question: Can it be monitored remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes, via RS-232, USB, and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring using LC GreenBox.

faqs.question: Do I need a platform and clamps?
faqs.answer: Yes. A universal platform is sold separately, and clamps, racks or holders are chosen for your vessels.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help with platform and clamp selection?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help select the model, platform, clamps and accessories, and support installation and training.

body: The OS Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of benchtop platform shakers engineered for laboratories that need versatile, reliable shaking across a wide range of vessels.

Dual-action motion lets users switch between orbital and reciprocating shaking, while a wide speed range up to 500 rpm and selectable amplitude suit everything from gentle mixing to vigorous culturing.

Its maintenance-free BLDC motor runs quietly and reliably with little upkeep, and an intelligent load-handling function keeps the platform moving steadily even when a run is loaded beyond the rated capacity.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) OS-7000 Series General Shakers are large open-air orbital platform shakers built to handle heavy workloads with a powerful driving system and a durable body structure.
features: Powerful Direct-Drive System: An ideal DD (Direct Drive) brushless motor and triple cam system support heavy loads with high torque at high speed, quiet running, smooth rotation and maintenance-free operation.

High Speed with PID Control: Microprocessor PID control with an intelligent speed controller and shaking-speed calibration delivers reproducible results at a competitive high speed up to 500 rpm, with a wide speed range even under heavy workloads.

Best-Effort Run and Auto Adjustment: A best-effort run function keeps the platform shaking even beyond rated capacity, and automatic speed adjustment responds to unbalanced load placement, unusual vibration or external shock.

Smooth Start and Stop: Smooth acceleration and deceleration control, with smooth start and smooth stop functions, prevents chemical spills from flasks or test tubes and provides a pleasant test environment.
Low-Vibration Design: A low-profile design minimises vibration and sliding caused by high-speed shaking, keeping the large platform stable during operation.
Repeatable Positioning: The platform stops where it starts, so repetitive tasks are easy and the fixed stop position benefits automated dosing or sampling.

Clear VFD Display and Timer: A user-friendly control panel with Lab Companion's bright VFD display, a durable membrane touch switch and control knob, and an easy-set digital timer make operation simple; the OS-7100 timer runs up to 9999 hr 59 min.
Flexible Speed Setting: Speed is set and displayed in 1 rpm increments, and the increment interval can be changed among 1, 5 or 10 rpm to suit user preference.

Connectivity and Accessories: Built-in RS-232 and USB ports allow external control and data collection, a variety of accessories meet different application demands, and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox enables monitoring anytime, anywhere.
Safety Features: Safety features include automatic run after a power interruption, a shaking-speed deviation alarm and overcurrent protection.

body: The technical specifications of the OS-7000 Series include orbital motion, up to 500 rpm, a large 755 x 520 mm platform and loads up to 35 kg.

Maximum rpm is measured under fixed-weight conditions with a steel plate at default amplitude; actual performance may vary with liquid samples. Speed accuracy is ±1 rpm below 100 rpm and ±1% above 100 rpm. A universal platform (sold separately) is required to mount clamps, racks and holders.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) SKC-7000 Series Program Shakers are programmable open-air orbital platform shakers built around an innovative triple-cam shaking mechanism that offers reliable performance across a wide speed range.
features: Programmable Multi-Step Operation: Progressive program operation supports up to 20 patterns with up to 20 segments each, with forward and backward shaking and pause steps timed from 1 minute to 99 hr 59 min.

Triple-Cam Direct-Drive System: An ideal DD (Direct Drive) brushless motor and triple cam system support heavy loads with high torque at high speed, quiet running, smooth rotation and maintenance-free operation.
High Speed with PID Control: Microprocessor PID control maintains a constant speed and delivers a competitive high speed up to 500 rpm, with a wide speed range even under heavy workloads.

Best-Effort Run and Auto Adjustment: A best-effort run function keeps the platform shaking even beyond rated capacity, and automatic speed adjustment responds to unbalanced load placement, unusual vibration or external shock.
Smooth Start and Stop: Smooth acceleration and deceleration control, with smooth start and smooth stop functions, prevents chemical spills from flasks or test tubes.
Exceptional Low-Profile Design: At only 12 cm from the bottom to the platform, the low-profile design minimises vibration and sliding caused by high-speed shaking and keeps loading comfortable.
Repeatable Positioning: The platform stops where it starts, so repetitive tasks are easy and the fixed stop position benefits automated dosing or sampling.
Slide-Type Platform Option: An easy-exchange slide-type universal platform (optional) reduces physical fatigue when handling heavy-load samples.

Clear VFD Display and Safety: A user-friendly control panel with a bright VFD display, durable membrane touch switch and control knob is complemented by a shaking-speed deviation alarm and overcurrent protection.

Chemistry and Mixing: Used for dissolution, mixing and reaction steps that need programmed speed and direction changes.
Sample Preparation: Suitable for multi-step sample preparation across flasks, tubes and microplates.
Analytical Laboratories: Supports reproducible, documented mixing for analytical and QC workflows.
Research and Teaching: Ideal for labs that need automated, repeatable shaking protocols.

longForm.heroLead: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) SKC-7000 Series Program Shakers are programmable open-air orbital platform shakers built around an innovative triple-cam shaking mechanism that offers reliable performance across a wide speed range.
heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) SKC-7000 Series Program Shakers are programmable open-air orbital platform shakers built around an innovative triple-cam shaking mechanism that offers reliable performance across a wide speed range.

Built around an ideal DD (Direct Drive) brushless motor and triple cam system with an exceptionally low-profile design (only 12 cm from the bottom to the platform), the SKC-7000 Series delivers high torque, quiet, maintenance-free operation with minimal vibration.

Three models - SKC-7075, SKC-7100 and SKC-7200 - offer a choice of amplitude (19, 25 or 50 mm) with programmable forward/backward and pause steps, and an optional easy-exchange slide-type universal platform.

body: The SKC-7000 Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of programmable open-air platform shakers engineered for laboratories that need repeatable, multi-step shaking with reliable high-speed performance.

An innovative triple-cam shaking mechanism gives reliable performance across a wide speed range, and programmable forward, backward and pause steps let users automate complex or repetitive shaking protocols.

An ideal DD (Direct Drive) brushless motor with a triple cam system supports heavy loads with high torque, quiet running and maintenance-free operation, while an exceptionally low-profile design minimises vibration during high-speed shaking.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) CBS-350 Heating Shaker combines precise temperature control with high-speed orbital mixing, and its interval-mix function in program mode can be set to match each user's experimental conditions.
features: Combined Heating and Mixing: The CBS-350 heats from ambient +5 to 100°C and mixes orbitally at high speed, combining a heating block and shaker in one instrument.
Wide High-Speed Range: Microprocessor PID control ensures consistent, precise shaking across a wide 150 to 1500 rpm range (block-dependent), with a 2 mm orbit suited to tubes and plates.
Programmable Interval Mix: An interval-mix function continuously switches between shaking and phasing, and can be set precisely in program mode to match each experimental condition.
Program Memory: A memory function stores relevant parameters - temperature, rpm and time - for each program step, with up to 10 programs of up to 10 steps each.
Dual Wait-Timer Modes: Advanced dual wait on/off timer modes let the user start the timer immediately, or only after the set temperature is reached.
Optimal Heat Transfer: A tight coupling design between the main body and corrosion-resistant anodized aluminum blocks achieves optimal, uniform heat transfer.
Automatic Temperature Calibration: Automatic temperature calibration keeps readings accurate, displayed on a bright VFD with 0.1°C resolution and responsive touch buttons.

Low-Vibration Design and Safety: A low-profile design with rubber feet minimises vibration and noise, and safety features include over-temperature protection on the heating plate and PCB, current-limit protection, a self-diagnostic function and a chemical-resistant polypropylene body.

faqs.question: What does the CBS-350 do?
faqs.answer: It combines heating (ambient +5 to 100°C) with high-speed orbital mixing in one instrument.

faqs.question: What is the speed range?
faqs.answer: 150 up to 1500 rpm, depending on the fitted block, with a 2 mm orbit.

faqs.question: How accurate is the temperature?
faqs.answer: ±0.3°C fluctuation at 80°C, displayed with 0.1°C resolution and automatic calibration.

faqs.question: What is interval mix?
faqs.answer: A programmable function that continuously switches between shaking and phasing to suit each protocol.

faqs.question: Is it programmable?
faqs.answer: Yes. It stores up to 10 programs of up to 10 steps, saving temperature, rpm and time per step.

faqs.question: Can it wait for temperature before starting?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dual wait-timer modes let the timer start immediately or only after the set temperature is reached.

faqs.question: What tube formats are supported?
faqs.answer: Interchangeable blocks for 0.2, 0.5, 1.5/2.0, 15 and 50 mL tubes, 12/13 mm tubes and 96-well formats.

faqs.question: Why does max speed differ by block?
faqs.answer: Larger, heavier tubes reduce the safe maximum speed, so each block has its own rpm limit.

Built around microprocessor PID control and corrosion-resistant anodized aluminum tube blocks, the CBS-350 achieves optimal heat transfer through a tight coupling design and delivers consistent, precise shaking.

body: The CBS-350 from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a heating shaker (thermomixer) engineered for laboratories that need combined temperature control and high-speed mixing of tubes and plates.
Microprocessor PID control ensures consistent shaking motion and precise accuracy, while a programmable interval-mix function continuously switches between shaking and phasing to match each protocol.

Optimal heat transfer is achieved by the tight coupling design of the main body and corrosion-resistant anodized aluminum blocks, and a low-profile design with rubber feet keeps vibration and noise to a minimum.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) IST Series Incubated Shakers (Tabletop) are digital incubating and refrigerating benchtop shakers that combine precise temperature control with high-speed orbital shaking for culturing and mixing.
features: Precise Temperature Control: Microprocessor PID control with three-point temperature calibration and automatic tuning holds temperature to ±0.1°C fluctuation at 37°C in flask.
Optional Refrigeration: R models cool to ambient -15°C (minimum 15°C) using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant to minimise greenhouse-gas emissions.
High-Speed BLDC Shaking: A maintenance-free BLDC motor delivers competitive high speed up to 500 rpm with a 19.1 mm orbit and a wide speed range even under heavy workloads.

Uniform Temperature Distribution: A high-velocity fan ensures uniform temperature distribution and rapid thermal recovery after the door is opened, and an air-tight silicone door seal gives excellent uniformity.
Smooth Start and Stop: Smooth acceleration and deceleration control, with smooth start and smooth stop, prevents chemical spills from flasks or test tubes.

Sample Monitoring: A three-side transparent acrylic lid with bright LED lamps allows convenient sample monitoring without affecting the internal environment, and gas-spring lid supports give smooth, soft opening and closing.
Repeatable Positioning: The platform stops where it starts, so repetitive tasks are easy and the fixed stop position benefits automated dosing or sampling.

Touch-Screen Control and Connectivity: An intuitive touch-screen LCD with easy icons and logical menus, a digital timer to 999 hr 59 min, built-in RS-232 and USB ports, and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox make operation and data collection simple.

Compliance and Safety: The unit integrates with 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper (option) for GMP audits, and safety features include auto-run after power interruption, temperature and speed deviation alarms, overcurrent protection, stalled-platform check, mechanical over-temperature protection, a stainless-steel interior and audible/visible open-door alarms.

The refrigerated R models add cooling to ambient -15°C using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant, and a maintenance-free BLDC motor with smooth start/stop provides quiet, spill-free operation.

features: Direct-Drive Triple-Cam Mechanism: An ideal DD (Direct Drive) brushless motor and triple cam system support heavy loads with high torque at high speed, quiet running, smooth rotation and maintenance-free operation.

Best-Effort Run and Auto Adjustment: A best-effort run function intelligently manages rpm to keep shaking even beyond capacity, and automatic speed adjustment responds to unbalanced loads, unusual vibration or external shock.

Precise Temperature Control: Microprocessor PID control with three-point calibration and automatic tuning holds temperature to ±0.1°C fluctuation at 37°C in flask, and a triple independent temperature monitor system adds protection.
Optional Refrigeration: R models cool to ambient -20°C (minimum +4°C) using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant; a defrost function is recommended below 25°C.

Uniform Temperature Distribution: A high-velocity fan ensures uniform temperature distribution and rapid thermal recovery after opening, with an air-tight silicone door seal and a lockable door for safe sample storage.
Smooth Start and Stop: Smooth acceleration and deceleration, with smooth start and smooth stop, prevents chemical spills from flasks or test tubes.

Easy Sample Monitoring and Access: A transparent top viewing window with bright LED lamps, gently inclined toward the front, allows clear observation without affecting the chamber, and gas-spring lid supports give smooth opening and closing. An easy-access drain with a quick-disconnect valve simplifies clean-up, and sturdy foot casters ease mobility.

Connectivity and Compliance: An intuitive touch-screen LCD, a digital timer to 999 hr 59 min, built-in RS-232 and USB ports, optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox, and optional 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper support operation, data collection and GMP audits.

Safety: Safety features include auto-run after power interruption, temperature and speed deviation alarms, overcurrent protection, a triple independent temperature monitor system (deviation alarm, electronic limiter and mechanical over-temperature limiter), a corrosion-resistant stainless-steel interior and CFC-free refrigerant on R models.

heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) ISS Series Incubated Shakers (Multi-Stackable) are large-capacity, triple-stackable incubated shakers that let laboratories multiply throughput in the same floor footprint, with reliable temperature control and stable shaking of high-load samples.

A direct-drive motor with outstanding durability - backed by a 5-year motor warranty - delivers minimized-vibration shaking, and a patented shaking structure keeps high-load samples stable (KR patent 10-1678160).

body: The ISS Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of triple-stackable incubated shakers engineered for laboratories that need to expand shaking capacity without expanding floor space.

Each 198 L unit stacks up to three high using exclusive stacking kits and stands, and three operating modes - Temperature and Shaking, Temperature only, or Shaking only - let each unit run the way a protocol needs.

A durable direct-drive motor with a 5-year warranty, a patented low-vibration shaking structure and a glide-up door make high-load work stable and convenient, while R models add cooling to ambient -20°C using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the ISS Series include an ambient +10 to 80°C range (R to ambient -20°C), 30 to 400 rpm shaking and a 198 L stackable chamber.

Standard models control from 10°C above ambient (15 to 40°C) to 80°C; R models control from 20°C below ambient (18 to 35°C) to 80°C, lowest 4°C. Stacked units have reduced maximum speeds (see table). Use the defrost function below 25°C. A universal platform is sold separately, and exclusive stacking kits and stands are required for stacking.

sections.title: Control and Operation
body: The ISS Series offers colour touch-screen PID control with three modes, timer, self-diagnosis and optional compliance software.
Microprocessor PID control with temperature auto-tuning and calibration.
Three operating modes: Temperature and Shaking, Temperature, or Shaking.
Intuitive colour touch display with controller-lock and full status/error display.
Countdown timer to 999 hr 59 min; auto-restart after power recovery.
Optional LC Connected mobile monitoring (LC GreenBox) and LC DataKeeper (21 CFR Part 11).

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) ISS-3075/4075 Series Incubated Shakers (Stackable) are specially designed to be double-stacked on the floor or placed on lab benches for space saving, while delivering precise temperature control and high-speed shaking.
features: Space-Efficient Double Stacking: The best space-efficient model, designed to double-stack using exclusive stacking kits or sit on the bench, saving valuable laboratory space.
Three Operating Modes: Each unit runs in Temperature and Shaking, Temperature only, or Shaking only mode, so different protocols can share a stack.

High-Speed, Precise Control: Up to 500 rpm (19.1 mm orbit) with microprocessor PID control, temperature auto-tuning and calibration holds temperature to ±0.1°C fluctuation at 37°C in flask, up to 80°C.
Internal Power Outlet: An internal power outlet adds convenience for in-chamber accessories.
Optional Refrigeration: R models cool to ambient -20°C (minimum +4°C) using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant; a defrost function is recommended below 25°C.

Convenient Operation: An intuitive colour touch display shows all operation and error information, high-brightness low-power LED illumination makes it easy to observe inside, and a spill drain port keeps the chamber clean and easy to maintain.
Low Vibration and Soft Start/Stop: A shaking structure with minimized vibration, plus soft start and stop, keeps operation smooth and spill-free, with a countdown timer to 999 hr 59 min.

Dual Over-Temperature Protection: An electronic advanced over-temperature limiter (A-OT) with an independent precision sensor and controller, plus a conventional backup mechanical limiter (B-OT), provide reliable protection even during electronic faults.

Smart Self-Diagnosis and Connectivity: Real-time self-diagnostics monitor rpm and temperature against setpoints and raise alarms, the unit restarts automatically after power recovery, a controller-lock prevents accidental changes, and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring (via LC GreenBox) and 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper support remote oversight and GMP audits.

applications: Space-Constrained Culturing: Used where bench or floor space is limited, by stacking two units or placing one on the bench.
Parallel Small-Batch Work: Supports running different conditions in each unit thanks to three operating modes.
Microbial and Cell Culture: Used for bacterial, yeast and suspension cell culturing at controlled temperature.
Protein Expression: Used for induction and expression, including sub-ambient induction on R models.
Refrigerated Culturing: R models support cold incubation and temperature-sensitive work.
Pharmaceutical and QC: Supports GMP-oriented culturing with optional 21 CFR Part 11 data integrity.

body: The ISS-3075/4075 Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of space-efficient stackable incubated shakers engineered for laboratories that need controlled-temperature shaking without dedicating a lot of bench or floor area.

Two units can be double-stacked using exclusive stacking kits, or a unit can sit on the bench, and three operating modes - Temperature and Shaking, Temperature only, or Shaking only - let each unit match its protocol.

An orbital motion up to 500 rpm (19.1 mm amplitude) with ±0.1°C temperature control, a low-vibration structure and an internal power outlet make these units flexible, and R models add cooling to ambient -20°C using eco-friendly R-600a refrigerant.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the ISS-3075/4075 Series include an ambient +5 to 80°C range (R to ambient -20°C), 20 to 500 rpm shaking and 80 or 150 L chambers.

Standard models control from 5°C above ambient (15 to 40°C) to 80°C; R models control from ambient down to -20°C, lowest 4°C. Stacked units run at reduced maximum speed (20 to 250 rpm). Use the defrost function below 25°C. Speed accuracy is ±1 rpm at or below 100 rpm and ±1% above 100 rpm. A universal platform is sold separately, and exclusive stacking kits are required to stack two units.

sections.title: Control and Operation
body: The ISS-3075/4075 Series offers colour touch-screen PID control with three modes, timer, self-diagnosis and optional compliance software.
Microprocessor PID control with temperature auto-tuning and calibration.
Three operating modes: Temperature and Shaking, Temperature, or Shaking.
Intuitive colour touch display with controller-lock and full status/error display.
Countdown timer to 999 hr 59 min; auto-restart after power recovery.
Optional LC Connected mobile monitoring (LC GreenBox) and LC DataKeeper (21 CFR Part 11).

body: The BW-H Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of agitated heating baths engineered for laboratories that need uniform, reliable warming of samples in water.

A patented built-in agitator drives a powerful circulation system, so heat is distributed evenly across the bath, and microprocessor PID control with automatic tuning and calibration holds temperature to +/- 0.1 C at 50 C.

An isolated design separates the heater and sensor behind a baffle plate to protect users and samples from direct contact, and a low-profile design with a sloped control panel makes operation easier and safer.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) BS2 Series Shaking Heating Baths combine reciprocal shaking with precise heating and a transparent cover, ideal for sample incubation of DNA, tissue culture and heat-sensitive samples.
features: Precise Heat and Motion: Precise rpm (max 200 rpm) and temperature (max 100 C) control with accuracy, plus optimal PID control, deliver reliable, repeatable conditions.
Excellent Temperature Distribution: The shaking motion gives excellent temperature distribution across the bath (+/- 0.1 C at 50 C).
Multi-Point Calibration: Three-point temperature calibration and one-point shaking calibration give better accuracy across the range.
Extended Height for Large Flasks: An extended bath height accommodates larger sample volumes, with room for flasks up to 2.8 L.
Touch Colour Display and Timer: Easy operation with a touch colour display and an automatic on/off timer (up to 999 hr 59 min).
Transparent Gable Cover: A transparent gable roof-shaped cover prevents condensed water from falling onto specimens, and a spring wire rack is provided as standard.

Convenient Access and Connectivity: A side-mounted drain port improves accessibility, a USB port connects to a PC for recording and monitoring, and optional real-time mobile monitoring is available via LC GreenBox.

Compliance and Safety: Optional 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper supports GMP audits, and safety features include audio and visual alarms with heater shutdown on water shortage, temperature and rpm discrepancy alarms, sensor-fault alarms, and over-current and short-circuit protection.

Intuitive Touch-Screen LCD: An intuitive touch-screen LCD controller with easy icons and logical menus includes a convenient scheduler and a program-view-at-a-glance display.

Powerful Variable-Speed Pump: A powerful variable-speed pump gives 1 to 3 steps for internal circulation and 4 to 5 steps for external circulation, with strong pressure and flow across the whole temperature range.
Ultra-Stable PID Control: Microprocessor PID control with three-point calibration, automatic tuning and automatic run holds temperature to +/- 0.05 C at 50 C.

Digital I/O and Connectivity: A digital input/output control function interlocks external devices, and RS-232 and USB interfaces support external control and data collection, with optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox.

Easy-Clean, Mobile Bath: A corrosion-resistant, leak-proof, round-cornered, easy-to-clean stainless-steel bath with an easy-access drain valve, built-in casters and side handles makes transport, installation and cleaning simple.
Temperature Warning Indicator: A temperature warning indicator shows the inner reservoir temperature by three different colours at a glance.

Safety: An isolated agitator, heater and sensor design, low-level, dry-running, over-temperature and over-current protection, warning alarms, a keypad lock and a splash-proof keypad keep operation safe.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) RW3 Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulators (General) deliver rapid heating and cooling throughout the entire temperature range, combining a built-in cooling coil with a powerful five-speed pump for both internal and external circulation.
features: Rapid Heating and Cooling: A built-in cooling coil and heater deliver rapid heating and cooling throughout the entire range, from -35 C (or -25 C) up to 150 C.
Five-Speed Pump: A five-speed adjustable pump reduces turbulence and suits both internal (steps 1-3) and external (steps 4-5) circulation, reaching up to 5.9 psi and 28 L/min.
Ultra-Stable PID Control: Microprocessor PID control with three-point calibration, automatic tuning and automatic run holds temperature to +/- 0.05 C.

Efficient, Low-Maintenance Cooling: CFC-free refrigerant (R-507 or R-404A) with a double service valve prevents leakage, and a detachable condenser air-filter plus a quick-release front grill make cleaning and maintenance easy.
Bright VFD Display: A bright VFD display with a quick adjustable dial knob shows temperature at 0.1 C resolution.
Dual Timer and Memory: Dual wait on/off timer modes (1 minute to 99 hr 59 min) and a three-temperature memory simplify repeated work.

Easy-Clean Bath and Connectivity: A corrosion-resistant, leak-proof, round-cornered, easy-to-clean stainless-steel bath with a drain valve and side handles, RS-232 and USB interfaces, an optional external temperature sensor and optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox complete the package.
Safety: An isolated agitator, heater and sensor design, low-level, dry-running, over-temperature and over-current protection, warning alarms and a keypad lock keep operation safe.

faqs.question: What is the temperature range?
faqs.answer: -25 to 150 C on the RW3-25 class and -35 to 150 C on the RW3-35 class, with +/- 0.05 C stability.

faqs.question: How much cooling capacity does it have?
faqs.answer: For example, 400 to 980 W at +20 C, 270 to 700 W at 0 C and 140 to 465 W at -20 C, depending on model (with ethanol).

faqs.question: Does it circulate to external apparatus?
faqs.answer: Yes. A five-speed adjustable pump provides internal circulation (steps 1-3) and external circulation (steps 4-5), up to 5.9 psi and 28 L/min.

faqs.question: What refrigerant does it use?
faqs.answer: CFC-free R-507 or R-404A, with a double service valve to prevent leakage.

faqs.question: Can I control the sample temperature directly?
faqs.answer: Yes, with an optional external sensor (3 m or 5 m).

faqs.question: What bath volumes are available?
faqs.answer: 5, 10, 20 and 30 L in both temperature classes.

faqs.question: What bath fluid does it use?
faqs.answer: Water near ambient; ethanol or silicone oil for wide-range work (replace silicone tube fittings with copper or Teflon at high temperature).

faqs.question: Is the condenser easy to maintain?
faqs.answer: Yes. A detachable condenser air-filter and a quick-release front grill make cleaning easy.

faqs.question: Can I record data?
faqs.answer: Yes, via RS-232 and USB, and optionally via LC Connected mobile monitoring using LC GreenBox.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help select the class, capacity and fluid?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help select the temperature class, volume, cooling capacity, sensor and fluid, and support installation and training.

heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) RW3 Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulators (General) deliver rapid heating and cooling throughout the entire temperature range, combining a built-in cooling coil with a powerful five-speed pump for both internal and external circulation.

Two temperature classes - RW3-25 models (-25 to 150 C) and RW3-35 models (-35 to 150 C) - are held to +/- 0.05 C by microprocessor PID control with three-point calibration, automatic tuning and automatic run.
Four bath volumes in each class - 5, 10, 20 and 30 L - use CFC-free refrigerant (R-507 or R-404A) and a corrosion-resistant, easy-to-clean stainless-steel bath.

sections.title: RW3 Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulator at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the RW3 Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulator (General) overview, features, applications, specifications, control system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The RW3 Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulators heat and cool rapidly across the entire range with powerful internal and external circulation.
body: The RW3 Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of refrigerated and heating bath circulators engineered for laboratories that need precise, stable temperature control both above and below ambient, delivered inside the bath and to external apparatus.

A five-speed adjustable pump and a built-in cooling coil reduce turbulence and suit both internal and external circulation - 1 to 3 steps for internal mixing and 4 to 5 steps for external supply - with strong pressure and flow.

Microprocessor PID control with three-point calibration holds temperature to +/- 0.05 C, and CFC-free refrigerant with a double service valve, a detachable condenser air-filter and a quick-release front grill keep cooling efficient and maintenance simple.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Built for rapid, stable heating and cooling
sections.description: The RW3 Series combines a five-speed pump, a built-in cooling coil, PID control, easy condenser maintenance and full safety protection.

sections.title: Applications
sections.description: From sub-ambient reactor control to calibration and property testing, the RW3 Series suits chemistry, materials, pharmaceutical and QC laboratories.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the RW3 Series include a -25 to 150 C or -35 to 150 C range, +/- 0.05 C stability, and 5 to 30 L bath volumes with internal and external circulation.

Technical data according to DIN 12876 (stability measured with ethanol at -10 C; cooling capacity with ethanol, at 230V/60Hz). Pump performance measured with water. Refrigerant: R-507 or R-404A depending on model. When using silicone oil, replace the silicone tube fittings (inlet/outlet) with copper or Teflon tube. Contact technical support for consultation before purchasing.

sections.title: Control and Operation
body: The RW3 Series offers PID control with a VFD display, five-speed pump, dual timers, memory and connectivity.
Microprocessor PID control with three-point calibration, auto-tuning and auto-run.
Bright VFD display with quick adjustable dial knob (0.1 C resolution).
Five-speed pump: 1-3 steps internal, 4-5 steps external circulation.
Dual wait on/off timers (1 minute to 99 hr 59 min) and 3-temperature memory.
RS-232 and USB interfaces; optional external sensor; optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox; keypad lock.

sections.title: Configure the RW3 Series around your workflow
sections.description: Configurations and options of the RW3 Series include temperature-class and volume selection, an external sensor, stainless-steel covers, test tube racks and spring wire racks.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) RW3-P Series Refrigerated & Heating Bath Circulators (Program) add a smart programmable controller to wide-range refrigerated and heating circulation, automating temperature ramp-up and dwell profiles from -35 C up to 150 C.
features: Intelligent Program Control: Ten programs are available for temperature ramp-up and dwell control, with 10 steps per program, up to 99 hr 59 min per step, easily linkable programs and repeats of up to 99 cycles; pre-heating and heating times can be set before a program starts.
Wide-Range Heating and Cooling: A built-in cooling coil and heater deliver rapid heating and cooling from -35 C (or -25 C) up to 150 C.
Five-Speed Pump: A five-speed adjustable pump reduces turbulence and suits internal (steps 1-3) and external (steps 4-5) circulation, up to 5.9 psi and 28 L/min.
Ultra-Stable PID Control: Microprocessor PID control with three-point calibration, automatic tuning and automatic run holds temperature to +/- 0.05 C.
Intuitive Touch-Screen LCD: An intuitive touch-screen LCD controller with easy icons and logical menus manages programs and scheduling.

Digital I/O and Connectivity: A digital input/output control function interlocks external devices, and RS-232 and USB interfaces support external control and data collection, with optional LC Connected mobile monitoring via LC GreenBox.

Efficient, Low-Maintenance Cooling: CFC-free refrigerant (R-507 or R-404A) with a double service valve, a detachable condenser air-filter and a quick-release front grill keep cooling efficient and maintenance simple.

Mobile Bath and Safety: A corrosion-resistant, easy-to-clean stainless-steel bath with a drain valve, built-in casters and side handles, an isolated design, a three-colour temperature warning indicator, low-level, dry-run, over-temperature and over-current protection, warning alarms, a keypad lock and a splash-proof keypad complete the package.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) ST-G Series Autoclaves (Vertical Type) use microprocessor control with reliable safety functions to guarantee an optimum sterilization temperature, in a top-loading vertical design suited to high-volume sterilization.
features: High-Precision Control: A microprocessor controller with a temperature-calibration function allows high-precision temperature control, with sterilization from 110 to 123 C and melting (liquefaction of coagulated agar media) from 60 to 100 C.
Automatic Sterilization Cycle: An automatic sterilization system enables unattended operation, running heating, safety check, sterilization, sterilization-safe, exhausting and end in sequence.
Standard and Program Modes: Standard modes cover decontamination, solids, liquids and melting, and program modes allow custom temperature (110 to 123 C) and time (1 to 999 minutes) for varied uses.

Clear Monitoring: A VFD visualises temperature, pressure (optional), timer and warning-alert checks, LED lamps show the sterilization process, and a standard front pressure gauge makes pressure easy to read.
Vertical Top-Loading: The vertical, top-loading design suits high-volume sterilization, and baskets stack two high or more to make full use of the chamber.
Low-Maintenance Build: A corrosion-resistant stainless-steel chamber and an easy-to-replace silicone gasket keep maintenance low.

Documentation and Connectivity: An optional dot-type (6-point) data recorder supports documentation, LC GreenBox enables mobile monitoring, and 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper suits GMP audits.
Comprehensive Safety: Mechanical safety devices and warning systems protect users and loads (detailed in the Control & Safety section).

body: The DC2 Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of automatic electronic dry cabinets engineered for laboratories that need to store moisture-sensitive materials, components and samples in a reliably low-humidity environment.

An automatic electronic desiccator unit controls the set humidity inside the cabinet without any desiccant, so maintenance is simple, and deviation notification and calibration for humidity and temperature keep control reliable.
A large transparent acrylic window allows convenient internal observation, height-adjustable shelves and optional drawers handle varied samples, and a key lock blocks unauthorised access.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) SC3-90F Series Fire Safety Storage Cabinets (Type 90) safeguard flammable hazardous materials from fire, with proven refractory performance certified to the strictest European standard, EN 14470-1.
features: High Fire Resistance: Fire resistance performance is in accordance with the strictest European standard (EN 14470-1), with the internal temperature kept below a 180 K rise for up to 90 minutes in the event of fire.

Fire Response Sealing System: When the temperature reaches 50 C the door automatically closes, and when the ambient temperature reaches 70 +/- 10 C the exhaust holes and ventilation openings automatically close, totally blocking the flow of heat from outside.

Application-Matched Model Selection: The right model can be selected to suppress fire at the natural ignition point of the dangerous goods being handled, considering prediction time and other factors.
Chemical-Resistant Interior: The interior material is coated with polyphenol resin for excellent chemical resistance, even in long-term use.
Triple Insulation Structure: All walls use the same triple-insulated structure, and all gaps are treated with fire-retardant finishes to protect flammable materials in a surrounding fire.

Safe Ventilation of Flammable Vapour: Vent inlet and outlet openings discharge gas easily to prevent accidents from accumulated flammable vapour and protect the operator, keeping vapours below the LEL concentration.
Solid, Secure Shelving: A solid shelf structure holds up to 80 kg per shelf and fixes firmly to the inside walls, with 30 mm-deep shelf edges to safely retain any leaked contents.

Effluent Reservoir and Key Lock: A bottom collecting sump safely handles any leaked material and prevents leakage out of the cabinet, and a key lock is provided as standard to block unauthorised access.
Easy Movement and Installation: Forklift fork space allows convenient movement, and leveling feet provide stable installation; under-bench models offer selectable 750 mm or 820 mm working height.

sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the SC3-30F Series Fire Safety Storage Cabinet (Type 30) overview, features, applications, specifications, safety system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The SC3-30F Series Fire Safety Cabinets protect flammable materials with certified 30-minute fire resistance.
body: The SC3-30F Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of Type 30 fire safety storage cabinets engineered for laboratories that must store flammable and hazardous materials safely, where a certified 30-minute fire rating meets the requirement.

Fire resistance is certified to EN 14470-1, keeping the internal temperature below a 180 K rise for up to 30 minutes during a fire, and a Fire Response Sealing System automatically closes the door and seals the ventilation to block external heat.
A triple-insulated structure, a chemical-resistant polyphenol-resin interior, solid 80 kg shelves with leak-safe edges, an effluent-collecting sump and a key lock make daily storage safe and secure.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the SC3-30F Series include EN 14470-1 Type 30 fire resistance and 116 to 802 L storage volumes.

Type 30: internal temperature kept below a 180 K rise for up to 30 minutes in fire, per EN 14470-1 (fire test to EN 1363-1). Standard shelves and sump are epoxy powder-coated steel; stainless steel, PP trays and drawers are optional. Under-bench models offer 750 mm or 820 mm working height. Contact technical support for consultation before purchasing.

sections.title: Safety System and Operation
body: The SC3-30F Series provides certified fire resistance with automatic sealing, safe ventilation and secure access.
EN 14470-1 Type 30: internal temperature below 180 K rise for up to 30 minutes.
Door auto-closes at 50 C; exhaust and ventilation auto-seal at 70 +/- 10 C.
Triple-insulated walls with fire-retardant gap finishes.
Safe flammable-vapour ventilation (keeps vapours below LEL); door closure holds the door at any position.
Key lock as standard; effluent-collecting sump; forklift fork space and leveling feet.

Space-Efficient Interior: An internal compartment structure organises the interior efficiently according to the stored samples for practical, safe use (except SC-C-0706D1).
Key Lock and Labelling: A key lock is provided as standard to block unauthorised access, and removable acid/base pictogram stickers make it easy to classify stored materials.
Easy Movement and Installation: Forklift space allows convenient movement, and leveling feet provide stable installation.

If combustible or corrosive vapour is left without ventilation during storage, it may affect product durability or contaminate the inside air; connecting to a building or separate exhaust system is recommended. A top exhaust vent allows connection to forced exhaust or a purifier. The SC-C-0706D1 does not include the exhaust-system connection, compartment interior or standard shelves/trays of the larger models. Contact technical support for consultation before purchasing.

sections.title: Ventilation and Operation
body: The SC-C Series provides safe corrosive storage with built-in ventilation, spill containment and secure access.
Built-in top vent and rear exhaust holes prevent gas accumulation.
Connectable to a building or separate exhaust system (except SC-C-0706D1), or ductless with the EM-33 module.
Phenol-resin coated, corrosion-resistant interior for acids and bases.
PP spill trays and 30 mm shelf edges contain leaks.
Key lock as standard; acid/base pictogram stickers; forklift space and leveling feet.

products.overview: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) FSC Series Filtering Storage Cabinets store reagents in a ductless, recirculating-filtration cabinet, keeping the laboratory environment clean without connecting to an existing exhaust system.
features: Cost-Effective Ductless Filtration: Flexible installation is possible with no cost-intensive exhaust air ducts, and internal air circulation prevents the heating and cooling loss - and high energy consumption - of ducted exhaust.

Customised Filter Configuration: An ISO class 4 (US class 10) HEPA filter removes 0.3 um and larger particulates at 99.99% efficiency; a polyester pre-filter (85% arrestance) traps larger particles and extends HEPA life; and VOC, MA and MB activated-carbon filters are available - selected to suit the chemicals used.
Real-Time VOC Indication: A clear, symbolic VOC level bar indicates the VOC measurement inside the cabinet, with real-time detecting and displaying via an internal VOC sensor.

Powerful Air Purification (Turbo Fan): A turbo-fan button activates the fan at maximum speed before the door is opened, protecting users from any remaining hazardous gas; this can also be interlocked with door opening.

Safety Alarms and Protection: Safety warning alarms with LED indicators cover high temperature (with automatic fan stop), fan failure, door open, sensor error and check-filter, plus over-temperature and over-current protection.

Energy-Saving Sleep Mode: A sleep mode (for example, running only 8 am to 6 pm) saves up to 60% of energy consumption and extends the life of the fan and filter, and auto run resumes automatically after a power failure.

SEFA-Tested, Durable Storage: Doors and drawers are tested to SEFA (door-hinge and drawer static-load tests), with an additional overturning test, and drawers sustain up to 40 kg on smooth full-extension slides.

Chemical-Resistant Build: Corrosion-resistant epoxy-coated steel throughout and a tempered-glass door give clear observation, a full-length handle, a spill tray and a door lock for clean, safe storage.

body: The FSC Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of filtering storage cabinets engineered for laboratories that need to store chemical reagents safely and keep the lab environment clean, without a ducted exhaust system.
The cabinet recirculates and purifies air internally, tested to BS 7989:2001, so it can be installed flexibly anywhere and avoids the heating and cooling energy loss of ducted exhaust systems.

Customised HEPA and activated-carbon filtration, a real-time VOC sensor and level bar, safety alarms with LED indicators, a turbo-fan function, an energy-saving sleep mode and SEFA-tested epoxy-coated-steel drawers with a tempered-glass door make it safe, efficient and easy to use.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, user training and after-sales service.

Carbon filters (complex, acid, formaldehyde, ammonia/amines) are selected to suit the chemicals used; a built-in pre-filter extends filter life. Front-Door Vacuum Gauge: A standard vacuum gauge attached to the front door makes checking the vacuum level easy.
UV-Blocking Option: U models are translucent amber vacuum desiccators with an ultraviolet-block effect, minimising damage or discolouration of light-sensitive samples.

faqs.question: What is the cylindrical design for?
faqs.answer: It is newly designed and ideal for storing tall equipment and samples that do not fit flat desiccators.

faqs.question: What vacuum can it reach and hold?
faqs.answer: A maximum vacuum of 1 Torr (1.33 x 10-4 MPa), held for 72 hours.

faqs.question: Does it need vacuum grease?
faqs.answer: No. A high-quality silicone gasket gives a greaseless airtight seal, and a flange lock holds the halves together under non-vacuum conditions.

faqs.question: What sizes are available?

faqs.question: Is a vacuum gauge included?

faqs.question: How adjustable are the shelves?

faqs.question: How do I draw, release or exchange gas?

faqs.question: Are round and cylindrical bodies compatible?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tops and bottoms of round and cylindrical vacuum desiccators are cross-compatible.

faqs.question: Is it RoHS compliant?
faqs.answer: Yes, except for the VDP-U (UV-block) models.

Connectivity and Compliance: RS-232 and USB ports, an optional BMS port, LC GreenBox mobile monitoring and 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper support data management and GMP audits.

Outstanding Safety: A buffered door releases internal pressure through upper and lower vent holes on stable vacuum or internal explosion, a polycarbonate safety cover guards against glass breakage, and a patented overheating-protection system, over-temperature limit, controller lock and deviation alarm protect users and samples.

sections.title: OV4 Series Vacuum Oven at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the OV4 Series Vacuum Ovens overview, features, applications, specifications, control and safety system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The OV4 Series Vacuum Ovens dry samples gently under vacuum, at lower effective temperatures and with full safety.
body: The OV4 Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of vacuum ovens engineered for laboratories that need to dry heat-sensitive, oxidation-prone or moisture-laden samples gently under reduced pressure.

Vacuum lowers the effective drying temperature and protects sensitive samples, a wide range reaches 250 C, distribution is tight (+/-1.5 C at 100 C), and 3-point calibration keeps accuracy high, with stainless-steel and aluminium shelves for clean, corrosion-resistant use.

Separated vacuum and release lines, a top-mounted 5-inch display, Ramp Control, automatic CSV data storage, real-time graphs and a buffered safety door with pressure-release vent holes and a polycarbonate cover make the OV4 safe, precise and easy to operate.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, validation support, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the OV4 Series include 28 and 65 L volumes, an Amb. +15 to 250 C range and +/-1.5 C distribution at 100 C.

Controller: 5-inch LCD. The lowest controllable temperature depends on room and sample temperatures. Technical data per DIN 12880 (after 2013). Adding an extra bottom shelf lets you run more samples but may slightly increase variation and fluctuation. A cold trap bath on the vacuum line is recommended to protect the pump from water/solvent or to supply dry air. 120V versions have their own catalog numbers. Contact technical support for consultation before purchasing.

body: The OV4 Series pairs an advanced 5-inch controller with a buffered safety door and patented protection.

items: Buffered door releases internal pressure through upper/lower vent holes (stable vacuum or internal explosion).

body: The OV4-S Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of standard vacuum ovens engineered for laboratories that need to dry heat-sensitive, oxidation-prone or moisture-laden samples gently under reduced pressure, with simple, reliable control.

Vacuum lowers the effective drying temperature and protects sensitive samples, a wide range reaches 250 C, distribution is tight (+/-1.5 C at 100 C), and 3-point calibration keeps accuracy high, with stainless-steel and aluminium shelves for clean, corrosion-resistant use.

Separated vacuum and release lines, a top-mounted 3.5-inch display and a buffered safety door with pressure-release vent holes and a polycarbonate cover make the OV4-S safe, precise and easy to operate.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, validation support, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the OV4-S Series include 28 and 65 L volumes, an Amb. +15 to 250 C range and +/-1.5 C distribution at 100 C.

Controller: 3.5-inch LCD. The lowest controllable temperature depends on room and sample temperatures. Technical data per DIN 12880 (after 2013). Adding an extra bottom shelf lets you run more samples but may slightly increase variation and fluctuation. A cold trap bath on the vacuum line is recommended to protect the pump from water/solvent or to supply dry air. The OV4-S does not include the advanced controller's Ramp Control, real-time graphs or automatic CSV data export (see the OV4 model for those). 120V versions have their own catalog numbers. Contact technical support for consultation before purchasing.

faqs.question: What is a forced convection oven for?
faqs.answer: Fast, uniform drying and heating of samples, glassware and materials using fan-driven airflow, up to 250 C.

faqs.question: How is it different from a natural convection oven?
faqs.answer: Forced convection uses a fan for faster, more uniform heating; natural convection (ON4) is gentler for light or loose samples.

faqs.question: How uniform and fast is it?
faqs.answer: Optimised airflow keeps variation within +/-1.9 C at 100 C, and it can reach 100 C in as little as 8 minutes.

faqs.question: What is the temperature range?
faqs.answer: Ambient +10 up to 250 C.

faqs.question: What sizes and doors are available?
faqs.answer: 26, 61, 112 and 147 L (OF4-03S/05S/10S/15S), each with a solid or window door.

faqs.question: How much can each shelf hold?
faqs.answer: Up to 30 kg per shelf.

faqs.question: Is it safe at high temperature?
faqs.answer: Yes. The surface stays under 70 C at 250 C, with a patented overheating-prevention system, an over-temperature limit and IEC Class II protection.

faqs.question: Can I stack two ovens?
faqs.answer: Yes, with the double-stacked bracket - note the upper oven's control range narrows to Amb.+30 to 250 C.

faqs.question: Is it GMP-ready?
faqs.answer: Yes, with the optional 21 CFR Part 11-compliant LC DataKeeper and PC/mobile/BMS monitoring.

faqs.question: Can Inkarp help select and validate it?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inkarp can help select the size and door, and support installation, calibration, validation and training.

Precise PID Control: Microprocessor PID control with 3-point temperature calibration and automatic tuning ensures high accuracy, with three preset temperatures for the most commonly used settings.

Durable, Easy-Clean Build: A corrosion-resistant incoloy sheath heating element, a stainless-steel interior with rounded corners for easy cleaning and optimal airflow, adjustable dual slide vents for inner vapour circulation, and an energy-efficient optimised insulation system.

Convenience: Dual wait on/off timer modes (1 min to 99 h 59 min), casters for easy mobility, USB and RS-232 ports for external control and data collection, and an optional threefold tempered-glass window for a clear inside view.

longForm.heroHook: Large-volume, fast-drying programmable ovens - up to 760 L and 300 C - for heavy-duty, quick test results
longForm.heroLead: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) OF3-P Series Forced Convection Ovens (Program) are heavy-duty, large-volume ovens specially designed for large-volume and fast-drying applications, up to 760 L and 300 C.
heroParagraphs: The JeioTech (Lab Companion) OF3-P Series Forced Convection Ovens (Program) are heavy-duty, large-volume ovens specially designed for large-volume and fast-drying applications, up to 760 L and 300 C.

Rapid heating from two powerful, noiseless sirocco fans gives uniform temperature distribution and short heat-up times, and an intelligent programmable colour-touch controller runs 10 programs of 10 steps for repeatable, unattended cycles.

Two temperature classes - OF3-P (to 200 C) and OF3-HP (to 300 C) - in three volumes each (314 / 450 / 760 L) suit industrial and high-throughput laboratories needing quick, uniform, programmable drying.

sections.title: OF3-P Series Large-Volume Oven at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the OF3-P Series Forced Convection Ovens (Program) overview, features, applications, specifications, control and safety system, configurations, documentation and support.
sections.subheading: The OF3-P Series Large-Volume Ovens dry high volumes fast and uniformly, with programmable control up to 300 C.
body: The OF3-P Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of heavy-duty, large-volume programmable forced convection ovens engineered for industrial and high-throughput laboratories that need rapid, uniform drying of large or numerous samples.

Two noiseless, powerful sirocco fans generate optimal air circulation for temperature uniformity and short heat-up times, microprocessor PID control with 3-point calibration and automatic tuning keeps accuracy high, and the range reaches 200 C (P) or 300 C (HP).

An intelligent colour-touch programmable controller runs 10 programs of 10 steps (up to 99 h 59 min per step, repeatable up to 99 cycles, with linkable programs and settable pre-heating), a corrosion-resistant incoloy heater and stainless interior with rounded corners ease cleaning, and casters, dual slide vents and an optional tempered-glass window add convenience.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, validation support, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: Technical Specifications
body: The technical specifications of the OF3-P Series include 314 to 760 L volumes, temperatures to 200 C (P) or 300 C (HP) and programmable twin-fan forced convection.

Controller: colour-touch programmable LCD (P/HP models). Two sirocco fans; microprocessor PID with 3-point calibration and auto-tuning. 10 programs x 10 steps, up to 99 h 59 min per step, 99 cycles, linkable programs, settable pre-heating. Technical data per DIN 12880; CE for 380V 50/60 Hz. Each model is available with a solid or window door (optional threefold tempered glass). Cat. Nos.: OF3-30P AAH18615K (solid, 230V) / AAH18715K (window); larger and HP models use 380V 3-phase catalog numbers. Contact technical support for consultation before purchasing.

body: The OF3 Series from JeioTech (Lab Companion) is a range of heavy-duty, large-volume forced convection ovens engineered for industrial and high-throughput laboratories that need rapid, uniform drying of large or numerous samples with straightforward, everyday control.

Two noiseless, powerful sirocco fans generate optimal air circulation for temperature uniformity and short heat-up times, microprocessor PID control with 3-point calibration and automatic tuning keeps accuracy high, and the range reaches 200 C (OF3) or 300 C (OF3-H).

A bright VFD display with a quick adjustable dial knob shows set and present values at once for the simplest control, a corrosion-resistant incoloy heater and stainless interior with rounded corners ease cleaning, and casters, dual slide vents and an optional tempered-glass window add convenience.

As a JeioTech Distributor and Service Provider in India, Inkarp Instruments supports laboratories with product consultation, application guidance, configuration assistance, installation, validation support, user training and after-sales service.

sections.title: The 5-in-1 Rotor
sections.tabSummary: What it replaces and what it covers
body: What it replaces and what it covers.

A centrifuge running several microtube formats through a typical week usually means several rotors — swapped, balanced, and re-swapped as the sample format changes. Kubota built the M500TR's core rotor to remove that step: one rotor, newly developed, sufficient on its own for use across various microtube formats.

That consolidation matters most in labs running mixed protocols day to day, where rotor changeover is otherwise the recurring interruption between one prep step and the next. The machine still scales beyond that single rotor when the work calls for it — bottle rotors up to 500 mL and plate rotor options extend the M500TR across the fuller range Kubota lists in its typical rotor and accessory set.

body: Discover what two named safety functions add to the Kubota S500FR.

The Self-Check Function verifies the system's own operating condition automatically, catching a problem with the machine itself before it affects a run. The Imbalance Early Detector addresses the load side of the same concern, flagging a poorly balanced rotor early, before an uneven spin causes damage or compromises a sample. Both run automatically, regardless of which operator loads the machine.

M500TR reaches 15,300 rpm and 22,250 xg, marginally ahead of 5500's 15,000 rpm and 20,820 xg. sections.title: Built for Plates, Nothing Else
sections.tabSummary: Why a dedicated rotor changes plate-based throughput
body: Learn why a dedicated rotor changes plate-based throughput on the Kubota Plate Spin 3.

Most centrifuges treat plate handling as one option among several, a plate rotor that competes for slot time with tube-based rotors, and has to be swapped in and out. Plate Spin 3 removes that trade-off entirely: the plate rotor is equipped with the main unit, not sold or configured separately, so a lab running plate-based work exclusively never spends time on a rotor decision at all.

That focus pays off directly in capacity. 6 microplates, or 2 × 96-hole PCR plates, or 2 deep well plates, cover the three formats a high-throughput screening or PCR workflow actually needs, without diluting the design to also handle standard tubes.

body: Learn why capacity, not top speed, defines the Kubota Model 8730.

Blood bank and clinical laboratory work rarely needs the 15,000-22,000 rpm range that Kubota's research centrifuges reach, it needs enough capacity to process real batches of blood bags and large bottles at a controlled temperature, reliably, run after run. Model 8730 is built around exactly that priority: a maximum capacity of 4,000 mL, blood bag compatibility built directly into the rotor design, and a temperature range wide enough to protect clinical samples throughout.

The rotor set reflects the same focus. 1 high capacity swinging bucket rotor handles the largest batches, and 2 multi-purpose swinging bucket rotors cover the routine tube and bottle work that fills the rest of a clinical lab's day.

sections.title: Twelve Bags, One Spin
sections.tabSummary: Why batch capacity defines this centrifuge entirely
body: Learn why batch capacity defines the Kubota Model 9945 entirely.

A blood bank doesn't process one bag at a time, it processes donations in batches, and every centrifuge cycle that handles fewer bags means more cycles, more time, and more staff hours spent loading and unloading. Model 9945 is built specifically to remove that bottleneck: 12 blood bags in a single run, on a rotor purpose-built for the 200 mL to 500 mL bag sizes standard blood collection actually uses.
There's no rotor decision to make here, no swapping between tube and plate configurations. One dedicated rotor, one job, done at the batch size a real blood bank actually needs.

sections.title: The 5-in-1 Rotor
sections.tabSummary: What it replaces and what it covers
body: What it replaces and what it covers.

A centrifuge running several microtube formats through a typical week usually means several rotors — swapped, balanced, and re-swapped as the sample format changes. Kubota built the M500TR's core rotor to remove that step: one rotor, newly developed, sufficient on its own for use across various microtube formats.

That consolidation matters most in labs running mixed protocols day to day, where rotor changeover is otherwise the recurring interruption between one prep step and the next. The machine still scales beyond that single rotor when the work calls for it — bottle rotors up to 500 mL and plate rotor options extend the M500TR across the fuller range Kubota lists in its typical rotor and accessory set.

body: Discover how two named safety functions on the Kubota Model S500T catch problems before they affect a run.

Kubota names two specific functions on S500T that go beyond S300T's single imbalance detector: a Self-Check Function and an Imbalance Early Detector. sections.title: Self-Check and Early Imbalance Detection
sections.tabSummary: What two named safety functions add to floor-standing use
body: Discover what two named safety functions add to the Kubota S500FR.

The Self-Check Function verifies the system's own operating condition automatically, catching a problem with the machine itself before it affects a run. The Imbalance Early Detector addresses the load side of the same concern, flagging a poorly balanced rotor early, before an uneven spin causes damage or compromises a sample. Both run automatically, regardless of which operator loads the machine.

body: Compare the two highest-performing Kubota centrifuges to choose between rotor variety and top-end speed.

Model 5500 and M500TR are the two strongest performers in Kubota's general-purpose lineup, and their headline figures sit close enough to genuinely compare. M500TR reaches 15,300 rpm and 22,250 xg, marginally ahead of 5500's 15,000 rpm and 20,820 xg. But 5500 pulls ahead on a wider -20°C to +40°C temperature range against M500TR's -10°C to +40°C, and on rotor count. M500TR's page highlights a single "5-in-1" rotor as its defining feature; Model 5500 offers 12 separate rotor options across four geometries.

sections.title: Built for Plates, Nothing Else
sections.tabSummary: Why a dedicated rotor changes plate-based throughput
body: Learn why a dedicated rotor changes plate-based throughput on the Kubota Plate Spin 3.

Most centrifuges treat plate handling as one option among several, a plate rotor that competes for slot time with tube-based rotors, and has to be swapped in and out. Plate Spin 3 removes that trade-off entirely: the plate rotor is equipped with the main unit, not sold or configured separately, so a lab running plate-based work exclusively never spends time on a rotor decision at all.

That focus pays off directly in capacity. 6 microplates, or 2 × 96-hole PCR plates, or 2 deep well plates, cover the three formats a high-throughput screening or PCR workflow actually needs, without diluting the design to also handle standard tubes.
